rollCalls.title: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering
rollCalls.summary: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for speech therapy for stuttering.

rollCalls.title: Directs the public service commission to develop, publish, and update a guidebook on the gas and electric ratemaking process
rollCalls.summary: Directs the public service commission to develop, publish, and update a guidebook on the gas and electric ratemaking process to promote public understanding and participation in the gas and electric ratemaking process; facilitates the formal intervention and participation of interested or affected parties; sets forth requirements for what such guidebook shall include.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes owners of mobile barber shops to obtain barber shop owner's licenses
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes owners of mobile barber shops to obtain barber shop owner's licenses provided that they can furnish proof of title, possession, registration and driver's license authorizing operation of the vehicle to be used to operate the mobile barber shop and proof of proper layout, adequate equipment for the shop, sanitary conditions in the shop and good moral character.

rollCalls.title: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland
rollCalls.summary: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Clarkstown, county of Rockland for an additional year for 2026-2027.

rollCalls.title: Limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland
rollCalls.summary: Relates to limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland for 2026-2027.

rollCalls.title: Grants certain county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service beyond twenty-five years
rollCalls.summary: Grants Nassau county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service rendered beyond twenty-five years.

rollCalls.title: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain employees of the New York Power Authority
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for employees of the New York Power Authority with the job title of mechanic, technician, electrician, equipment operator, power plant operator, utility security officer, or lineperson.

rollCalls.title: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to disclose to residents and their families
rollCalls.summary: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Poughkeepsie
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Poughkeepsie; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.

rollCalls.title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Poughkeepsie
rollCalls.summary: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Poughkeepsie.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits motor vehicle manufacturers and dealers from charging a subscription fee for certain functions of a motor vehicle after the vehicle is sold; provides that any manufacturer, dealer, or agent of a manufacturer or dealer that fails to comply with such requirements shall be assessed a civil penalty not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars per point of sale for each violation.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the New York telecommunications relay service center
rollCalls.summary: Restructures the New York telecommunications relay service center as a state-wide workforce; extends provisions of law authorizing the establishment of such workforce from June 30, 2027 until June 30, 2030.

rollCalls.title: Relates to extending provisions relating to statutory installment bonds
rollCalls.summary: Relates to extending provisions relating to statutory installment bonds.

rollCalls.title: Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance
rollCalls.summary: Provides a sales tax exemption to any admission charge for a comedy performance including both scripted and unscripted.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of Southampton
rollCalls.summary: Increases the term of office from two years to four years for the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of Southampton, county of Suffolk, and providing for the staggering of such terms of office.

rollCalls.title: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers
rollCalls.summary: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers at no less than one hundred percent of the medical assistance durable medical equipment fee schedule for the same service or item.

rollCalls.title: Relates to disability benefits for certain individuals employed by the Nassau county police department
rollCalls.summary: Provides a performance of duty presumption for diseases of the heart for members who serve as an ambulance medical technician, ambulance medical coordinator, ambulance medical technician/supervisor or a member who performs ambulance medical technician related services, or a police medic, police medic coordinator, police medic supervisor, bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, assistant bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, or a member who performs police medic or police emergency ambulance related services and is employed in the Nassau county police department.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the impersonation of an employee organization or an employee representative
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits falsely impersonating an employee organization or an employee representative with the intent to deceive the recipient and thereby cause harm to such recipient or employee organization by the use of fraud, misrepresentation, material omission, or other deception in making and disseminating a verbal, written or electronic communication; provides that the attorney general may bring an action or proceeding to enjoin such unlawful acts or practices.

rollCalls.title: Relates to exempting disabled veterans from certain fees relating to physical modification of a residence to accommodate a disability
rollCalls.summary: Relates to exempting disabled veterans from application fees relating to physical modification of a residence to accommodate a disability, including permit fees, plan review fees, inspection fees and reinspection fees.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions relating to the sale, issuance and refund of bonds and notes of New York city
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to the sale of bonds and notes of the city of New York, the issuance of bonds or notes with variable rates of interest, interest rate exchange agreements of the city of New York, the refunding of bonds, and the down payment for projects financed by bonds; extends the New York state financial emergency act for the city of New York; makes further amendments relating to the effectiveness thereof.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions relating to installment loans and obligations evidencing installment loans
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to installment loans and obligations evidencing installment loans to 2029.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to refunding bonds
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to refunding bonds to 2029.

rollCalls.title: Requires utility corporations and municipalities to notify property owners prior to beginning any scheduled non-emergency construction or other work
rollCalls.summary: Requires a utility corporation or municipality to notify property owners at least five business days prior to beginning any non-emergency construction or other work that will result in a planned interruption of a customer's property; requires notice to include, but not be limited to, a description of the work to be performed, the expected duration of such work, the location of such work, and the contact information for the utility performing such work; exempts cases where a natural or man-made disaster or state of emergency occurs.

rollCalls.title: Requires the department of education to develop informational materials on type 1 diabetes to be made available to schools for distribution to parents and guardians of students
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of education, in consultation with the department of health, to develop informational materials on type 1 diabetes; requires such materials to be made available to schools providing elementary education through the department's website; requires schools to distribute such materials to parents and guardians of elementary school students and new students.

rollCalls.title: Relates to dedicating a portion of the state highway system in the hamlet of Uniondale to Jomani Wright
rollCalls.summary: Designates a portion of the state highway system in the hamlet of Uniondale to Jomani Wright.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling for members who first become members of a public retirement system of the state on or after April first, two thousand twelve.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Pelham
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Pelham; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2031.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "police radio transparency act"
rollCalls.summary: Requires that any law enforcement agency in the state that encrypts any portion of its radio communications shall ensure that all of its radio communications, with the exception of sensitive information, may be monitored in real time by professional journalists, newscasters, and individuals employed by emergency services organizations.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes early renewal of vehicle registration for members of the armed forces who will be engaged in the performance of their official military duties upon its expiration
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes early renewal of vehicle registration for members of the armed forces who will be engaged in the performance of their official military duties upon its expiration.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the determination of adjusted base proportions in special assessing units which are cities for fiscal year 2027.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the statewide group home families working group
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the statewide group home families working group; provides that duties include informing and advising the commissioner as to matters of importance for persons with developmental disabilities residing in group homes and their families and guardians, providing recommendations for statewide and regional priorities and goals for individuals residing in group homes and families and guardians of individuals residing in group homes, advising the commissioner on such other matters related to group homes as the statewide group home families working group deems relevant, holding regional public meetings to solicit and receive input from residents of group homes and family members and guardians of residents of group homes, and any matter relating to the performance of their duties with relation to individuals in group homes and on policies, Establishes the statewide group home families working group; provides that duties include informing and advising the commissioner as to matters of importance for persons with developmental disabilities residing in group homes and their families and guardians, providing recommendations for statewide and regional priorities and goals for individuals residing in group homes and families and guardians of individuals residing in group homes, advising the commissioner on such other matters related to group homes as the statewide group home families working group deems relevant, holding public meetings to solicit and receive input from residents of group homes and family members and guardians of residents of group homes, and any matter relating to the performance of their duties with relation to individuals in group homes and on policies, goals, budget and operation of group homes.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions of law relating to temporary investments by local governments
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of law relating to temporary investments by local governments.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions relating to physical therapy assistants
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to the provision of physical therapy assistant services by physical therapy assistants.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of chapter 435 of the laws of 2014 relating to defining spearguns and allowing recreational spearfishing in New York's marine and coastal waters
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to defining spearguns and allowing recreational spearfishing in New York's marine and coastal waters.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the special powers of the New York state environmental facilities corporation
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the special powers of the New York state environmental facilities corporation to 2029.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions related to the regulation of the amount of Jonah crabs that may be taken
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions related to the regulation of the amount of Jonah crabs that may be taken for an additional two years.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions relating to the establishment of the mercury thermostat collection act to January 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Requires an annual brownfields redevelopment tax credit report
rollCalls.summary: Requires an annual brownfields redevelopment tax credit report.

rollCalls.title: Relates to license fees required to be paid by wholesale beer licensees to sell cider
rollCalls.summary: Requires wholesale beer licensees to only need to pay a one time additional license fee to sell cider.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of authorizing big game hunting in Albany county
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions authorizing big game hunting in Albany county until October 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions relating to a Long Island deer management pilot program
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to a Long Island deer management pilot program for an additional 3 years.

rollCalls.title: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; authorizes funding of joint labor-management committees; implements agreements between the state and an employee organization; makes an appropriation therefor (Part A); provides for the salaries of certain state officers and employees excluded from collective negotiating units; makes an appropriation therefor (Part B).

rollCalls.title: Extends the expansion of eligibility for World Trade Center death and disability benefits for members of New York's organized militia
rollCalls.summary: Extends the expansion of eligibility for World Trade Center death and disability benefits for members of New York's organized militia for an additional four years.

rollCalls.title: Relates to extending the deadline for reduction in class size under contracts for excellence in a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants
rollCalls.summary: Extends the deadline for reduction in class size under contracts for excellence in a city school district in a city having a population of one million or more inhabitants.

rollCalls.title: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a school
rollCalls.summary: Relates to an exemption for certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a school.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the staffing and operations of a cancer research institute and a related not-for-profit corporation
rollCalls.summary: Transfers the Buffalo Division of Health Research, Inc. to the Roswell Park Cancer Research Corporation.

rollCalls.title: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county
rollCalls.summary: Increases the distribution of revenue from extending the authorization for the hotel and motel taxes in Suffolk county; provides for the support of a not-for-profit organization that manages and owns the first lighthouse built in New York, a national register of historic places site in Suffolk county that has been named a national historic landmark and is a New York state historic site.

rollCalls.title: Relates to increasing certain special accidental death benefits paid to widows and orphaned children of members
rollCalls.summary: Increases certain special accidental death benefits paid to a widow or widower or the children of a deceased member of the state and local retirement system.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to tickets to places of entertainment
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to tickets to places of entertainment.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the ability of the New York state medical care facilities finance agency to issue certain bonds and notes
rollCalls.summary: Increases the authorization of the Dormitory Authority of the State of New York ("DASNY"), as successor to the New York State Medical Care Facilities Finance Agency ("MCFFA") pursuant to the Health Care Financing Consolidation Act of 1995, to issue hospital and nursing home project bonds and notes from $20 billion to $21.8 billion.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the responsible data center development act
rollCalls.summary: Places a one year moratorium on the issuance of data center permits; requires utilities to establish an independent classification of service for large data centers; sets energy efficiency goals for data centers; provides for benefits for host communities; sets labor standards for the construction of data centers.

rollCalls.title: Enacts into law necessary legislation including extensions and technical corrections
rollCalls.summary: Extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part A); extends the duration of certain brownfield redevelopment and remediation tax credits with respect to a site located at 1800 Park Avenue (Part B); makes technical corrections relating to extending the term and authority of the independent monitor for the Orange county IDA (Part C); extends the demonstration project and workgroup to reduce the use of temporary staffing agencies in residential healthcare facilities for a fifth year, until December 31, 2027 (Part D); makes technical corrections to section 11-3206 of the administrative code of the city of New York (Part E); provides for the temporary transfer of racing support payments (Part F).

rollCalls.title: Requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "safer weapons, safer homes act"; requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms; defines personalized firearms; requires the division to report to the governor and the legislature on the results of the study.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the payment of restitution by registered and unregistered repair shops
rollCalls.summary: Establishes that if financial loss has been made and a registrant or unregistered repair shop fails to comply with an order to pay restitution, the commissioner shall, by order, increase the amount of the penalty assessed.

rollCalls.title: Requires the public service commission to consider the economic impact of utility rates and charges
rollCalls.summary: Requires consideration of evidence relating to the economic impact of major increases of rates or charges upon consumers and the areas affected by such increases of rates or charges prior to approval of any such rates or charges; establishes minimum data to be considered by the public service commission relating to such economic impact.

rollCalls.title: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a one through ten repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale
rollCalls.summary: Promotes consumer choice by requiring manufacturers of digital electronic equipment to provide retail sellers with a repair score that will be displayed to consumers at point of sale.

rollCalls.title: Allows certain physically disabled individuals to complete the live-fire range training course for a concealed carry license while sitting
rollCalls.summary: Allows physically disabled individuals who are not able to stand up to complete the two-hour live-fire range training course requirement for a concealed carry license while sitting.

rollCalls.title: Relates to setting integrated behavioral health services
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the commissioner of the office of mental health, and the office of addiction services and support to jointly establish a single set of licensing standards and requirements for the construction, operation, reporting and surveillance of integrated behavioral health services.

rollCalls.title: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry
rollCalls.summary: Revises the New York state veteran's memorial and monument registry such that it is easier to navigate; relates to the updating and availability of the registry.

rollCalls.title: Relates to proceedings for appointment of a guardian for personal needs or property management
rollCalls.summary: Enacts "Karilyn's law"; provides that the court set the date for proceedings relating to family visitation under a guardianship petition for not more than ten days from the signing of the order to show cause; provides that visitation shall be a rebuttable presumption.

rollCalls.title: Requires an annual report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult
rollCalls.summary: Requires a report on individuals who are the primary caregiver for an older adult, including the number of individuals who are primary caregivers for an older adult, the average age of a primary caregiver, the cost to an individual to provide care to an older adult, and the economic value and savings to the state of such individual's services.

rollCalls.title: Relates to addressing non-covered dental services
rollCalls.summary: Addresses non-covered dental services by requiring all policies providing coverage of and all contracts for dental services issued to include a disclosure stating that a participating provider may charge their normal fee for services that are not covered; requires a cost estimate to be provided.

rollCalls.title: Directs the New York State Department of Labor to establish a voluntary training and certification program for employers that have taken the Neurodiversity Training Pledge
rollCalls.summary: Directs the New York State Department of Labor to establish a voluntary training and certification program for employers entitled the Neurodiversity Training Pledge.

rollCalls.title: Designates security officers for the village court of the village of Pleasantville as peace officers
rollCalls.summary: Designates security officers for the village court of the village of Pleasantville as peace officers.

rollCalls.title: Grants security officers serving at the village of Ardsley village court peace officer status
rollCalls.summary: Grants security officers serving at the village of Ardsley village court peace officer status; provides that such officers shall complete training if they are not otherwise police officers or peace officers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the dissemination of information pertaining to Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia through the NY Connects: Choices for Long Term Care program
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the dissemination of information pertaining to individuals suffering from Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia through the NY Connects: Choices for Long Term Care program.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the taxation of vapor products
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the taxation of vapor products; provides for the licensing of vapor products distributors; imposes certain tax return filing requirements on vapor products distributors; provides for enforcement powers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring utility companies maintain a toll free number for reporting service outages
rollCalls.summary: Requires utility companies maintain a toll free number for consumers to call to report service outages which shall be made available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

rollCalls.title: Relates to training for school security guards
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "school security guard training enhancement act"; provides that annual training where a security guard is employed or contracted by a school in this state shall require the completion of school specific-training.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain security features and warning labels on baby monitors
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the manufacture, distribution, sale, or offering for sale of a baby monitor that broadcasts audio or video through an internet connection unless it includes certain security features to prevent unauthorized access; requires a written warning label; provides penalties.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program regarding qualifying water improvements, qualifying resiliency improvements and, in a city with a population of one million or more, the use of low carbon intensity building components.

rollCalls.title: Requires policies for the use of automatic license plate reader systems
rollCalls.summary: Requires the consumer protection division to promulgate a policy governing the use of automatic license plate reader systems by non-law enforcement agencies and non-government entities; requires such non-law enforcement agencies and non-government entities to conspicuously post such policy on their website or in their place of business.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Christopher Walser and Matthew Patire to each take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Christopher Walser and Matthew Patire to each take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and to each be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the village of Skaneateles police department.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the contents of emergency response plans required to be submitted to the public service commission by electric corporations; requires such plans to include details of staffing, equipment, and ability to perform toward certain standards; requires the public service commission to establish a time-based restoration schedule.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the establishment of a statewide supervised visitation initiative to support safe and structured parenting time
rollCalls.summary: Directs the office of victim services, in consultation with the office for the prevention of domestic violence, to establish a statewide supervised visitation initiative including culturally sensitive services that provide language access for those who need it and that are affordable for those with limited means to pay; requires the submission of regular assessments and reports.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the artificial intelligence training data transparency act requiring developers of generative artificial intelligence models or services to post on the developer's website information regarding the data used by the developer to train the generative artificial intelligence model or service, including a high-level summary of the datasets used in the development of such system or service.

rollCalls.title: Permits licensed insurance agents, brokers, adjusters, consultants, and intermediaries to carryover up to seven hours of continuing education credit per biennial licensing period
rollCalls.summary: Permits licensed insurance agents, brokers, adjusters, consultants, and intermediaries to carryover up to five hours of continuing education credit per biennial licensing period.

rollCalls.title: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts "the construction reporting pay act"; provides that each laborer, worker or mechanic in the employ of a contractor who by request or permission of an employer reports for work on any day shall be paid no less than four hours at the prevailing rate of wages.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the sale of playground surfacing materials that contain PFAS, PAHs or more than ninety parts per million of lead; and provides penalties for violations
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale of playground surfacing materials that contain PFAS, PAHs or lead; prevents sellers of playground surfacing materials that contain PFAS, PAHs or lead from being held in violation when relying in good faith on a certificate of compliance provided by the manufacturer; provides penalties for violations.

rollCalls.title: Provides additional support to children with complex needs under the jurisdiction of the state
rollCalls.summary: Provides additional support to children with complex needs under the jurisdiction of the state; requires data collection regarding children under the jurisdiction of the state.

rollCalls.title: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from seven to nine members
rollCalls.summary: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from a maximum of seven members to nine members.

rollCalls.title: Relates to workplace safety equipment for social services employees
rollCalls.summary: Requires every city or county social services district to provide a wearable or mobile phone-based panic button to each employee whose job responsibilities necessitate direct interaction with clients in a client's home.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain covered platforms to provide a process for law enforcement agencies to contact such platform, and to comply with search warrants within seventy-two hours
rollCalls.summary: Requires an operator of a covered platform with at least one million users to ensure that its covered platform provides a process to allow law enforcement agencies to contact such covered platform, which shall provide continuous availability of such process; provides that an operator of a covered platform with at least one million users shall comply with a search warrant within seventy-two hours of receipt under certain circumstances; provides that a court may extend the time for compliance with a search warrant under certain circumstances.

rollCalls.title: Creates a women veterans history trail
rollCalls.summary: Creates a women veterans history trail in order to recognize and celebrate the history of women in service.

rollCalls.title: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements
rollCalls.summary: Permits funds collected from the Oswego county occupancy tax to be used on making tourism related capital improvements; removes such tax on permanent residents.

rollCalls.title: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers
rollCalls.summary: Designates dog control officers of the village of Holley, named by the village board as constables, as peace officers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to access of certain information by the New York city department of investigation
rollCalls.summary: Lifts required approvals on the access of information pertaining to children by the New York city department of investigation.

rollCalls.title: Requires NYCHA to provide information and trainings to residents regarding resident management corporations
rollCalls.summary: Requires NYCHA to provide information and trainings to all residents regarding the formation of resident management corporations, the requirements of such resident management corporations and the potential benefits of creating such resident management corporations.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits insurance carriers and employers from withholding certain benefits from injured workers based on attachment to the labor market
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits insurance carriers and employers from withholding certain benefits from injured workers based on a claim that such workers have voluntarily withdrawn from the labor market by not seeking alternate employment that their injury or illness does not preclude them from performing.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the calculation of the maximum fee for health clubs
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the calculation of the maximum fee for health clubs; allows the maximum annual fee amount to be adjusted for inflation based upon the US Consumer Price Index.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "prevention of damage to critical infrastructure act of 2026"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "prevention of damage to critical infrastructure act"; prevents junk dealers and scrap processors from selling metals that are used by critical infrastructure providers; defines terms.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants test strip program
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services to establish a program for individuals to receive free drug test strips to detect the presence of medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants; directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services, in cooperation with the commissioner of the department of health, to develop and conduct a public awareness and educational campaign on the dangers of medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants.

rollCalls.title: Requires biannual certification of cooling towers
rollCalls.summary: Requires biannual certification of cooling towers; increases penalties for violations of such reporting requirements.

rollCalls.title: Permits requests for self-exclusion from gambling to be made electronically
rollCalls.summary: Requires that procedures for placements on, and removals from, the list of persons self-excluded from gambling includes procedures that allow a person to submit requests electronically; requires such procedures to ensure parity between electronic and non-electronic requests with respect to record retention and transmission of requests to licensed gaming facilities and mobile sports wagering platforms.

rollCalls.title: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines
rollCalls.summary: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines so long as such vaccination does not arise out of willful misconduct or gross negligence.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the retirement of state, county and municipal 911 operators and dispatchers
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain public safety dispatchers, public safety telecommunicators, 911 operators, communications officers, police communication technicians, emergency services operators and emergency services dispatchers employed by the state, or a county or municipal emergency services department.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of surveillance pricing, directly or indirectly; prohibits the collection, use, retention, or sharing of data to facilitate surveillance pricing; provides exceptions; provides for enforcement by the attorney general; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people
rollCalls.summary: Sets minimum staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people.

rollCalls.title: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use
rollCalls.summary: Requires covered businesses to annually report to the department of labor regarding the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use for the previous year; requires the department of labor to file an annual report on the impact of artificial intelligence on hiring and the nature of artificial intelligence use in the state; establishes penalties for covered business that fail to submit such reports.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to The New York Climate Exchange Inc. for the construction of facilities on Governor's Island.

rollCalls.title: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health
rollCalls.summary: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health.

rollCalls.title: Repeals a provision of the civil service law relating to resolutions of disputes in the course of collective negotiations with certain deputy sheriffs
rollCalls.summary: Repeals provisions relating to resolutions of disputes in the course of collective negotiations with certain deputy sheriffs to provide such deputy sheriffs with the same interest arbitration scope as municipal police officers.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of law relating to the operation of personal watercraft and specialty prop-craft.

rollCalls.title: Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for additional grants in aid for certain educational and not-for-profit institutions

Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2023-2024 fiscal year for services and expenses of human services and veterans community services organizations
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for additional grants in aid certain educational and not-for-profit institutions
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for certain appropriations for services and expenses of economic development and community services organizations
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for aid for services and expenses of human services and veterans community services organizations
Amending a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-26 state fiscal year for community adult and youth mental health programs and services
Amends a plan establishing itemized list of grantees for 2025-2026 providing community safety and restorative justice programs
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for additional grants in aid for services and expenses of senate priorities for housing initiatives
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for certain appropriations for services and expenses of economic development and community services organizations
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for additional grants in aid certain educational and not-for-profit institutions

Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-26 state fiscal year for services and expenses of human services and veterans community services organization
Amends a plan establishing itemized list of grantees for 2025-2026 providing community public health programs and services
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2026-27 state fiscal year for additional grants in aid to certain school districts, public libraries
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2026-27 state fiscal year for grants or reimbursement of certain expenses by local governments

Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2026-27 state fiscal year for services and expenses of human services and veterans community services organization
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for 2026-2027 providing Public Protection and Economic Development programs and services
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for 2026-2027 providing Public Health and Mental Health programs and services
Relates to determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the use of restoration services when determining the capacity of a defendant to stand trial.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Croton-on-Hudson
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Croton-on-Hudson; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2031.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Hamburg to extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include the village of Blasdell
rollCalls.summary: Provides that once the board of trustees of the village of Blasdell abolishes its fire department, the town of Hamburg may extend the Big Tree fire protection district to include such village.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Hicksville Water District to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Hicksville Water District to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status.

rollCalls.title: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers of the village of Dobbs Ferry in Westchester County
rollCalls.summary: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers of the village of Dobbs Ferry in Westchester County.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the Volunteer and Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association of Bethpage, Nassau county, New York, Inc.; changes "firemen" to "firefighters"; directs that certain taxes received shall be used by such benevolent association in furtherance of its purposes.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Amsterdam; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2031.

rollCalls.title: Relates to energy efficiency improvements and certain alterations to multiple dwellings
rollCalls.summary: Provides for energy efficiency improvements to certain windows; relates to certain alterations concerning windows and HVAC equipment in multiple dwellings.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the South End Children's Cafe to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the city of Albany assessor
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the South End Children's Cafe Inc. to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the city of Albany assessor for all applicable taxes from the 2025-2026 assessment rolls.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Hempstead to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a certain parcel of land located in the hamlet of West Hempstead
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Hempstead to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a certain parcel of land located in the hamlet of West Hempstead.

rollCalls.title: Broadens the court's discretion to use extended terms of interim probation on consent of the defendant to avoid incarceratory outcomes
rollCalls.summary: Broadens the court's discretion to use extended terms of interim probation on consent of the defendant to avoid incarceratory outcomes.

rollCalls.title: Establishes scholarship programs within the New York 529 program
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the comptroller, in consultation with the NYS higher education services corporation, to develop and administer a scholarship and savings program to provide a pathway for eligible children to save for education expenses.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the powers of the New York state housing finance agency
rollCalls.summary: Makes certain powers of the New York state housing finance agency permanent.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes pharmacists to dispense HIV pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes pharmacists to dispense HIV pre-exposure and post-exposure prophylaxis.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to amortize over a period of 20 years, the payments made to village employees upon separation from employment
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of Hempstead, in the county of Nassau, to amortize over a period of 20 years, the payments made to village employees upon separation from employment.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
rollCalls.summary: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises in the county of Greene.

rollCalls.title: Provides notice regarding the timeliness of the receipt by the board of elections of ballots capable of return by mail
rollCalls.summary: Provides notice regarding the timeliness of the receipt by the board of elections of ballots capable of return by mail to advise voters that such ballot should be returned to the board of elections as soon as possible by any approved method, and further recommend the use of alternative methods of return besides domestic mail services if the voter will be returning their ballot within several days of the election.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain powers of the attorney general
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the denial of access to certain public records which relate to civil investigations; relates to the enforcement powers of the attorney general; authorizes the attorney general to investigate and bring any civil action addressing repeated or persistent discrimination in elementary and secondary schools; requires the compromise of any claim which the state may have for care, maintenance or treatment furnished in hospitals or other such facilities to be made accordance with parameters established by the office of the attorney general; allows the commissioner of health to waive bills or compromise bills for the maintenance, care and treatment furnished to patients in medical facilities upon the prior approval of the comptroller alone.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Cong Kehal Square of Roman to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Cong Kehal Square of Roman to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2024 assessment roll and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Lakeview Fire District
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from the Lakeview Fire District with respect to the 2025-2026 assessment roll for a portion of the 2025-2026 school taxes and a portion of the 2026 general taxes.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Greenburgh to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parkland and to lease such land to HESP Solar LLC for a term not to exceed twenty-five years.

rollCalls.title: Provides dormitory authority financing for construction of buildings to be used as a school for Yeshiva Ohr Yoseph
rollCalls.summary: Provides dormitory authority financing for construction of buildings to be used as a school for Yeshiva Ohr Yoseph.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a highway safety corridor on the Southern State Parkway
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a highway safety corridor on the Southern State Parkway between exit seventeen and exit thirty-one; provides for enhanced traffic enforcement and a reporting requirement.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Freeport Bible Center to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the village of Freeport assessor
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Freeport Bible Center to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor for all applicable taxes from the 2026 assessment roll.

rollCalls.title: Relates to judicial districts
rollCalls.summary: Provides that in the fourth judicial department, three new districts, fourteen, fifteen and sixteen are added; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes where the victim is under the influence of any drug, intoxicant, or other substance to a degree which rendered the victim temporarily incapable of appraising or controlling such person's conduct and such condition was known or reasonably should have been known to a person in the actor's situation.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the use of smart access systems and the information that may be gathered from such systems
rollCalls.summary: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the form of submission and abstract for proposed amendments to the constitution
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the form of submission and abstract for proposed amendments to the constitution submitted to the people to be determined by enactment in a separate joint resolution passed by both houses of the legislature at least 120 days prior to the general election where such amendment to the constitution shall be submitted.

rollCalls.title: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Relates to labor peace agreements and the cannabis industry wage board.

rollCalls.title: Implements an agreement between the state and an employee organization; providing for the adjustment of salaries of certain incumbents in the professional service in the state university; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Implements an agreement between the state and an employee organization; provides for the adjustment of salaries of certain incumbents in the professional service in the state university; makes an appropriation for the purpose of effectuating certain provisions thereof.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the compensation, benefits and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; implements the agreements between the state and the public employees federation.

rollCalls.title: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses
rollCalls.summary: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses.

rollCalls.title: Relates to electronic appearances for parking violations
rollCalls.summary: Provides that persons charged with a parking violation shall be able to make an electronic court appearance unless a locality elects not to permit electronic appearances.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits naming dependent children under the age of 18 in petitions to recover possession of real property and eviction warrants
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits naming dependent children under the age of 18 living in the same household with a parent or guardian in petitions to recover possession of real property and eviction warrants; seals any records pertaining to dependent children under the age of 18 living in the same household with a parent or guardian who were residing on or removed from such property.

rollCalls.title: Increases short-term disability benefits
rollCalls.summary: Increases short-term disability benefits.

rollCalls.title: Relates to cost sharing fees for outpatient treatment at a substance use treatment program
rollCalls.summary: Provides that for a substance use disorder outpatient treatment episode of care by a provider licensed, certified or otherwise authorized by the office of addiction services and supports, an insured shall only be responsible for a cost sharing fee not to exceed two hundred fifty dollars.

rollCalls.title: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing the "340B prescription drug anti-discrimination act"
rollCalls.summary: Relates to establishing the "340B prescription drug anti-discrimination act"; prohibits pharmaceutical manufacturers and pharmacy benefit managers from discriminating against covered entities and New York state pharmacies based on participation in the drug discount program authorized by section 340B of the federal public health service act.

rollCalls.title: Restores medical futility as a basis for DNR
rollCalls.summary: Restores medical futility as a basis for DNR.

rollCalls.title: Relates to child care assistance under the child care block grant
rollCalls.summary: Provides that a caregiver may be eligible for assistance for child care under the child care block grant regardless of the hours the parent actually works.

rollCalls.title: Relates to preventing certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Prevents certain elected officials from being a member of an agency or industrial development authority.

rollCalls.title: Creates a small business grid renewable energy tax credit
rollCalls.summary: Creates a small business renewable tax credit; provides the term "business related renewable energy usage" shall refer to renewable power usage used to further the economic activity of the taxpayer at the primary business location that is clearly delimited from any shared renewable energy power usage cost.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature; allows the formation of a subsidiary of a public authority without prior approval of the legislature if such public authority files a written notice sixty days prior to the organization of such subsidiary with the governor and the legislature.

rollCalls.title: Designates the Scajaquada pedestrian bridge as the "9.11 Heroes Bridge"
rollCalls.summary: Designates the Scajaquada pedestrian bridge as the "9.11 Heroes Bridge".

rollCalls.title: Makes conforming changes reflecting the previously authorized scope of practice of nurse practitioners
rollCalls.summary: Makes conforming changes reflecting the previously authorized scope of practice of nurse practitioners; adds nurse practitioners as persons who can authorize or make certain determinations authorized to be made or determined by physicians.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children; requires kindergarten in certain school districts.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Medicaid coverage for the complex care assistant program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a program for specific individuals to become complex care assistants and provide private duty nursing services to certain Medicaid enrollees.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Christine Hasseler to apply for a recalculation of her retirement benefits
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Christine Hasseler to apply for a recalculation of her retirement benefits.

rollCalls.title: Provides remedies for disrupted elections
rollCalls.summary: Provides remedies for disrupted voting times and locations during elections; directs that the BOE extend voting to account for the disruption.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the geographic area of employment of state university police officers, centralization of the state university police, and hiring of state university police officers; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Expands the geographic area of employment of state university police officers; centralizes the state university police by appointing a commissioner of state university police; provides for the hiring of state university police officers.

rollCalls.title: Establishes an operation SNUG program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an "operation SNUG" program within the division of criminal justice services which provides grant awards to reduce, prevent or respond to gun violence.

rollCalls.title: Requires health insurance contracts cover postpartum pelvic floor therapy
rollCalls.summary: Requires health insurance contracts cover postpartum pelvic floor therapy for new mothers.

rollCalls.title: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data
rollCalls.summary: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data for incarcerated individuals in medication assisted treatment programs.

rollCalls.title: Requires elections and terms of certain officials occur on even-numbered years except in the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain elections take place in even-numbered years for certain municipal and judicial officials except in the city of New York.

rollCalls.title: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation, and department of transportation about certain freight rail trains
rollCalls.summary: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation and department of transportation about freight rail trains transporting hazardous materials prior to traveling on tracks within the state.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for fire marshals I or supervisors of such title in Suffolk county
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for fire marshals I and supervisors of such title in Suffolk county.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent prescription substance use disorder
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent prescription substance use disorder.

rollCalls.title: Establishes "Kyra's Law"
rollCalls.summary: Requires the court to consider a child's health and safety when making a decision regarding child custody and visitation; directs the court to review certain information as it relates to allegations of child abuse, domestic violence and child safety.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the city of Buffalo, in Erie County, to the Fallen Skywalkers.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes camp operators and employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children under certain circumstances
rollCalls.summary: Allows camp employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children, under parent or guardian consent and authorization, pursuant to a patient specific order and in compliance with regulations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to issuing the village of Nelliston incorporation documents
rollCalls.summary: Directs the secretary of State to issue to the village of Nelliston in the Town of Palatine, Montgomery county, a certificate of incorporation verifying the status of the village of Nelliston as incorporated as a village since 1878.

rollCalls.title: Allows students attending agricultural learning events to be counted as in attendance at school
rollCalls.summary: Allows students attending agricultural learning events to be counted as in attendance at school; defines "agricultural learning events" as including FFA events and 4-H programs.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring Medicaid to cover a wearable medical device to treat certain forms of cancer
rollCalls.summary: Requires Medicaid to cover a wearable medical device that uses low-intensity, alternating electric fields delivered to the tumor site to treat glioblastoma and other cancers as recommended by medical and scientific evidence.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the transitional pathway program for students in higher education with autism spectrum disorder
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the transitional pathway program for students in higher education at SUNY and CUNY schools with autism spectrum disorder to encourage accessibility and inclusivity in higher education for students with autism spectrum disorder; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act and requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the New York dignity in pregnancy and childbirth act; requires hospitals and other facilities that provide perinatal care to implement an evidence-based implicit bias program for all health care providers involved in the perinatal care of patients within those facilities; requires the department of health to publish reports on maternal morbidity and pregnancy related deaths.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits octopus farming
rollCalls.summary: Provides that no person shall engage in the operation of a marine hatchery or in the off-bottom or on-bottom culture of any species belonging to the order Octopoda unless for scientific or educational purposes for the purpose of human consumption.

rollCalls.title: Relates to demonstration programs imposing monetary liability on the owner of a vehicle for failure of an operator thereof to comply with certain posted maximum speed limits in the town of Yorktown
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Yorktown, Westchester county, shall have the ability to install and operate photo speed violation monitoring systems within construction or maintenance work areas that fall within the border or jurisdiction of such municipality; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings; authorizes utility companies or municipalities to commence an action against the owner of the premises affected to seek the appointment of a receiver of rents or payments for use and occupancy or common charges.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the number and duties of assistant principals to be assigned to school districts in the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the number and duties of assistant principals to be assigned to school districts in the city of New York.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the authority of Plandome Manor to enter into contracts to sell delinquent tax liens
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the authority of the village of Plandome Manor to enter into contracts to sell delinquent tax liens or to pledge such liens as collateral for a loan.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the green jobs-green New York program
rollCalls.summary: Relates to on-bill recovery loan agreements executed under the green jobs-green New York program.

rollCalls.title: Relates to procedures for issuing safety and health rules
rollCalls.summary: Removes certain provisions regarding public hearing and notice requirements prior to issuing safety and health rules, and notice requirements after issuing safety and health rules.

rollCalls.title: Relates to authorization of treatment under workers' compensation for certain providers; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Relates to authorization of treatment under workers' compensation for care and treatment of injured employees by podiatrists, chiropractors and psychologists; repeals certain provisions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to campaign contributions by certain vendors
rollCalls.summary: Relates to campaign contributions by certain vendors for procurement contracts.

rollCalls.title: Relates to interest on unclaimed child and spousal support payments
rollCalls.summary: Relates to interest on unclaimed child and spousal support payments by the owner of abandoned properties.

rollCalls.title: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct an analysis of the financial stability of the check cashing industry and review the current system of licensing for such industry
rollCalls.summary: Directs the superintendent of financial services to conduct an analysis of the financial stability of the check cashing industry and review the current system of licensing for such industry and issue reports on both topics.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the administration of reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the administration of reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections; provides that no pharmacist shall administer reversible progestin-only contraceptive injections without receiving training satisfactory to the commissioner of education and the commissioner of health.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing protest procedures on contracts rewarded by state agencies
rollCalls.summary: Relates to establishing protest procedures on contracts rewarded by state agencies and how such protests may be resolved.

rollCalls.title: Relates to sanctions with regard to to substantiated reports of abuse or neglect which are no longer subject to amendment or appeal
rollCalls.summary: Relates to sanctions by the office of the Medicaid inspector general with regard to substantiated reports of abuse or neglect which are no longer subject to amendment or appeal.

rollCalls.title: Relates to notices of violation returnable to a parking violations bureau in a city with a population of one million or more
rollCalls.summary: Relates to notices of violation returnable to a parking violations bureau in a city with a population of one million or more; provides that in a city with a population of one million persons or more, if such notice is served upon the operator of a vehicle that has no such registration plate or if such registration plate is concealed or obscured, the vehicle identification number may be inserted in such notice in place of the plate designation and plate type.

rollCalls.title: Prevents discrimination by insurers based on an individual's mental health or substance use disorder
rollCalls.summary: Prevents discrimination by insurers based on an individual's mental health or substance use disorder; incorporates into law federal enforcement rules set forth in the federal mental health parity and addiction equity act of 2008.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the "Maternal Health, Dignity and Consent act"
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits drug, cannabis or alcohol testing of pregnant or postpartum individuals and newborns unless the individual consents and it is within the scope of medical care, or the testing is necessary for a medical emergency.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "New York fundamental artificial intelligence requirements in (FAIR) news act"; provides transparency requirements for news media content composed, authored, or otherwise created through generative AI.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the residency requirement for the St. Lawrence county public health director and community services director
rollCalls.summary: Exempts persons holding the offices of public health director and director of community services of St. Lawrence county from the requirement that such person be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state for which such person shall be chosen or within which such person's official functions are required to be exercised.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "victims protection and child sex buyer accountability act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "victims protection and child sex buyer accountability act" relating to increasing the age of victims of the patronizing, promoting, and compelling of prostitution.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the "protecting consumers and jobs from discriminatory pricing act"
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of electronic shelving labels, digital shelf display technology, and surveillance pricing in food retail establishments and drug retail establishments; provides injunctive relief and civil penalties.

rollCalls.title: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Provides for expanded non-medical in-home services, non-institutional respite services, case management services, and ancillary services without a prescription or physician's order; repeals certain cost sharing requirements for such services.

rollCalls.title: Relates to optional disability coverage for county probation officers
rollCalls.summary: Provides optional disability coverage for county probation officers.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the NY digital choice act requiring social media companies to provide covered users with a copy of the covered user's social graph at the request of the covered user
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the NY digital choice act requiring social media companies to provide covered users with a copy of the covered user's social graph at the request of the covered user; defines terms; provides requirements for the interoperability of covered users' data; grants the attorney general the authority to promulgate rules and regulations and enforce such provisions.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the county of Putnam to lease certain lands used as parklands in the town of Carmel for use as a cell tower for thirty years.

rollCalls.title: Relates to commuter passes on the New York state thruway in the Syracuse area
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the New York state thruway authority to issue annual short distance commuter permits which shall provide for travel at no charge between interchanges in permit areas.

rollCalls.title: Relates to limiting audit and review of certain medical assistance program funds
rollCalls.summary: Limits the reimbursement amount of certain overpayment claims and reviews where such overpayment was due to the provider's submission of records which were not in accordance with program requirements at the time but which were in accordance with current requirements as a result of changes to guidelines or regulations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions
rollCalls.summary: Relates to providing information to patients and the public on hospital rule-based exclusions; requires the commissioner of health to collect from each hospital a list of its hospital rule-based exclusions and publish such information on the department's website.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes a plaintiff commencing an action alleging conduct constituting a sexual offense or a civil offense involving the transmission of HIV shall have the right to proceed anonymously
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a plaintiff commencing an action alleging conduct constituting a sexual offense or a civil offense involving the transmission of the human immunodeficiency virus shall have the right to proceed anonymously.

rollCalls.title: Includes public officers or employees of the federal government within the definition of public servant
rollCalls.summary: Includes public officers or employees of the federal government within the definition of public servant for purposes of the penal law.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits artificial intelligence companions from using features which are considered unsafe for minors
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits artificial intelligence companions from using features which are considered unsafe for minors; defines terms; specifies what are considered unsafe features.

rollCalls.title: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system
rollCalls.summary: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system.

rollCalls.title: Relates to liability insurance for voluntary foster care agencies
rollCalls.summary: Establishes participation in assigned risk plans for voluntary foster care agencies (Part A); requires the office of children and family services to establish standards of payment for liability insurance costs beginning July 1, 2028 for the 2027-2028 rate year that ensures the maximum state aid rate accurately reflect the year over year increased costs for voluntary foster care agencies; directs such office to establish an application process (Part B); establishes the voluntary foster care agency insurance bridge fund; establishes a process for the distribution of moneys in such fund; sets eligibility requirements; requires certain supporting documentation (Part C).

rollCalls.title: Relates to the management of PFAS in biosolids
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the management of PFAS in biosolids in the state by requiring testing and reporting of certain groundwater, biosolids, and soil and establishing a moratorium on the sale and use of biosolids; establishes the PFAS agricultural response program and fund to assist farms found to have levels of PFAS contamination which exceed regulatory standards.

rollCalls.title: Enacts "India's law"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts "India's law" under which an incarcerated individual's next of kin shall be notified and allowed visitation by a local correctional facility when such individual is experiencing a serious medical event or demonstrating behavior that is likely to result in serious harm to themselves or others.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a death benefit option for the wife of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a death benefit option for the beneficiary of deceased justice Jerry Garguilo, a justice of the unified court system.

rollCalls.title: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate
rollCalls.summary: Creates the state office of the utility consumer advocate to represent interests of residential utility customers including a proposed change of rates, charges, terms and conditions of service, the adoption of rules, regulations, guidelines, orders, standards or final policy decisions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to interest earned on the statewide opioid settlement agreement money
rollCalls.summary: Includes interest earned on the monies obtained by the state through the statewide opioid settlement agreement, in the opioid settlement fund; requires any New York subdivision that receives funds pursuant to an opioid settlement agreement to spend interest earned on such funds on approved uses.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a real property tax exemption for certain property owners who reside full-time on such property in certain counties
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a real property tax exemption for certain property owners who reside full-time on such property in certain counties; requires that such owners occupy such property as their primary residence and are enrolled in or eligible for the STAR exemption or credit or that such owners rent to a tenant for a term of at least twelve months and such tenant occupies such property as their primary residence.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the New York state park police
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the New York state park police under the jurisdiction of the commissioner of parks, recreation and historic preservation.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a publicly available database of business entities in the state that enter into procurement contracts with procuring entities in the state
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a publicly available database of business entities in the state that enter into procurement contracts with procuring entities in the state; requires such database to include, among other things, the name of the business entity, the current business street address and county associated with each business street address, and the full name of each beneficial owner.

rollCalls.title: Provides a reduction in insurance premium charges for insured volunteer firefighters and emergency personnel
