rollCalls.summary: Provides a reduction in insurance premium charges for insured volunteer firefighters and emergency personnel for a 3 year period after successfully completing the emergency vehicle operator's course as part of their training.

rollCalls.title: Relates to centralized contracts for services
rollCalls.summary: Amends provisions of law from making it mandatory to optional that where the purchase of services by state agencies be conducted in a manner that accords second priority to centralized contracts meeting form, function and utility required by such agency, third priority to agency or multi-agency contracts and fourth priority to other means of contracting.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to accept certain documentation issued to veterans of the military as acceptable proofs of identity when applying for a driver license or state identification card
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the department of motor vehicles to accept a certificate of release or discharge from active duty issued by the United States department of defense (DD form 214), a veteran identification card issued by the United States department of veterans affairs, or a veterans health identification card issued by the United States department of veterans affairs from veterans of the military as acceptable proofs of identity when applying for a driver license or state identification card.

rollCalls.title: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and findings thereon
rollCalls.summary: Provides that arbitration awards in consumer and employment disputes, where the arbitration is conducted pursuant to a contract, shall include all issues in dispute and the arbitrator's findings of fact and conclusions of law.

rollCalls.title: Requires landlords in the city of New York to provide fire extinguishers in certain dwellings
rollCalls.summary: Requires landlords of non-owner occupied, one-six family dwellings in the city of New York to provide fire extinguishers in all rented apartments; authorizes the promulgation of standards related thereto.

rollCalls.title: Allows Steven Kobie Jackson to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the town of Woodstock police department
rollCalls.summary: Allows Steven Kobie Jackson to be eligible to take the civil service exam for the position of police officer for the town of Woodstock police department.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Civil War veteran John B. Nicholas
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system including the bridge on state route five hundred thirty-one, crossing over route two hundred fifty-nine, otherwise known as, South Union Street, in the town of Ogden, county of Monroe, to Civil War Veteran John B. Nichols.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Ithaca; repeals authorization of such program on December 31, 2030.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the operation of N.Y. city transit authority subways or trains without a conductor on board
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the operation of NYC transit authority subways or trains without at least one conductor on board except where it is currently permissible.

rollCalls.title: Relates to appropriations to the Barker central school district following the cessation of operations of an electric generating facility located within such district
rollCalls.summary: Relates to appropriations to the Barker central school district following the cessation of operations of an electric generating facility located within such district; permits awards for a period of ten years for the loss of tax revenue.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Edward "Red" Corrigan
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a bridge on state route 112 over state route 27 to Edward "Red" Corrigan in the town of Patchogue, county of Suffolk.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the block by block homeownership program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the block by block homeownership program to provide capital subsidies for the purpose of constructing, preserving, and rehabilitating one- to two- family dwellings throughout the state, outside of NYC.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the transfer of funds from the tuition reimbursement account
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the transfer of funds from the tuition reimbursement account to the proprietary vocational school supervision account in the event that the net balance of the tuition reimbursement account is in excess of two million five hundred thousand dollars.

rollCalls.title: Relates to caregiver requirements for certain day care homes
rollCalls.summary: Requires one caregiver for every two children under eighteen months of age in group family day care homes and family day care homes.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certifying instructors in small arms practice
rollCalls.summary: Relates to certifying instructors in small arms practice; provides that after December 31, 2028 individuals certified as an instructor in small arms practice shall seek recertification subject to the standards and curriculum promulgated by the division of criminal justice services.

rollCalls.title: Relates to remedies for unlawful discharge or discrimination for the exercise of an employee's right to be absent from employment for jury duty
rollCalls.summary: Creates, in addition to the existing sanction of criminal contempt of court, the remedies of labor law civil penalties and employee's right to bring civil action for unlawful discharge, penalty or discrimination on account of the exercise by an employee of a juror's right to be absent from employment by reason of jury service.

rollCalls.title: Requires insurers to deposit certain funds into the reproductive health care access fund; and establishes the reproductive health care access fund
rollCalls.summary: Requires insurance companies to deposit a certain percentage of premiums collected but not paid out in prior years for abortion care to the reproductive health care access fund for use for grants under the reproductive freedom and equity grant program; establishes the reproductive health care access fund; relates to the use of funds under the reproductive freedom and equity grant program; directs the governor to provide for funding in the state budget.

rollCalls.title: Amends the definition of mental health care provider for purposes of sex offenses
rollCalls.summary: Amends the definition of mental health care provider for purposes of sex offenses to include persons who are, or are required to be, licensed or registered or holds themselves out to be licensed or registered, or provides services as if they were licensed or registered as a physician, psychologist, professional nurse, clinical social worker, master social worker under the supervision of a physician, psychologist or licensed clinical social worker, licensed mental health counselor or a licensed marriage and family therapist.

rollCalls.title: Automated identification of eligible participants for the Medicare savings program
rollCalls.summary: Identifies and enrolls SNAP program participants who are eligible for the Medicare savings program.

rollCalls.title: Requires the office of children and family services to notify child day care providers of updates on any forms listed on their website
rollCalls.summary: Directs the office of children and family services to provide written and electronic notice to child day care providers whenever such office has updated any form necessary for the delivery of services listed on its website; provides that such notice shall be disseminated in concurrence with the publication of updated forms.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the vacant rental improvement program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the vacant rental improvement program to provide grants of up to $75,000 per unit to owners of buildings with five or fewer units.

rollCalls.title: Requires general hospitals and nursing homes to offer free notarial services to patients
rollCalls.summary: Requires general hospitals and nursing homes to offer free notarial services to patients; requires an employee of such general hospital or nursing home who is a notary public to be present from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on business days.

rollCalls.title: Relates to moneys to be credited to the general account of the unemployment insurance fund
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that moneys credited to the state pursuant to section nine hundred one of the federal social security act are to be credited to the general account of the unemployment insurance fund.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the effective date of a reclassification for an accidental disability retirement benefit
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the effective date of a reclassification for an accidental disability retirement benefit for applications filed on or after January 1, 2027.

rollCalls.title: Relates to access to certain confidential records in criminal actions or proceedings
rollCalls.summary: Relates to access to certain confidential records upon the termination of a criminal action in favor of the accused.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Kurt Nolan to receive certain credit under sections 384-d and 384-e of the retirement and social security law for prior employment with the New York state university police.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Tovas Dovid Community Kollel, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024 and 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide for a specific period of time
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes licensees to remain open for extended hours of operation statewide between June 11 and July 20, 2026.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of the authority of the town of Red Hook to impose real estate transfer taxes and to deposit revenue from such taxes into a community preservation fund
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of the authority of the town of Red Hook to impose real estate transfer taxes and to deposit revenue from such taxes into a community preservation fund.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the low impact landscaping rights act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the low impact landscaping rights act, preventing homeowners' associations from adopting or enforcing any rules or regulations that would effectively prohibit, or impose unreasonable limitations on, the installation or maintenance of low impact landscaping.

rollCalls.title: Requires utilities accept public assistance payments
rollCalls.summary: Requires utilities accept public assistance payments including payments from the home energy assistance programs and emergency funding programs.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits insurance discrimination on the basis of an insured's marital status following the death of the insured's spouse
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits insurance discrimination on the basis of an insured's marital status following the death of the insured's spouse.

rollCalls.title: Requires residential health care facilities to maintain hospice agreements to ensure access to hospice services for eligible residents
rollCalls.summary: Requires residential health care facilities to maintain hospice agreements to ensure access to hospice services for eligible residents.

rollCalls.title: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by St. Joseph's Health Hospital, North Medical Center and Northeast Medical Center
rollCalls.summary: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by St. Joseph's Health Hospital, North Medical Center and Northeast Medical Center when acting pursuant to their special duties on the grounds or premises owned, controlled or administered by any such hospital or any of its subsidiaries.

rollCalls.title: Phases out certain mandatory university fees for certain graduate students and adjunct staff
rollCalls.summary: Provides that beginning in the 2026-2027 academic year, certain graduate students shall be required to pay 25% of all current and future mandatory university fees; provides that in the 2027-2028 academic year and thereafter, no mandatory university fees shall be charged to certain graduate students and adjunct staff, with the exclusion of the graduate student association student activity fee.

rollCalls.title: Extends the time for New York city marshals to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs with respect to the execution of money judgments
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to authorizing New York city marshals to exercise the same functions, powers and duties as sheriffs with respect to the execution of money judgments of the supreme and family courts of the city of New York; extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring New York city marshals to post and electronically file notices of eviction.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes and directs the conveyance of a conservation easement over certain state-owned lands in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, Suffolk County
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of transportation to grant a perpetual conservation easement to certain entities over certain state-owned lands in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, Suffolk County.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to supermarkets providing excess edible food to food relief organizations to 12/31/2031.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions relating to the repair of damaged pesticide containers
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to the repair of damaged pesticide containers.

rollCalls.title: Provides that certain members of the United States Air Force Auxiliary Civil Air Patrol or the United States Coast Guard Auxiliary Pilots shall be granted leave from work with pay for air force assigned missions
rollCalls.summary: Provides that public officers and employees of the state who are members of the United States Air Force Auxiliary Civil Air Patrol or the United States Coast Guard Auxiliary Pilots shall be granted leave from work with pay to participate in emergency services during certain air force assigned missions.

rollCalls.title: Clarifies who may sue an insurer for violations related to misrepresentations, misleading statements and incomplete comparisons
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies that residents of the state and any policyholder, contract holder, certificate holder, or beneficiary of a policy, contract, or certificate of life, accident and health insurance may sue an insurer for violations related to misrepresentations, misleading statements and incomplete comparisons.

rollCalls.title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Ithaca
rollCalls.summary: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Ithaca.

rollCalls.title: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by Albany Memorial Hospital, Samaritan Hospital, and St. Peter's Hospital
rollCalls.summary: Grants peace officer status to security officers employed by Albany Memorial Hospital, Samaritan Hospital, and St. Peter's Hospital when acting pursuant to their special duties on the grounds or premises owned, controlled or administered by any such hospital or any of its subsidiaries.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Lewisboro, county of Westchester, to Nathaniel Reynolds
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting state route thirty-five, beginning at its intersection with state route one hundred twenty-one and continuing to its intersection with North Salem road, in the town of Lewisboro, county of Westchester, to Nathaniel Reynolds.

rollCalls.title: Relates to digital advertisements for insurance agents and brokers
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the requirement for advertisements referring to an insurer to include the insurer's full name and principal office shall not apply to digital advertisements.

rollCalls.title: Relates to deer management permits; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the issuance of deer management permits in the northern zone of the state.

rollCalls.title: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza
rollCalls.summary: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza; requires the governor to choose the new agency building names within 60 days after the council's recommendation.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage Atlantic bonito and false albacore
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage Atlantic bonito and false albacore.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the definition of tidal wetlands
rollCalls.summary: Specifies the marine and coastal district as part of the definition of tidal wetlands.

rollCalls.title: Imposes standards for certain examination services
rollCalls.summary: Imposes standards for certain examination services for insurance agents.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the handling of certain unclaimed human remains
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits unclaimed human remains from being buried, cremated, or otherwise finally disposed of unless such remains have first been entered into the National Missing and Unidentified Persons System, and for a period of time thereafter as specified by the commissioner of health.

rollCalls.title: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage Atlantic Cod
rollCalls.summary: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage Atlantic Cod.

rollCalls.title: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage black sea bass
rollCalls.summary: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage black sea bass.

rollCalls.title: Relates to pilotage fees on vessels transiting the New York state waters of Long Island Sound or Block Island Sound east of Execution Rocks or Sands Point
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a new system of pilotage fees for the Long Island Sound and Block Island Sound east of Execution Rocks or Sands Point.

rollCalls.title: Permits the Vestal Central School District to create an insurance reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Permits the Vestal Central School District to create an insurance reserve fund.

rollCalls.title: Exempts the Liverpool Fire Department from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the Liverpool Fire Department within the town of Salina, Onondaga county, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
rollCalls.summary: Allows the state liquor authority to issue a retail license for on-premises consumption for a premises which shall be located within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues therefrom to be deposited in the community preservation fund; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain deadlines for purposes of the green roof tax abatement for certain properties in a city of one million or more persons
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain deadlines for purposes of the green roof tax abatement for certain properties in a city of one million or more persons.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the New York travel insurance act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "New York travel insurance act" regulating the licensing and registration of limited lines travel insurance producers and travel retailers, and the sale and marketing of travel insurance and related products.

rollCalls.title: Relates to commercial food fish licenses
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the issuance of commercial food fish licenses.

rollCalls.title: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a place of worship
rollCalls.summary: Exempts certain property within Manhattan in the city of New York from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a building occupied exclusively as a school or place of worship.

rollCalls.title: Exempts certain property in the village of Lake Placid from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
rollCalls.summary: Exempts certain property in the village of Lake Placid, town of North Elba, from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church.

rollCalls.title: Expands what qualifies as an authorized project for the "county of Westchester public works investment act"
rollCalls.summary: Expands what qualifies as an authorized project for the "county of Westchester public works investment act" to include replacing certain bridges.

rollCalls.title: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority to develop recommendations regarding the establishment of microgrids
rollCalls.summary: Requires the New York state energy research and development authority to develop recommendations regarding the establishment of microgrids.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the cesarean births review board
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the cesarean births review board; provides such board shall be comprised of multidisciplinary experts to review the rate of cesarean births at hospitals in the state; provides reporting requirements.

rollCalls.title: Provides an exemption from certain requirements for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
rollCalls.summary: Provides an exemption from certain requirements for a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises located in Orange county.

rollCalls.title: Grants peace officer status to uniformed court officers in the town of Montgomery
rollCalls.summary: Grants peace officer status to employees of the town court of the town of Montgomery serving as uniformed court officers at such town court.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the definition of family for purposes of services provided by voluntary foster care agency health facilities
rollCalls.summary: Includes both the birth family and the foster family of children in foster care, and other families receiving child welfare services from the authorized agency or the local departments of social services in the case of authorized agencies in the definition of family for purposes of services provided by voluntary foster care agency health facilities.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits insurers from refusing to renew a policy on certain automobiles used for volunteer social service transportation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits insurers from refusing to renew a policy on certain automobiles used for volunteer social service transportation.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the psychology interjurisdictional compact
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the psychology interjurisdictional compact to increase public access to psychological services by allowing telepsychological practice and temporary in-person services across state lines.

rollCalls.title: Grants peace officer status to certain security officers employed by Highland Hospital
rollCalls.summary: Grants peace officer status to certain security officers employed by Highland Hospital; provides such peace officers are not authorized to carry, possess, repair or dispose of a firearm.

rollCalls.title: Requires third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide the ability to include a gratuity at the same point in the online order process when the underlying order is placed
rollCalls.summary: Requires third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services to provide the ability to include a gratuity at the same point in the online order process when the underlying order is placed; provides that customers shall not be required to pay a gratuity; provides that third-party food delivery services and third-party grocery delivery services shall not reduce the compensation of any worker as a result of gratuities; establishes penalties for violations of such provisions.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Port Authority Police Officer Arthur M. Ansert Jr.
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system including the bridge on the South Service Road, between Federal Circle and Perimeter Road Overpass, crossing over the Van Wyck Expressway in Jamaica to Port Authority Police Officer Arthur M. Ansert Jr.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "no toxics tent act"
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the definition of portable temporary shelters for the purposes of prohibitions on the manufacture or sale of products containing highly flammable materials.

rollCalls.title: Provides that certain purchase contracts to purchase food can be awarded to a qualified bidder who complies with certain standards when such bid is not more than 10% higher than the lowest responsible bidder
rollCalls.summary: Provides that certain purchase contracts to purchase food can be awarded to a qualified bidder who fulfills certain values based procurement standards when such bid is not more than 10% higher than the lowest responsible bidder and when the bidder makes publicly available data on where such bidder sources their food items; sets forth the criteria for values based procurement standards to include local economies, environmental resilience, racial equity, valued workforce, valued agricultural sector, animal welfare, and nutrition.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the Mohawk River Basin management act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a Mohawk River Basin district and Mohawk River Basin management program for management of such district to preserve, protect, restore and enhance the environmental quality of the Mohawk River.

rollCalls.title: Relates to alternate jurors
rollCalls.summary: Provides that after an alternate juror has been substituted, the jury shall deliberate anew on all issues submitted to the jury at the outset of deliberations; exempts issues for which a verdict was already rendered.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the use of assumed and corporate names pertaining to household goods moving
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the use of assumed and corporate names by companies in the business of household goods moving; provides that companies may not use the words "mover", "moving", or "relocation service" or any abbreviation or derivative thereof unless approved by the commissioner of transportation.

rollCalls.title: Provides that no state or local correctional facility shall deny entry to a visitor to such facility due to the fact that such person is menstruating, wearing a menstrual product or has a contraceptive device
rollCalls.summary: Provides that no state or local correctional facility shall deny entry to a person visiting such facility due to the fact that such person is menstruating or has a contraceptive device or appears on body scan imaging or alternative methods to have or be using a menstrual product or contraceptive device.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the council on the arts to designate Little Panama as a cultural district
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the council on the arts to designate Little Panama as a cultural district in the city of New York; designates boundaries.

rollCalls.title: Relates to penalties for a lodging facility that fails to comply with certain requirements for providing information concerning services for human trafficking victims
rollCalls.summary: Provides that a lodging facility that fails to comply with certain requirements for providing information concerning services for human trafficking victims shall be liable for a civil penalty of five hundred dollars for a first offense and one thousand dollars for each subsequent offense; provides for concurrent enforcement by the director or commissioner of a municipal consumer affairs office or by the town attorney, city corporation counsel, or other lawful designee of a municipality.

rollCalls.title: Requires the testing of baby food and infant formula for toxic heavy metals and the disclosure of such test results
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "Baby Food and Infant Formula Safety and Transparency Act"; requires the testing of baby food and infant formula for toxic heavy metals and the disclosure of such test results.

rollCalls.title: Relates to protecting the display of religious items on dwellings
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a property owner from enforcing or adopting a restriction that prohibits one or more religious items from being displayed or affixed on any entry door or entry doorframe of a dwelling.

rollCalls.title: Requires epinephrine devices for anaphylaxis and staff trained to use them at child day care centers
rollCalls.summary: Requires child day care centers to have epinephrine devices and staff trained to use them on site in case of anaphylaxis or other severe allergic reaction.

rollCalls.title: Requires merchants to round cash purchases to the nearest five cent denomination in order to reduce the circulation of pennies within New York state
rollCalls.summary: Requires merchants to round cash purchases to the nearest five cent denomination in order to encourage the reduction of the circulation of pennies within New York state.

rollCalls.title: Approves notice and proof of disability from an attending nurse practitioner
rollCalls.summary: Approves notice and proof of disability or proof of need for family leave, or proof of disability for a special cross-bow permit, from an attending nurse practitioner.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property to the town of Goshen
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the transfer and conveyance of certain property located on the Mid-Hudson Forensic Psychiatric Center campus to the town of Goshen.

rollCalls.title: Indexes fixed amounts and clarifies compliance for life insurance and annuity businesses; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Indexes fixed dollar amounts in the statute to inflation, authorizes changes to compensation plans, removes obsolete language, and removes unnecessary filing requirements for certain life insurance and annuity businesses.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the use of a confirmation of trafficking victim status as evidence of identity for the issuance of an identification card
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the use of a confirmation of trafficking victim status issued by OTDA as evidence of identity for the issuance of a non-driver identification card.

rollCalls.title: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No.1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the East Herkimer Volunteer Fire Department No. 1, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the protection of people with special needs and the confidentiality of certain documents
rollCalls.summary: Relates to confidentiality in cases involving the protection of people with special needs; allows the state comptroller's office to unseal certain documents.

rollCalls.title: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease certain sports field fences for advertisements
rollCalls.summary: Permits the town of Southeast, Putnam county, to lease fences at the John E. Markel Memorial Park for advertisements.

rollCalls.title: Requires liability insurance coverage for tanning facilities
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain liability insurance covering bodily injuries and personal injuries arising out of the operation or use of ultraviolet radiation devices at tanning facilities.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip to be a nonresident of such town
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town attorney of the town of Islip, in the county of Suffolk, to be a nonresident of such town.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Congregation Divrei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023, 2024, 2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024, 2024-2025, and 2025-2026 school taxes for two parcels of land located at 67 and 71 College Road in Monsey.

rollCalls.title: Directs the the state board of real property tax services to conduct a study on the feasibility of amending property tax revisions for senior citizens located in special districts
rollCalls.summary: Directs the state board of real property tax services conduct a study on the feasibility of amending property tax revisions for senior citizens located in special districts and provide a report for such study.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes non-resident volunteer membership within the East Concord Fire Department, Inc.
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the East Concord Fire Department, Inc. from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of the membership.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the Birch Hill-Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Birch Hill - Highview Water District in the town of Southeast, Putnam County.

rollCalls.title: Relates to legalizing and validating certain actions taken by the town of Aurelius in apportioning water district costs
rollCalls.summary: Legalizes and validates the establishment of a unit-based tax levy by the town of Aurelius in apportioning certain water district costs in violation of current town law.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain alterations to multiple dwellings; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Relates to certain alterations based upon which room is being altered in a multiple dwelling.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Larry Mendel to receive his 30 years of service credit granting eligibility for the length of service award program
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Larry Mendel to receive his 30 years of service credit granting eligibility for the length of service award program.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the county of Cortland to transfer ownership of Linear Park to Lime Hollow Nature Center, Inc.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the county of Cortland to transfer ownership of Linear Park to Lime Hollow Nature Center, Inc.; provides that such lands shall revert to the county of Cortland if they cease to be used for the agreed upon purpose; provides that such park shall continue to be made available to the general public of the state of New York.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Breanne M. Smith to receive a refund of certain accumulated contributions paid to the New York state and local employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Breanne M. Smith to receive a refund of certain accumulated contributions paid to the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the compensation of Catholic Guardian Services for fair and equitable holding expenses associated with lands transferred to Catholic Home Bureau
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the compensation to Catholic Guardian Services for fair and equitable holding expenses associated with lands transferred to Catholic Home Bureau which reverted to the state upon termination of their use for public purposes.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Patrick LaFortune Jr.
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting state route nine-W within the town of Bethlehem, at the town line bordering the city of Albany until its intersection with Moriah road, to Patrick LaFortune Jr.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Church of Pentecost, USA, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Church of Pentecost, USA, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for parcels located in the county of Suffolk.

rollCalls.title: Requires rent reduction in cases of submetered utility service
rollCalls.summary: Requires rent reduction in cases of submetered utility service; directs the division of housing and community renewal to develop a standard reduction and an appeals process.

rollCalls.title: Relates to authorities which collect tolls
rollCalls.summary: Requires every public authority which collects tolls from motorists to submit an annual report to the legislature; establishes the New York and New Jersey toll and fees reduction task force.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper Gerard B. Kane
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates the bridge over the Southern State Parkway on Udall Road in the town of Islip, county of Suffolk, to Trooper Gerard B. Kane.

rollCalls.title: Updates provisions relating to the independent redistricting commission
rollCalls.summary: Updates provisions relating to the independent redistricting commission; provides for redistricting following every federal census.

rollCalls.title: Makes commissioners full time employees of boards outside the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Makes commissioners full time employees of boards outside the city of New York.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems
rollCalls.summary: Regulates the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems to prevent algorithmic discrimination; requires independent audits of high risk AI systems; provides for enforcement by the attorney general.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring the establishment of automatic payment plans
rollCalls.summary: Relates to requiring the establishment of automatic payment plans; requires utility companies headquartered in New York to establish a statewide program to provide eligible participants with affordable payment plans.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates portion of the state highway system to Detective Brian C. Mulkeen
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Woodbury, county of Orange, to Detective Brian C. Mulkeen.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the biometric identifier privacy act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the biometric identifier privacy act; requires private entities in possession of biometric identifiers or biometric information to develop a written policy establishing a retention schedule and guidelines for permanently destroying biometric identifiers and biometric information when the initial purpose for collecting or obtaining such identifiers or information has been satisfied or within three years of the individual's last interaction with the private entity, whichever occurs first.

rollCalls.title: Relates to notices of non-renewal provided to a health care professional by a health care plan
rollCalls.summary: Provides that notices of non-renewal provided by a health care plan to a health care professional shall include an explanation of the reasons for such non-renewal and information for the health care professional to respond to such determination.

rollCalls.title: Relates to potable water testing at state and local parks
rollCalls.summary: Requires potable water testing at state and local parks at least once every three years.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the licensing of vision impairment specialists.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to War Dogs
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to War Dogs.

rollCalls.title: Provides family leave to persons recovering from a pregnancy loss
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definition of "family leave" to include persons recovering from a pregnancy loss.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of his deceased wife with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the underrepresented teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the underrepresented teachers of tomorrow teacher recruitment and retention program to attract and retain underrepresented certified teachers in schools which have an underrepresentation of underrepresented certified teachers; provides for grants and procedures for applying for such grants and eligibility requirements for fund distribution.

rollCalls.title: Relates to mortgage guaranty insurance
rollCalls.summary: Relates to mortgage guaranty insurance; allows for withdrawals from the contingency reserve if the superintendent determines that such withdrawals will not be harmful to policy holders.

rollCalls.title: Relates to state financial aid for library social work services
rollCalls.summary: Creates a program to award state financial aid for social work services to be provided in libraries located in economically disadvantaged communities to enhance and expand access to services in places where individuals seek assistance and resources.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the nutrient inactivant application permit
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the nutrient inactivant application permit to allow for the use of products used for controlling phosphorus levels in lakes or ponds to prevent and inhibit harmful algal blooms.

rollCalls.title: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals
rollCalls.summary: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the volunteer firefighters' and ambulance workers' credit; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Repeals the provision of law that volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers who receive a real property tax exemption for service may not receive the income tax credit for such service.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of her deceased husband with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the consumer protection division in the department of state
rollCalls.summary: Requires the consumer protection division to establish a process by which any state agency or third party, pursuant to an interagency agreement with the division for the purposes of fraud prevention, identity verification, and ensuring the integrity or security of individual identities, to grant access to verify New York resident identities via a secure comparison process against state systems.

rollCalls.title: Requires out-of-state affordable housing owners to maintain an escrow account for affordable housing rental units located in New York state
rollCalls.summary: Requires out-of-state affordable housing owners to maintain an escrow account for the purpose of financing utility costs, property tax obligations, fire services, and regular maintenance costs for affordable housing rental units located in New York state.

rollCalls.title: Relates to motions to vacate judgment; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Relates to motions to vacate judgment; authorizes filing motions to vacate judgment for a conviction that was subsequently decriminalized; authorizes motions to vacate judgment to be filed at any time after entry of a judgment obtained at trial or by plea; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

rollCalls.title: Requires third-party food delivery services to verify limited-use motorcycles and motor vehicles operated by workers in the course of making deliveries for such third-party delivery service are legally registered
rollCalls.summary: Requires third-party food delivery services to verify that limited-use motorcycles and motor vehicles operated by workers in the course of making deliveries for such third-party delivery service are legally registered; requires that a third-party food delivery service shall not sell, share, or allow access to such information.

rollCalls.title: Requires synthetic content creations system providers to include provenance data on certain content made available by the provider
rollCalls.summary: Requires synthetic content creations system providers to include provenance data on synthetic content produced or modified by a synthetic content creations system that such provider makes available.

rollCalls.title: Provides for requirements for the rental of helmets
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits any person, corporation, association or partnership who rents helmets or provides helmets to customers as part of their business from renting or providing a helmet that has sustained an impact.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the New York gift certificate scam prevention act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "New York gift certificate scam prevention act" to require certain sale, security and record-keeping requirements for gift certificates by sellers of gift certificates.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the senior center council; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the senior center council for the purposes of providing a forum for discussion of challenges facing senior centers across the state and developing solutions; supports sharing of information regarding efficient and effective operation of senior centers in different areas around the state; encourages the spread of methods and programs with proven effectiveness; creates an environment for peer-to-peer support for senior centers across the state; offers recommendations for how the state can support senior centers and lower barriers to effective service delivery; offers recommendations on existing services and cost effective measures to ensure the long-term sustainability and viability of senior centers in all areas of the state; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the age of persons enrolled in certain large group policies who receive annual mammograms
rollCalls.summary: Reduces the age from 35 to 30 for a covered person's annual mammogram for persons enrolled in large group policies.

rollCalls.title: Grants volunteer firefighters and emergency medical technicians academic credit at SUNY and CUNY
rollCalls.summary: Grants volunteer firefighters and emergency medical technicians academic credit at state operated institutions of the state university of New York and the senior colleges of the city university of New York to the extent of three academic credits per year, and 6 credits in the aggregate; provides that no fee, tuition or other charge shall be assessed against a volunteer firefighter or emergency medical technician who qualifies for such credit; directs the board of trustees of the state university and the city university of New York to adopt necessary procedures.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the statute of limitations for certain deed theft actions, revives such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations, and grants trial preference to such actions
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the statute of limitations for certain deed theft actions; revives such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations and states who may bring such actions; grants trial preference to such actions; directs the chief administrator of the courts to promulgate rules for the timely adjudication of certain revived actions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the eligibility of New York city transit authority employees for performance of duty disability retirement
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the eligibility of New York city transit authority employees for performance of duty disability retirement.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Fort de la Presentation
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting route 68 in the city of Ogdensburg, county of St. Lawrence, to Fort de la Presentation.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Duane Lake, in the town of Duanesburg, county of Schenectady, to participate in the septic system replacement fund
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Duane Lake, in the town of Duanesburg, county of Schenectady, to participate in the septic system replacement fund.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the widow of William James Middlebrooks to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Janice Middlebrooks, the widow of William James Middlebrooks, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Appalachian Trail
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of state highway 284 in the village of Unionville, county of Orange, to the Appalachian Trail.

rollCalls.title: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering
rollCalls.summary: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering and creating accounts on mobile sports wagering platforms; requires platforms to employ commercially reasonable and technically feasible age assurance methods.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the native/pollinator planting fund, the pollinator highway program and creates a distinctive license plate relating thereto
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the native/pollinator planting fund and the pollinator highway program; creates a distinctive native plant and pollinator license plate with the goal of promoting the cultivation and maintenance of native flowering plants, grasses and shrubs on land bordering state highways and on other public lands.

rollCalls.title: Provides internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing
rollCalls.summary: Provides WiFi service and internet access to all individuals residing in temporary housing; relates to funding for internet service under the ConnectAll digital equity grant program.

rollCalls.title: Clarifies the standard of care for animals held in or being transported by animal shelters; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies the standard of care for animals held in or being transported by animal shelters including the length of time and conditions such animal may be exposed to.

rollCalls.title: Relates to pet breeders; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Relates to pet breeders; changes the term "pet dealer" to "pet breeder"; amends the definition of pet breeders; repeals certain provisions of law related thereto.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the individual counseling rate enhancement act
rollCalls.summary: Requires a rate enhancement for reimbursement of individual psychotherapy services provided by a mental health counselor, a clinical social worker, or a psychologist where such services are provided in an outpatient substance use disorder clinic.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to William Cornell
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the Wantagh state parkway from route 27 to Jerusalem Road in the hamlet of Wantagh, town of Hempstead, county of Nassau to William Cornell.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the definition of small group for the purposes of health insurance policies and contracts; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Amends the definition of "small group" for purposes of health insurance policies and contracts to fifty employees or fewer; repeals provisions requiring the superintendent to conduct an impact study.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of health to contract with a qualified entity for a feasibility study and actuarial analysis of long-term services and supports financing and services options
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of health to contract with a qualified entity for a feasibility study and actuarial analysis of long-term services and supports financing and services options.

rollCalls.title: Requires medical assistance to include medical care, services or supplies to monitor blood pressure that have been validated for accuracy and are furnished without prior authorization to eligible pregnant women
rollCalls.summary: Requires medical assistance to include medical care, services or supplies to monitor blood pressure that have been validated for accuracy and are furnished without prior authorization to eligible pregnant women.

rollCalls.title: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain data to the department of financial services and authorizes premium discounts to policyholders who demonstrate certain mitigation actions
rollCalls.summary: Requires property/casualty insurance companies to submit certain zip code-level data to the department of financial services on nonrenewal rates, nonpayment cancellation rates, other cancellation rates, claim frequency rates, average claim amounts, paid loss ratios, and average premiums; requires property/casualty insurance companies that use a natural disaster risk model or scoring method to assign risk, information about such model or scoring method; authorizes a premium discount to policyholders of homeowners insurance or property/casualty insurance applicable to residential real property who demonstrate certain mitigation actions; requires insurers to post about such discounts on their public websites; relates to the timing of cancellation and nonrenewal notices for certain insurance policies; relates to increasing membership of the board governing the New York property insurance underwriting association; requires a quadrennial report on the activities of such association; increases such board membership to 23 including 6 directors appointed by the legislature and 4 directors appointed by the governor.

rollCalls.title: Requires health insurance plans to provide coverage for continuous blood glucose monitors for all children
rollCalls.summary: Requires health insurance plans to provide coverage for continuous blood glucose monitors for all children; requires coverage for glucose monitoring devices for all sugar disorders.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain anti-aging skin care products to contain a warning label
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain anti-aging skin care products to contain a warning label; sets forth requirements for the language, size, and placement of such warning label; establishes penalties for violating such provisions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to purposes of the drug treatment and public education fund
rollCalls.summary: Expands the purposes of the drug treatment and public education fund to include prevention and recovery programs; requires reporting to be made available on the office of addiction services and supports' website.

rollCalls.title: Requires notification of residents who are potentially affected by a serious health threat to their water system
rollCalls.summary: Requires notification of residents who are potentially affected by a serious health threat to their water system within 24 hours of receiving investigation results.

rollCalls.title: Provides that the New York state energy research and development authority shall provide information to residential and commercial consumers on renewable energy technology incentive and affordability programs
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the New York state energy research and development authority shall provide information to residential and commercial consumers regarding renewable energy technology incentive and affordability programs through a variety of methods, including brochures, posters, social media, television ads, and public ambassadors.

rollCalls.title: Relates to professional employer organization services
rollCalls.summary: Provides that receipts from other services and other business receipts, taxpayers, and combined groups including members, engaged in providing professional employer organization services shall include with such receipts amounts received with respect to wages, benefits, and other employee expenses disbursed to or for the benefit of a client's worksite employees and the related employment taxes if the amounts received are included in the calculation of the business income base or the combined business income base, respectively.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper Arthur A. Reddy
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates the bridge over the Southern State Parkway on Deer Park Avenue between Parkdale Drive and Sylvan Road in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to Trooper Arthur B. Reddy.

rollCalls.title: Changes the dedication of the bridge dedicated to Detective Thomas M. Inman
rollCalls.summary: Changes the dedication of the bridge dedicated to Detective Thomas M. Inman.

rollCalls.title: Removes designating letters on ballots
rollCalls.summary: Removes designating letters for rows and columns on ballots.

rollCalls.title: Requires the registration of data brokers and establishing a data deletion mechanism for consumers
rollCalls.summary: Requires the registration of data brokers; imposes regulations upon data brokers; establishes a data deletion mechanism for consumers; imposes penalties upon data brokers for violations of the law.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer or questioning plus crisis hotline
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a twenty-four hour, toll-free hotline and website for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer or questioning plus (LGBTQ+) individuals who are experiencing emotional distress, suicidal ideation, or crisis-related challenges, which shall provide immediate support, referrals, resource lists, and other information.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Tina Russo to receive certain service credit with the New York state teachers' retirement system.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to David Gaines
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Niagara to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to convey such parklands to David Gaines.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the caregiver coordinating commission to review and evaluate statewide planning, development, and implementation of caregiver support services, including respite care, for informal family caregivers caring for those across the lifespan.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Janay Gasparini, a part-time police officer, with the town of New Paltz police department to take the civil service examination
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Janay Gasparini, a part-time police officer, with the town of New Paltz police department to take the civil service examination and be eligible for appointment as a full time police officer for the town of New Paltz.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the protection of health information
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the protection of health information; establishes requirements for communications to individuals about their health information; requires either written consent or a designated necessary purpose for the processing of an individual's health information.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a waiting period before a firearm, shotgun or rifle may be delivered to a person
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a three calendar day waiting period from contact of the New York State National Instant Background Check System (NYS NICS) before a firearm, shotgun or rifle may be delivered to a person; provides exceptions where a person possesses a license to purchase, carry or possess a pistol, revolver, or semiautomatic rifle.

rollCalls.title: Requires instruction on work zone safety awareness as part of the pre-licensing course
rollCalls.summary: Requires instruction on work zone safety awareness as part of the pre-licensing course; establishes curriculum for the work zone safety component.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring gas and electric corporations to disclose certain information with an application for a major rate change
rollCalls.summary: Requires a gas and electric corporation to disclose certain information with an application for a major rate change; requires information relating to dividends paid to shareholders, capital investments, and policy expenditures; requires each application to include a dividend forecast covering the requested rate period.

rollCalls.title: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Katie Adamek
rollCalls.summary: Grants retroactive tier IV membership in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Katie Adamek, who is an employee of the Schenectady City School District beginning November 23, 2009.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain procedural protections granted to third-party sellers and seller profiles of online marketplaces
rollCalls.summary: Relates to certain procedural protections granted to third-party sellers and seller profiles of online marketplaces; provides that online marketplaces must provide notice and an opportunity to respond before a seller or profile is suspended; provides that a suspended third-party seller or seller profile shall have the right to appeal the determination of the online marketplace in seeking account reinstatement.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing school-based food pantries in schools in the city school district of the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Establishes school-based food pantries in high need schools in the city school district of the city of New York.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the retail sale of nitrous oxide and establishes civil penalties for violations; includes nitrous oxide misuse in the health care and wellness education and outreach program
rollCalls.summary: Enacts "Nima's law" which prohibits the retail sale of nitrous oxide; establishes civil penalties for violations; includes nitrous oxide misuse in the health care and wellness education and outreach program to expand education on the dangers of nitrous oxide misuse; prohibits the sale of whip cream chargers.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the use of drilling fluids, brine and flowback water from gas or oil wells, pools, or fields on any highway
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of drilling fluids, brine and flowback water from gas or oil wells, pools, or fields on any highway for any purpose including but not limited to de-icing or dust suppression.

rollCalls.title: Requires the consideration of complete street design for certain transportation projects which receive federal or state funding
rollCalls.summary: Requires the consideration of complete street design for certain transportation projects which receive federal or state funding; authorizes the department to compile and make publicly available guidance and reference material related to consideration of complete street design.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits non-compete agreements and certain restrictive covenants; authorizes covered individuals to bring a civil action in a court of competent jurisdiction against any employer or persons alleged to have violated such prohibition.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to PFC Travis C. Krege
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system constituting the bridge on Cleveland Drive crossing interstate route 90 in the town of Cheektowaga, county of Erie, to PFC Travis C. Krege.

rollCalls.title: Relates to crypto kiosks
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the registration and regulation of crypto kiosks and exchanges and licensing of cashier crypto exchange operators.

rollCalls.title: Relates to admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress in civil actions or proceedings; provides limited exceptions.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state bridge system to Detective Stephen J. Mullen
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates bridge number 1019119 on state route one hundred ten in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to Detective Stephen J. Mullen.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes retail licensees to purchase alcohol with a business payment card.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the office for the aging to establish, operate and maintain programs for transportation services
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the office for the aging to establish, operate and maintain programs for transportation services, or to contract with counties, cities, towns, villages, school districts or public or private nonprofit corporations, associations, institutions, or agencies concerned with the aging, for the operation and maintenance of such programs.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the qualifications to serve as a member of the citywide council on English language learners and of the citywide council on high schools
rollCalls.summary: Allows parents of a child who has ever received services through an English as a second language program to serve as a member of the citywide council on English language learners and of the citywide council on high schools even if the child is no longer enrolled.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a stakeholder group in the Oswego river basin
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a stakeholder group in the Oswego river basin to coordinate water release.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions of law relating to catastrophic or reinsurance coverage issued to certain small groups
rollCalls.summary: Makes permanent certain provisions of law relating to catastrophic or reinsurance coverage issued to certain small groups.

rollCalls.title: Relates to adult care facility financial statements
rollCalls.summary: Requires statements to be accompanied by a review performed in accordance with a statement on standards for accounting and review services.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the New York state workforce development board
rollCalls.summary: Renames the New York state workforce investment board as the New York state workforce development board; revises the duties of the board.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to lease such lands for cell tower installation
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to lease such lands for a cell tower installation.

rollCalls.title: Requires mobile sports wagering operators to share monthly invoice statements to authorized consumers
rollCalls.summary: Requires mobile sports wagering operators to share monthly invoice statements to authorized consumers; specifies information required.

rollCalls.title: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county
rollCalls.summary: Provides for certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assistant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange county.

rollCalls.title: Relates to base pilotage tariffs at Sandy Hook, Sands Point and Execution Rocks
rollCalls.summary: Relates to base pilotage tariffs rates at Sandy Hook, Sands Point and Execution Rocks for the years 2028 through 2032.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits gas and electric corporations from recovering costs related to labor-related legal activity or workers' compensation loss adjustment expenses from ratepayers
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits gas and electric corporations from recovering labor-related legal costs or workers' compensation loss adjustment expenses from ratepayers through rates, charges, surcharges, adjustment mechanisms, riders, or reconciliation mechanisms; defines labor-related legal activity.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a real property tax exemption for surviving spouses of correction officers who died in the line of duty
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a real property tax exemption of up to fifty percent of the assessed valuation of such real property for surviving spouses of state and county correction officers who died in the line of duty and such property constitutes the primary resident of such surviving spouse.

rollCalls.title: Relates to service contracts for accidental damages
rollCalls.summary: Relates to service contracts for accidental damages from handling and power surges.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions providing for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits cannabis inversion
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "cannabis supply chain integrity and anti-inversion act"; prohibits any act or omission involving illicit cannabis; provides penalties for such cannabis inversion.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to East Fishkill veterans
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to East Fishkill veterans.

rollCalls.title: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo
rollCalls.summary: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo.

rollCalls.title: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises to 2027
rollCalls.summary: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises from June 30, 2026 to June 30, 2027; extends for one year the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises which is tasked with reporting and making recommendations on how best to support such businesses and promote the formation and growth of new employee-owned enterprises in New York state.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue certain parkland in the borough of Queens
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue certain parkland in the borough of Queens and transfer such parkland to the metropolitan transportation authority.

rollCalls.title: Relates to benefits for the surviving spouses of firefighters killed in the line of duty
rollCalls.summary: Provides benefits to the surviving spouses of firefighters killed in the line of duty.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions of law relating to providing local governments greater contract flexibility and cost savings by permitting certain shared purchasing among political subdivisions
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of law relating to providing local governments greater contract flexibility and cost savings by permitting certain shared purchasing among political subdivisions from June 30, 2026 until June 30, 2027.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the issuance of pet insurance that provides coverage for accidents and illnesses of pets.

rollCalls.title: Relates to contracts by service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprises
rollCalls.summary: Increases the statewide goal for participation on state contracts by service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprises from six to eight percent.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions providing for increased supplementary uninsured/underinsured motorist (SUM) insurance coverage
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions providing for increased supplementary uninsured/underinsured motorist (SUM) insurance coverage to June 30, 2029.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions of the property/casualty insurance availability act and the authority of the New York property insurance underwriting association
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of the property/casualty insurance availability act and the authority of the New York property insurance underwriting association.

rollCalls.title: Removes the authority of the state civil service commission to administer the county service in Westchester
rollCalls.summary: Removes the authority of the state civil service commission to administer the county service in Westchester.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown in Rockland county to alienate certain lands used as parklands for the purposes of installing a cellular tower
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Clarkstown in Rockland county to lease certain lands used as parklands to Homeland Towers, LLC for the purposes of installing a cellular tower.

rollCalls.title: Provides additional protection to judges and their family members under the Judicial Security Act
rollCalls.summary: Provides additional protection to judges and their family members under the Judicial Security Act; expands protection to domestic partners and adult children; relates to records to be kept private; relates to the continuation of the prohibition against the public disclosure of personal information; authorizes the chief administrator of the courts to develop procedures necessary to prevent the disclosure of personal information in the possession of the unified court system.

rollCalls.title: Relates to electronic filing for the court of appeals
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the court of appeals to promulgate rules authorizing the use of electronic means for civil and criminal matters in such court.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of the state charter advisory board
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of the state charter advisory board.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the Coordinated Construction Act for Lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions authorizing the city of Syracuse to impose a hotel and motel tax
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions authorizing the city of Syracuse to impose a hotel and motel tax to December 31, 2029.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions related to the assessment and review of assessments in the county of Nassau
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions related to the assessment and review of assessments in the county of Nassau to June 30, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the bonding authority of the New York city housing development corporation
rollCalls.summary: Increases the maximum aggregate principal amount of the outstanding notes and bonds of the New York city housing development corporation from twenty billion dollars to twenty-two billion dollars.

rollCalls.title: Enacts "Francesco's law"; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Enacts "Francesco's law" which establishes violations for the failure to safely store rifles, shotguns, and firearms in the presence of a minor or a prohibited person; requires the office of gun violence prevention to collect and analyze statistical and other information and data with respect to injuries or deaths of minors resulting from failure to safely store a firearm, rifle, or shotgun.

rollCalls.title: Provides that applicants or recipients for SNAP benefits shall not be subjected to finger imaging as a requirement of the supplemental nutrition assistance program
rollCalls.summary: Provides that applicants for or recipients of SNAP benefits shall not be subjected to finger imaging as a requirement of the supplemental nutrition assistance program.

rollCalls.title: Allows veterans to fish for free in state parks
rollCalls.summary: Allows veterans of the armed forces of the United States to fish for free in state parks under the jurisdiction of a state agency.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the operation of gene synthesis providers and manufacturers of gene synthesis equipment
rollCalls.summary: Requires gene synthesis providers and manufacturers of gene synthesis equipment to operate in accordance with rules and regulations issued by the department of health, including identifying potentially dangerous sequences and maintaining certain records.

rollCalls.title: Removes restrictions on the frequency certain authorized organizations may conduct bingo games
rollCalls.summary: Removes restrictions on the frequency certain authorized organizations may conduct bingo games.

rollCalls.title: Designates records and information relating to a patient who has been deceased for a period of fifty years or longer as historic records no longer subject to privacy protections
rollCalls.summary: Designates records and information relating to a patient who has been deceased for a period of fifty years or longer as historic records no longer subject to privacy protections; provides that such provisions shall not be construed as requiring a facility to retain records for any particular length of time.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain disclosures in advertisements involving virtual tokens
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain disclosures by a developer of virtual tokens in advertisements involving such virtual tokens; provides restrictions concerning advertising.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a requirement for information related to specialized dental benefit plans
