rollCalls.summary: Requires insurers and corporations that issue, sell, renew or offer a specialized dental benefits plan policy or contract to report annually on data related to such dental benefits plan policies.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Power House Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Power House Church to file an application for a real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor for all applicable taxes from the 2023 and 2024 assessment rolls.

rollCalls.title: Relates to deadlines for filing nominating petitions for small city school board elections
rollCalls.summary: Requires that nominating petitions for small city school district elections be submitted no later than thirty days prior to the election; makes technical corrections relating to such small city school board elections.

rollCalls.title: Relates to posting financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidate for a member of the legislature
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the annual statement of financial disclosure and the posting of financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidates for a member of the legislature.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certification required for payments made for home care services
rollCalls.summary: Requires an annual statement of wage parity hours and expenses to be accompanied by an independent accountant's report on applying agreed upon procedures on the annual compliance statement of wage parity, hours and expenses prior to payments for home care services by government agencies.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the level of acceptable light transmittance of automobile window tint and film
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the level of acceptable light transmittance of automobile window tint and film.

rollCalls.title: Allows prospective and current agency personnel receive certification through remote training methods
rollCalls.summary: Allows prospective and current agency personnel to receive certification through remote training methods.

rollCalls.title: Defines mental health practitioners with diagnostic authority
rollCalls.summary: Defines mental health practitioners with diagnostic authority for the purposes of providing services under the workers' compensation law; includes such practitioners as providers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to mandatory health insurance coverage for acupuncture services
rollCalls.summary: Requires mandatory health insurance coverage for acupuncture services upon the prescription of a health care provider acting within the provider's scope of practice.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits insurers from reducing disability benefits due to the actual or anticipated receipt of social security disability benefits unless certain conditions are met
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits insurers from reducing disability benefits due to the actual or anticipated receipt of social security disability benefits unless certain conditions are met.

rollCalls.title: Relates to Medicaid accountable care organizations
rollCalls.summary: Allows for Medicaid accountable care organizations to purchase experience-rated health insurance for their members.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a veterans' bill of rights
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a veterans' bill of rights; provides sample language for such bill of rights; requires the department of veterans' services to establish and distribute a veterans' bill of rights and to make such bill of rights available on the department's website.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the disclosure of the records of court proceedings in certain mental hygiene proceedings
rollCalls.summary: Provides that court records in a proceeding under articles 77, 78 and 81 of the mental hygiene law shall not be perused, examined, disclosed, taken or copied by any other person than a party, the attorney or counsel of a party, the guardian, the court evaluator or the court examiner except by order of the court, or the office of the attorney general.

rollCalls.title: Requires that public contracts be divided by size into large, medium, small and micro contracts for the purpose of increasing opportunities for small businesses, including MWBEs, to participate in state contracts
rollCalls.summary: Requires that public contracts be divided by size into large, medium, small and micro contracts for the purpose of increasing opportunities for small businesses, including minority-owned business enterprises and women-owned business enterprises, to participate in state contracts.

rollCalls.title: Relates to electric charging station fee transparency
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of public service to promulgate rules and regulations to establish fee transparency standards for electric vehicle charging stations.

rollCalls.title: Replaces the terms father, mother, and filiation to gender neutral language; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Replaces the terms father, mother, and filiation to gender neutral language.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the central New York regional transportation authority
rollCalls.summary: Increases the membership of the central New York regional transportation authority from twelve to thirteen members.

rollCalls.title: Requires bicycles advertised for sale or resale in New York state to have an identifying serial number and for such serial number to be posted in any advertisement for such bicycle
rollCalls.summary: Requires bicycles advertised for sale or resale in New York state to have an identifying serial number in legible boldfaced figures in one of certain specified areas on the bicycle; requires advertisements for bicycles to clearly and conspicuously include a photograph of such bicycles; exempts online marketplaces from placing identifying serial numbers on bicycles.

rollCalls.title: Requires cities that fluoridate public water supplies to comply with certain provisions of law and publish a notice prior to discontinuing such fluoridation
rollCalls.summary: Requires cities that fluoridate public water supplies to comply with certain provisions of law relating to fluoridation, and to publish a notice in local newspapers and on the city's website and social media pages at least ninety days prior to discontinuing such fluoridation.

rollCalls.title: Relates to banned members of social referral services
rollCalls.summary: Relates to bans from online dating services based on content; requires retention of records where necessary to maintain enforcement of fraud bans or content bans; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Assembly Member Bobby D'Andrea
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates all that portion of the state highway system constituting bridge number 1007069, located on Union Avenue, state route 9P, crossing interstate 87 in the city of Saratoga Springs, county of Saratoga, to Assembly Member Bobby D'Andrea.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Bonnie E. Sullivan, the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan, to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed.

rollCalls.title: Permits the Johnson City Central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Permits the Johnson City central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

rollCalls.title: Relates to school tax relief exemption notification
rollCalls.summary: Provides that notification of the approval of a STAR exemption be mailed to the applicant within thirty days of such determination.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of health to establish and maintain a menopause informational and resource webpage on the department website
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of health to establish and maintain a menopause informational and resource webpage on the department website.

rollCalls.title: Provides for permitted leaves of absence for members of civil air patrol
rollCalls.summary: Provides for permitted leaves of absence for members of the civil air patrol during emergencies for purposes of assisting with such emergencies.

rollCalls.title: Relates to unauthorized rental car use
rollCalls.summary: Amends provisions relating to unauthorized rental car use; authorizes a rental vehicle company to regain custody of a rental vehicle which is not returned at the end of the rental agreement including repossession.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the prohibition of lending institutions issuing unsolicited mail-loan checks
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the prohibition of lending institutions issuing mail-loan checks except in response to an affirmative request or application therefor; provides that any debt, interest, fee or other obligation arising from a mail-loan check issued in violation of this section shall be null and void and unenforceable.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prohibitions on the use of certain tropical hardwoods for state contracts
rollCalls.summary: Requires that companies contracting with the state do not contribute to tropical forest degradation or deforestation directly or through their supply chains.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the submission of requests to the committee on special education for the educational services mandated by an individualized education services program
rollCalls.summary: Requires the school district of location shall annually provide written notice to all parents or persons in parental relation to students with disabilities attending nonpublic schools within their district regarding the process for requesting special education services; relates to the denial of services in a city having a population of one million or more for the 2024--2025 school year.

rollCalls.title: Extends the twenty-five year presumptive eligibility period for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations
rollCalls.summary: Extends the presumptive eligibility period, from twenty-five to thirty-five years, for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations.

rollCalls.title: Provides a tax exemption on certain auxiliary dwelling units constructed for seniors or disabled individuals
rollCalls.summary: Allows a real property tax exemption for dwelling units constructed for senior citizens or disabled persons receiving social security disability benefits.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring the office of victim assistance to notify crime victims of the availability of victim support services
rollCalls.summary: Requires the office of victim assistance to notify crime victims of the availability of victim support services by providing such victims with a written notice of the availability of statewide programs.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Godschild Outreach Ministries to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Godschild Outreach Ministries to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk.

rollCalls.title: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Permits the Chenango Forks central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of New Hyde Park to file an application for exemption from real property taxes for a portion of the 2024-2025 assessment rolls and all of the 2025 general taxes.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of Johnson City to establish hotel and motel taxes within such village
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of Johnson City to establish hotel and motel taxes within such village.

rollCalls.title: Permits the Oswego city school district to create an insurance reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the Oswego city school district may establish an insurance reserve fund.

rollCalls.title: Authorization for certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with an event sanctioned by the New York Road Runners
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state in connection with an event sanctioned by the New York Road Runners.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the allocation and use of the revenues raised from the imposition of hotel and motel taxes in Cortland county
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the allocation and use of the revenues raised from the imposition of hotel and motel taxes in Cortland county; provides that a certain percentage of such net annual occupancy receipts be utilized to support and enhance tourism and tourist activity; provides that the remaining portion be used for any lawful county purpose related to economic development.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Yonkers
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Yonkers; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2031.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions of law relating to capital facilities in support of the state university and community colleges, procurement and the state university health care facilities
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of law relating to capital facilities in support of the state university and community colleges, procurement and the state university health care facilities.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions authorizing hunting big game by rifle in the county of Tompkins
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions authorizing hunting big game by rifle in the county of Tompkins until 2028.

rollCalls.title: Changes the name of the office of temporary and disability assistance to the office of economic security
rollCalls.summary: Changes the name of the office of temporary and disability assistance to the office of economic security.

rollCalls.title: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system
rollCalls.summary: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system; restores 55/30 for all members; reduces the retirement age from 63 to 62.

rollCalls.title: Relates to disability claims for a qualifying World Trade Center
rollCalls.summary: Extends the deadline for filing disability claims for a qualifying World Trade Center condition until 2030.

rollCalls.title: Relates to personal income taxes in the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions of law relating to tax rates and the imposition of income taxes in the city of New York.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the amount of St. Lawrence county economic development power that may be used by the New York Power Authority to generate net earnings
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the amount of St. Lawrence county economic development power that may be used by the New York Power Authority to generate net earnings and authority-TMED contracts.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Rushford, county of Allegany, to be a nonresident of such town.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the purchase of claims by corporations or collection agencies; relates to the inference of an assignee's intent and purpose in taking an assignment of a claim against an obligor that is not an eligible obligor.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the licensing of landscape architects
rollCalls.summary: Relates to certain licensing exemptions for landscape architects.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring emergency notices be provided to customers in certain languages
rollCalls.summary: Requires every utility corporation or municipality who sends an emergency notice to customers to make available and provide such notice in English, Spanish, Haitian-Creole, Mandarin, Cantonese, Arabic, French, Urdu, Russian, Yiddish, Korean, Bangla, Polish, Italian, Hindi and Tagalog.

rollCalls.title: Relates to authorizing the city of Albany to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of Albany to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such city's annual tax levy.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of DMV to establish a sex trafficking awareness and prevention program to provide education and awareness literature and educational materials to trade schools, community colleges, agencies, public or private schools or persons offering instruction in the operation of commercial motor vehicles with a commercial motor vehicle license and requires applicants for commercial driver's licenses submit a certificate for completion of such program.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Edward J. Sweeney"
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Edward J. Sweeney" in the town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.

rollCalls.title: Limits physician charges for missed appointments by patients
rollCalls.summary: Relates to physician charges for missed appointments by patients; bars physicians from charging fees if a patient arrives on time for appointment but was not seen; requires written policy about missed appointments be prominently posted in patient waiting room and included in bills mailed to patients.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the tribal-state compact revenue account
rollCalls.summary: Relates to monies appropriated and received each year by the state as a portion of the negotiated percentage of the net drop from electronic gaming devices the state receives.

rollCalls.title: Imposes certain penalties related to violations of building and fire code standards within fourteen days and increases certain fine amounts for violations of housing standards
rollCalls.summary: Requires that any penalties for violations of housing standards or building and fire codes be assessed and imposed within fourteen days; increases certain fine amounts for violations of housing standards.

rollCalls.title: Includes Stewart International Airport in the definition of covered airport location for the purposes of minimum wage rates
rollCalls.summary: Includes Stewart International Airport in the definition of covered airport location for the purposes of minimum wage rates.

rollCalls.title: Requires the establishment of community housing waiting lists within the office of mental health service system
rollCalls.summary: Requires the establishment of community housing waiting lists within the office of mental health service system; directs each provider of housing services in the office of mental health system to provide, on a monthly basis, the office of mental health with a list of each person referred to, admitted to, applying for, withdrawing an application for and denied admission to housing provided by such provider; requires the community-based agency performing assessments of persons with a documented mental illness to provide the office with the names of such who have been assessed and who meet the eligibility criteria for the array of funded and/or licensed housing programs; requires such office to publish such waiting lists on a monthly basis.

rollCalls.title: Requires patient hospital admissions form to allow patient to designate a domestic partner with the same privileges as a next-of-kin respecting authorizing surgery
rollCalls.summary: Requires patient hospital admissions form to allow a patient to designate a domestic partner with the same privileges as a next-of-kin respecting visitation and the authorizing of surgery for a patient in the absence and unavailability of a next-of-kin or nearest relative where the patient has given no specific instructions and becomes unable to execute a health care proxy or make decisions about their health care.

rollCalls.title: Requires the educational and vocational credits earned by incarcerated individuals are transferable upon release
rollCalls.summary: Requires that curricula and educational programs provide incarcerated individuals the opportunity to earn educational or vocational credits which shall be transferable to an educational institution upon the release of the incarcerated individual.

rollCalls.title: Exempts veterans and those on active duty from paying certain fees for travel
rollCalls.summary: Exempts veterans and those on active duty from paying certain fees for travel on the New York world war veterans memorial highway in Essex county or Prospect mountain veteran's memorial highway in Warren county.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act" requiring manufacturers to make available certain documentation, parts, embedded software, firmware, or tools necessary for repairing equipment; establishes a timely repair for wheelchair program; deems all wheelchair repairs needed within 5 years of initial prescription medically necessary.

rollCalls.title: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age for New York police department members
rollCalls.summary: Relates to increasing the mandatory retirement age for New York police department members from 63 to 65.

rollCalls.title: Directs the commissioner of transportation to waive an annual security deposit fee for use of state land
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of transportation to waive the annual security deposit fee specified in Use and Occupancy Permit No. 82771 issued to the Bedford Hills Fire District, Town of Bedford, Westchester County allowing for the use of approximately 4,000 square feet of state land for parking for volunteer firefighter members of the Bedford Hills Fire District.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the first responder peer support program act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the "first responder peer support program act" which supplies peer-to-peer mental health programs to first responders.

rollCalls.title: Includes doula awareness in the department of health's education and outreach program
rollCalls.summary: Includes doula awareness and the advantages of utilizing a doula in the department of health's education and outreach program.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes and directs the New York state power authority to rename the Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant to the Shirley J. Hamilton Niagara Power Plant
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes and directs the New York state power authority to rename the Robert Moses Niagara Power Plant located in the town of Lewiston, county of Niagara, to the Shirley J. Hamilton Niagara Power Plant.

rollCalls.title: Requires colleges in the state to communicate all absentee deadlines for New York state elections
rollCalls.summary: Requires colleges in the state to communicate all absentee deadlines for New York state elections to all enrolled students.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the breeding, sale, trade, purchase, importation, and exportation of red-eared slider turtles
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the breeding, sale, trade, purchase, importation, and exportation of red-eared slider turtles in the state; exempts certain entities and organizations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits landlords from restricting the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants; provides that the landlord is not compelled to change utilities or alter the unit for such installation; prohibits surcharge where tenant pays utilities directly to provider; requires a tenant restore appliances or fixtures to the condition they were prior to being installed or allowing such appliances or fixtures remain in the rental unit at no cost to the landlord; defines "appliances or fixtures".

rollCalls.title: Relates to issuance of keepsake plates for gold star mothers
rollCalls.summary: Relates to distinctive license plates issued to gold star mothers; permits gold star mothers to retain one keepsake plate as a commemorative item after distinctive plates are surrendered.

rollCalls.title: Relates to warning labels on certain sports and muscle creams
rollCalls.summary: Enacts Arielle's Law which requires the placement of warning labels on certain sports and muscle creams.

rollCalls.title: Waives the residency requirement for the commissioner of health and public health director for Putnam county
rollCalls.summary: Waives the residency requirement for the commissioner of health and public health director for Putnam county.

rollCalls.title: Directs the commissioner of health to establish at least 4 maternal-infant care centers in areas of need for infants suffering from drug withdrawal as a result of in utero exposure
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of health to establish at least 4 maternal-infant care centers in areas of need for infants suffering from drug withdrawal as a result of in utero exposure.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the menopause awareness improvement act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the menopause awareness improvement act; establishes a menopause education program; establishes course work or training in menopausal health; directs the commissioner of labor to conduct a study on the impact of menopause on the workforce.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the residence of the part-time judge of the city court of Lackawanna; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the part-time judge of the city court of Lackawanna to reside anywhere in Erie county.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the sale of medical adhesives and bandages containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale of medical adhesives and bandages containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; provides penalties for violations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the authority of certain existing assisted living programs to expand capacity by nine or fewer beds under an expedited process
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes certain existing assisted living programs to expand capacity by nine or fewer beds under an expedited process.

rollCalls.title: Relates to registrations of residential mortgages in default
rollCalls.summary: Increases fee amount authorized to be imposed on mortgagees or their agents.

rollCalls.title: Provides for mental health counseling for correction officers and civilian staff in correctional facilities
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of corrections and community supervision, in consultation with the commissioner of mental health, to make mental health counseling available to all correction officers and civilian staff in correctional facilities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to authorizing the release of certain records of deceased residents of mental health facilities to family members upon written request
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner to promulgate regulations for the release of patient records by the office of mental health.

rollCalls.title: Provides an exception to hospital visitation rules for members of the clergy
rollCalls.summary: Provides an exception to hospital visitation rules for members of the clergy.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the perimeter rule at LaGuardia airport
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the port authority shall prohibit nonstop flights to or from points beyond one thousand five hundred miles, except on Saturdays and flights to Denver, Colorado, from flying to or from LaGuardia airport, an air terminal of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey.

rollCalls.title: Expands how applicants may qualify for a license to be a dentist
rollCalls.summary: Expands how applicants may qualify for a license to be a dentist to include postdoctoral specialty programs and advanced education programs in general dentistry.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing a Legionnaires' disease awareness and education program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a Legionnaires' disease awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of Legionnaires' disease.

rollCalls.title: Relates to newborn screening for Gaucher disease
rollCalls.summary: Requires that newborns are tested for Gaucher disease.

rollCalls.title: Directs how certain valuations and computations of the amount due are calculated in certain foreclosure actions
rollCalls.summary: Directs how certain valuations and computations of the amount due are calculated in certain foreclosure actions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to enacting technical changes to the good cause eviction law
rollCalls.summary: Relates to enacting technical changes to the good cause eviction law.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "freedom to read act"
rollCalls.summary: Requires each board of education to adopt a written policy for reconsideration of school library materials and make such policy available on its website; requires such policies to include provisions for the creation of a reconsideration committee to review complaints regarding school library materials; requires the commissioner of education to develop one or more model policies for school districts.

rollCalls.title: Directs the director of the office of the aging to establish a caregiver crisis hotline
rollCalls.summary: Directs the director of the office of the aging to establish a caregiver crisis hotline to provide emotional support resources for informal caregivers of a person in need of assistance.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the sale of 7-hydroxymitragynine products
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale of products that contain 7-hydroxymitragynine at a level that exceeds 2% of total alkaloids or one milligram per serving; establishes fines for the sale of such products.

rollCalls.title: Includes the county of Sullivan within the definition of a designated community
rollCalls.summary: Includes the county of Sullivan within the definition of a designated community for purposes of community preservation funds.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain guilty pleas
rollCalls.summary: Relates to certain guilty pleas where the plea is in the interest of justice and which are entered into with both the permission of the court and the consent of the people.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Lemcke Brothers Military Service
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Parma, county of Monroe, to the Lemcke Brothers Military Service.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the reconnection of service for low-income customers
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the reconnection of service for low-income customers; provides that upon the signing of a reconnection plan where a low-income customer shall pay no more than three percent of such customer's monthly income for electric or gas service or six percent of monthly income for combination electric and gas service plus such customer's current monthly bill, a utility shall reconnect such service.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the county of Warren to offer an optional twenty-year retirement plan to Bradley Murphy, a patrol officer employed by such county.

rollCalls.title: Requires the office for the aging to make an annual report on the budget expenditures on behalf of the senior population of the state
rollCalls.summary: Requires the office for the aging to make an annual report on the budget expenditures on behalf of the senior population of the state every April first.

rollCalls.title: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county
rollCalls.summary: Provides for certain death benefits to deputy sheriffs employed by Orange county.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the residency of certain officers of the village of Washingtonville, Orange county
rollCalls.summary: Expands the residency requirement for the village clerk, deputy village clerk, village treasurer, and deputy village treasurer of the village of Washingtonville such that such person need not be a resident of such village, but must be a resident in the county in which such village is located or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the consumer camera privacy act
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits manufacturers or operators of networked camera devices to enable coordinated surveillance features on such devices as a default feature without first obtaining affirmative opt-in consent from the owner; requires disclosure of data rights for owners of such devices; prohibits coordinated surveillance features to be disclosed to law enforcement without a warrant; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Officer Stephen L. Raymond
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system, consisting of the bridge located on Diamond Point road at exit twenty-three of interstate eighty-seven in the town of Lake George, county of Warren, to Officer Stephen L. Raymond.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Babylon to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Babylon to accept an application for exemption from real property taxes from Tiegerman Community Services, Inc.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sergeant Gregory L. Wahl
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sergeant Gregory L. Wahl.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Holland central school district to establish an insurance reserve fund for any loss, claim, action or judgment for which such school district is authorized or required to purchase or maintain insurance for the kinds of risks for which insurance is authorized.

rollCalls.title: Relates to qualifications to hold the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector in the village of Briarcliff Manor
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of Briarcliff Manor to provide that the positions of village treasurer, deputy village treasurer, village clerk, deputy clerk and building inspector may be held by residents of Westchester county, or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Clara H. Barton
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the village of Dansville, county of Livingston, to Clara H. Barton.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Gorham Pageant of Bands
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Gorham, county of Ontario, to the Gorham Pageant of Bands.

rollCalls.title: Relates to notifying an insured of a rate filing increase or decrease for long term care
rollCalls.summary: Relates to notifying an insured of a rate filing increase or decrease for long term care; provides such notification shall include instructions on how to submit comments on such rate filing.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to convey real property at the former Buffalo psychiatric center to the Richardson Center Corporation
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to convey real property at the former Buffalo psychiatric center to the Richardson Center Corporation for the purposes of constructing a mixed-use campus for the community benefit.

rollCalls.title: Requires the department of health to create and issue a five-year plan with its proposals to best mitigate the persistence of lead in school water across the state
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of health, in consultation with the commissioner of education, to create and issue a five-year plan with proposals to best mitigate the persistence of lead in schools.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a nursing facility transition and diversion Medicaid waiting list
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the commissioner of health to establish nursing facility transition and diversion Medicaid waiting lists per designated waiver region, once the federally approved capacity for the waiver is reached.

rollCalls.title: Relates to elections involving board members, by-law amendments, or dissolution, reconstitution or conversion of mutual housing companies
rollCalls.summary: Relates to elections involving board members, by-law amendments, or dissolution, reconstitution or conversion of mutual housing companies; provides that ballots shall be cast electronically to a neutral third party; provides that by-laws approved by shareholders and the commissioner of housing or supervising agency may limit eligibility for being a candidate for board of directors of a mutual housing company; relates to quorum for purposes of an election of board members in certain mutual housing companies.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes funding to local government entities from the urban development corporation through the electric generation facility cessation mitigation fund for an additional five years.

rollCalls.title: Relates to artist preferences in housing
rollCalls.summary: Relates to artist preferences in housing; provides that giving occupancy preference to individuals who are involved in artistic activities is not an unlawful discriminatory practice provided that such preference is implemented or authorized by an agency or the state of New York.

rollCalls.title: Provides for including siblings of parents and children of siblings in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members
rollCalls.summary: Provides for including siblings of parents and children of siblings in the definition of "family member" in relation to regulations pertaining to rights of family members to succeed in certain cases to the rights of certain tenants.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Donald Roy McAnn
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Donald Roy McAnn located on state route 941-A in the town of Greece, county of Monroe.

rollCalls.title: Relates to actions arising out of consumer debt
rollCalls.summary: Relates to action arising out of consumer debt; defines consumer debt; replaces consumer credit transaction with such term.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the city of Olean assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts)
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of Oleans assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from OWH Properties, Inc. (Operation Warm Hearts) for all of the 2025-2026 school taxes and all of the 2025 general taxes.

rollCalls.title: Allows certain minor defendants to utilize electronic appearances
rollCalls.summary: Allows certain minor defendants under the age of 18 to utilize electronic appearances under certain circumstances.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Christopher Walser to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer in the village of Chittenango and be placed on the eligible list for employment as such
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Christopher Walser to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police officer for the village of Chittenango police department.

rollCalls.title: Relates to collection of social security account numbers for registration with the New York state donate life registry
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes insurers to collect social security account numbers solely for the purpose of effectuating, verifying, or amending an individual's donor registration status in the New York state donate life registry; prohibits use of such information other than for such purposes.

rollCalls.title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury
rollCalls.summary: Permits the town of Woodbury to establish a demonstration program and install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices; relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Woodbury.

rollCalls.title: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree
rollCalls.summary: Permits the town of Palm Tree to establish a demonstration program and install and operate traffic-control signal photo violation-monitoring devices; relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the town of Palm Tree.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a task force to study aging in place in mental health housing
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a task force to study aging in place in mental health housing; provides for the repeal of such task force upon expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town clerk of the town of Bethany, county of Genesee, to be nonresidents of such town
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town clerk of the town of Bethany, county of Genesee, to be nonresidents of such town.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the rights of sexual assault survivors during the investigative process
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the rights of sexual assault survivors during the investigative process; establishes a task force to study and assess sexual assault survivors' rights and services.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prohibiting the use of stealth crawlers
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the deployment of a stealth crawler in a manner that would damage, impair or burden the operation of a covered news source or otherwise cause a news source economic harm.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of New Berlin to alienate certain parklands
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of New Berlin to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate certain lands.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes
rollCalls.summary: Updates provisions regarding the collection and use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by the Centerport Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the crime of benefiting from a labor trafficking venture, benefiting from a sex trafficking venture; creates a civil action relating thereto; and revives certain civil actions relating thereto
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the crimes of benefiting from a labor trafficking venture, benefiting from a sex trafficking venture and aggravated benefiting from a sex trafficking venture; establishes civil action for victims of benefiting from a trafficking venture; revives such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations, grants trial preference to such actions; directs the chief administrator of the courts to promulgate rules for the timely adjudication of certain revived actions.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix to be a nonresident of such town
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town justice of the town of Dix, county of Schuyler, to be a nonresident of such town.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Congregation Atzei Chaim to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2023 and 2024 assessment rolls and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an awareness campaign on the use of hormone replacement therapy in treating the symptoms of perimenopause and menopause.

rollCalls.title: Requires NYSERDA to develop a comprehensive electric vehicle fast charging station implementation plan
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a comprehensive electric vehicle fast charging station implementation plan; requires the New York state energy and research development authority to further establish a "Fast Charge NY working group" to develop such plan; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland
rollCalls.summary: Extends limitations on the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Orangetown, County of Rockland for the 2026--2027 assessment rolls.

rollCalls.title: Relates to extending provisions of laws permitting certain deductions from wages
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of law relating to permitted deductions from wages for an additional two years.

rollCalls.title: Relates to fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings; extending effectiveness
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of law providing for certain fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings to December 31, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the remedial construction of New York labor law act
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the New York labor law shall be construed liberally for the accomplishment of its remedial purposes, regardless of whether similarly-worded provisions of federal laws or regulations have been or continue to be construed otherwise.

rollCalls.title: Relates to access to fair and transparent real estate listings
rollCalls.summary: Requires timely public advertising or marketing of listed residential properties on platforms accessible to the general public; permits non-public marketing only where the seller gives informed, written direction after receiving a standardized state disclosure that clearly explains the risks and tradeoffs of withholding a listing from public marketing.

rollCalls.title: Requires the board of elections to notify victims of domestic violence whose registration is maintained as confidential of the expiration of the confidentiality of such registration records
rollCalls.summary: Requires the board of elections to notify victims of domestic violence whose registration is maintained as confidential of the expiration of the confidentiality of such registration records; requires such notice to include information on a new application for confidentiality of records.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring regulations to permit tuition waivers for certain firefighters and fire officers for CUNY until July 1, 2028
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions of law relating to requiring regulations to permit tuition waivers for certain firefighters and fire officers for CUNY until July 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain tuition waivers for police officer students of the city university of New York
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain tuition waivers for police officer students of the city university of New York to 2028.

rollCalls.title: Requires reporting of the tick-borne disease of Alpha-gal syndrome
rollCalls.summary: Requires reporting of the tick-borne disease of Alpha-gal syndrome.

rollCalls.title: Extends certain provisions relating to the boarding of out of state incarcerated individuals
rollCalls.summary: Extends certain provisions relating to the boarding of out of state incarcerated individuals until September 1, 2029.

rollCalls.title: Relates to use of accrued sick time, compensation time or vacation time
rollCalls.summary: Relates to use of accrued sick time, compensation time or vacation time.

rollCalls.title: Requires insurers to cover the substitution of a brand name prescription drug when the federal food and drug administration has declared that there is a supply issue with a generic drug
rollCalls.summary: Requires insurers to cover the substitution of a brand name prescription drug when the federal food and drug administration has declared that there is a supply issue with a generic drug.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to including dental implants, replacement dental prosthetic appliances, crowns and root canals as medically necessary dental care and services for coverage under the Medicaid program
rollCalls.summary: Includes implants, replacement dental prosthetic appliances, crowns and root canals as medically necessary dental care and services for coverage under the Medicaid program if a qualified dentist authorizes the procedures.

rollCalls.title: Increases the time frame for payments of certain expenses by adoptive parents
rollCalls.summary: Increases the time frame for payments of certain expenses by adoptive parents to 180 days prior to birth and 45 days after birth.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the commissioner of the department of civil service to reinstate Daniel Montalto on the eligible civil service list for employment as a police officer in the town of Shawangunk
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Daniel Montalto to take the competitive civil service exam for the position of police officer and be placed on the eligible civil service list for employment as a full-time police officer for the town of Shawangunk.

rollCalls.title: Relates to defining "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption
rollCalls.summary: Defines "period of war" for the alternative veterans' exemption.

rollCalls.title: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated individuals
rollCalls.summary: Establishes visiting policies for incarcerated people, to provide incarcerated people opportunities for personal contact with relatives, friends, clergy, volunteers and other persons to promote better institutional adjustment and better community adjustment upon release.

rollCalls.title: Includes image-guided biopsies under certain insurance coverage for breast cancer screening
rollCalls.summary: Includes image-guided biopsies under mandatory insurance coverage for breast cancer screening.

rollCalls.title: Relates to tax credits for volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
rollCalls.summary: Provides that for taxable years beginning on and after January first, two thousand twenty-six, a resident taxpayer who serves as an active volunteer firefighter or as a volunteer ambulance worker shall be allowed a credit against the tax imposed equal to eight hundred dollars; provides for a real property tax exemption under certain circumstances to an enrolled member of an incorporated volunteer fire company, fire department or incorporated voluntary ambulance service residing in such city, village, town, school district, special district, fire district or county.

rollCalls.title: Requires the department of health examine heat related deaths in the state of New York
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of health examine heat-related deaths in the state of New York; requires the department to issue a report to the temporary president of the senate, speaker of the assembly and the governor.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Firefighter's Benevolent Association
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the Nesconset Volunteer Exempt Firefighter's Benevolent Association; provides for the purpose of such association, and its use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes.

rollCalls.title: Requires body armor worn by New York city emergency services personnel to be replaced every five years
rollCalls.summary: Requires body armor worn by New York city emergency services personnel to be replaced every five years.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes full-time college students to act as election inspectors and poll clerks in the election district where their colleges are located
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes, under certain circumstances, full-time college and university students to act as election inspectors and poll clerks in the election district where their college or university is located.

rollCalls.title: Relates to special accidental death benefits paid to a deceased member's children
rollCalls.summary: Increases the duration of special accidental death benefits paid to a deceased member's children.

rollCalls.title: Relates to reporting on food security trends
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of public health to annually report on food security trends.

rollCalls.title: Transfers certain state property located in the town of Queensbury to the county of Warren
rollCalls.summary: Transfers certain state property owned by the New York state division of military and naval affairs located in the town of Queensbury to the county of Warren provided certain requirements are met.

rollCalls.title: Relates to local block anesthesia certificate
rollCalls.summary: Provides that a dental hygienist shall not administer local block anesthesia without a certificate and except under the personal supervision of a dentist and in conjunction with the performance of dental hygiene procedures authorized by law and in accordance with regulations promulgated by the commissioner.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Hachaim Veshalom to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Hachaim Veshalom to file an application for a retroactive real property tax exemption with the county of Nassau assessor.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "no gambling ads for kids act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "no gambling ads for kids act" under which certain covered platforms and social media platforms are prohibited from advertising a service permitting gaming-related gambling, predictive market wagering, online sweepstakes gaming, sports-related gambling, and/or traditional online gambling to minors.

rollCalls.title: Relates to winter road maintenance data collection and monitoring
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a standardized statewide system for collecting, recording, and monitoring winter road maintenance operational data in order to improve efficiency, enhance transparency, and support the protection of water resources in the state of New York; requires calibration of all deicing material application equipment used for winter highway maintenance on public roads.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act.

rollCalls.title: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits
rollCalls.summary: Provides that a microbusiness licensee authorized to conduct retail sales may serve as a processor and cultivator for purposes of cannabis showcase event permits.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Cong Ahavas Yisrael, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2026 assessment roll and all of the 2025-2026 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "extended producer responsibility for artificial turf act of 2026"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "extended producer responsibility for artificial turf act".

rollCalls.title: Relates to e-scooter mobile app disclosures
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits electric scooter service platforms operating a digital network from operating electric scooters in this state unless such platform displays a warning that persons under 18 years of age are not allowed to operate electric scooters through the platform; imposes a penalty for violations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns
rollCalls.summary: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns; requires the division of state police to maintain statewide records of individuals who have waived the right to purchase firearms, rifles, or shotguns and any revocations of such waivers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a competency restoration workgroup to evaluate
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a competency restoration workgroup to evaluate and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the competency restoration process as it relates to defendants who are being evaluated and receiving restoration under article seven hundred thirty of the criminal procedure law to permit legal proceedings to resume without undue delay.

rollCalls.title: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county
rollCalls.summary: Permits Yates county assistant district attorneys and assistant public defenders to reside in Monroe county.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the establishment of certain water charges for hospitals and charities in New York city
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the establishment of certain water charges for hospitals and charities in New York city from September 1, 2026 until September 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the provision of criminal history background checks free of charge to mentoring programs operated by not-for-profit corporations
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the provision of criminal history background checks free of charge to mentoring programs operated by not-for-profit corporations.

rollCalls.title: Assesses a separate tax on distributions from designated settlement funds
rollCalls.summary: Assesses a 100% tax on distributions from the federal anti-weaponization fund; provides that such tax shall not be reduced pursuant to any deduction, exemption or credit.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions relating to public hearings on proposed rules until January 1, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for medical professionals
rollCalls.summary: Requires cultural awareness and competence training for medical professionals, including two hours of course work or training encompassing minority healthcare issues; provides an exemption for certain individuals; requires hospitals and facilities to request documentation of the completion of training from employees and prospective employees.

rollCalls.title: Directs the commissioner of education to require public schools to report on compliance with art education instruction requirements
rollCalls.summary: Directs the state education commissioner to require public school districts to report on compliance with art education instruction requirements.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the New York state first home savings program to authorize first time home buyers to establish savings accounts to buy their first home
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the New York state first home savings program to authorize first time home buyers to establish savings accounts to buy their first home.

rollCalls.title: Requires third-party food delivery services maintain insurance through a group policy that covers bodily injury or death arising out of or resulting from qualifying accidents involving a delivery person
rollCalls.summary: Requires third-party food delivery services maintain insurance through a group policy that covers bodily injury or death arising out of or resulting from qualifying accidents involving a delivery person.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a town of Huntington deer management pilot program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a town of Huntington deer management pilot program.

rollCalls.title: Establishes an indirect source review for certain warehouse operations
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an indirect source review for heavy distribution warehouse operations; requires the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study regarding zero-emissions zones.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prohibiting certain suicide prevention and mental health services hotlines from being automated
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of mental health to promulgate rules and regulations prohibiting any suicide prevention or mental health services hotline operated or sponsored by the state from being automated.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the provision of financial assistance to museums, zoos, botanical gardens, aquariums and other cultural institutions located in low-income urban, suburban or rural communities
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the provision of financial assistance to museums, zoos, botanical gardens, aquariums and other cultural institutions located in low-income urban, suburban or rural communities, or that provide educational services to students from such communities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area
rollCalls.summary: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area; provides for a rebate program; provides for a process for application and certification.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain health care providers to disclose their disciplinary status to current and new patients
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain health care providers to disclose disciplinary status to current and new patients.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the Sickle Cell Treatment Act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the "Sickle Cell Treatment Act" which designates sickle cell centers for excellence and outpatient treatment centers.

rollCalls.title: Directs empire state development, in conjunction with the office of general services, to create plans for the development of mixed-use commercial and residential property at, and redesign of, the Harriman campus
rollCalls.summary: Directs empire state development, in conjunction with the office of general services, to create a plan to develop mixed-use commercial and residential property on a certain portion of the Harriman campus; directs such plan to be completed and made available for public comment no later than 180 days after the effective date; directs empire state development, in conjunction with the office of general services, to create a master plan for the redesign of the Harriman campus; directs that such plan be completed and made available for public comment no later than one year after the effective date.

rollCalls.title: Provides for automatic enrollment and recertification simplification for Medicaid eligible recipients
rollCalls.summary: Provides for automatic enrollment and recertification simplification for Medicaid managed care plans and long term care plans.

rollCalls.title: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules
rollCalls.summary: Relates to owner liability for failure of an operator to comply with street cleaning parking rules; relates to access to records prepared pursuant to street cleaning parking rules.

rollCalls.title: Extends the time period for recovery of energy performance contract costs incurred by school districts
rollCalls.summary: Extends the time period from eighteen years to twenty-five years that a school shall be guaranteed recovery of energy performance contract costs from energy savings incurred by school districts over that time period.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study on the formation and control of a state public bank
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study to evaluate and make recommendations concerning the formation and control of a state public bank; provides if such study finds that the state bank is feasible, the commission may recommend legislation to create a state public bank for New York.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the mental health educational opportunity program and the mental health higher educational opportunity program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the mental health educational opportunity program and the mental health higher educational opportunity program to provide additional educational opportunities for students at certain universities and colleges in the state to enroll in academic programs that lead to a degree or degrees required for licensure in any of the mental health professions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requirements for a building owner to refuse to renew a lease under the real estate industry stabilization code
rollCalls.summary: Relates to requirements for a building owner to refuse to renew a lease under the real estate industry stabilization code; requires the owner of a building to be demolished to prove that such owner has the financial ability to complete demolition of the building.

rollCalls.title: Designates the Honor and Remember Flag as the official state flag for recognizing armed services members
rollCalls.summary: Designates the "Honor and Remember Flag" as the official state flag for recognizing armed service members who have died as a result of serving the United States in any war or conflict the nation has been involved in since its inception.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the sale of ATVs and off-highway motorcycles in the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale of ATVs and off-highway motorcycles in the city of New York; provides enforcement mechanisms and penalties.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the right to breast feed
rollCalls.summary: Makes certain terms gender neutral in provisions regarding the right to breast feed.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the New York state and local employees' retirement system to accept an application for disability retirement benefits from Andrew Reilly, Jr.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the New York state and local employees' retirement system to accept an application for disability retirement benefits from Andrew Reilly, Jr.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the use of restraints on incarcerated individuals during labor, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant persons during a custodial interrogation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of restraints on and the use of force against incarcerated individuals during labor and incarcerated individuals who have experienced different pregnancy outcomes, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant and post-pregnancy persons during a custodial interrogation; provides for certain exceptions for restraints to be used and in such case limits the use to wrist restraints.

rollCalls.title: Relates to advanced transmission technologies
rollCalls.summary: Directs electric corporations and combination electric and gas corporations to file a cost-effectiveness and timetable analysis as part of any base rate proceeding with the public service commission; directs NYSERDA to conduct a study on the effectiveness of advanced transmission technologies.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to "Trooper Edward L. Cunningham"
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in Nassau county to "Trooper Edward L. Cunningham".

rollCalls.title: Requires the commissioner of education to establish Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander history and civic impact curriculum or instructions for school districts
rollCalls.summary: Requires the commissioner to establish Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander history and civic impact curriculum or instructions for school districts.

rollCalls.title: Relates to treatment of gains from qualified opportunity zones in calculating taxable income
rollCalls.summary: Relates to treatment of gains from qualified opportunity zones in calculating taxable income; removes exclusion of gains on property in qualified opportunity zones in calculation of income.

rollCalls.title: Designates March twenty-first as Down Syndrome Awareness Day
rollCalls.summary: Designates March twenty-first as a day of commemoration to be known as "Down Syndrome Awareness Day".

rollCalls.title: Establishes the rural suicide prevention council
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the rural suicide prevention council to identify barriers to mental health and substance use treatment and prevention services and other policies, practices, resources, services, and potential legislation that aim to reduce death by suicide and suicide attempts and acknowledge the demographic and cultural differences in rural communities; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption
rollCalls.summary: Allows brewery supply stores to sell New York state labelled beer for off-premises consumption.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "criminal court opinion transparency act"
rollCalls.summary: Requires the chief administrator of the courts to submit a report to the legislature and the governor on: an evaluation of the feasibility and benefit of publishing suppression rulings rendered by trial-level criminal courts and/or collection of data regarding such rulings; whether the publication of additional decisions and/or collection of data would improve the practice of law; an evaluation of the means by which such publication and/or collection of data may be effectuated to improve transparency and the public understanding of these courts; an assessment of any further resources that would be necessary to support increased publication or data collection; and recommendations regarding legislation and administrative measures that could be taken.

rollCalls.title: Establishes city community improvement projects
rollCalls.summary: Allows property owners to petition for city community improvement projects involving local improvements to shared driveways and sewer systems.

rollCalls.title: Relates to enacting the "traveling with dignity act"
rollCalls.summary: Provides for adult changing tables to be placed within an enclosed restroom facility or other similar private facility that is for use by persons with disabilities who need help with diapering at commercial places of public amusement and state-owned buildings open to the public.

rollCalls.title: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded
rollCalls.summary: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded; mandates that the prime contractor use such enterprise identified on the utilization plan, unless such enterprise cannot perform or is no longer state certified.

rollCalls.title: Relates to expanding the FreshConnect program
rollCalls.summary: Expands the FreshConnect program, which provides rebates for the purchase of local produce to certain people, to include local produce sold in supermarkets and grocery stores.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the county of Clinton to employ retired former members of the division of state police as special patrol officers
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the county of Clinton to employ retired former members of the division of state police as special patrol officers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code
rollCalls.summary: Relates to conducting investigations into the administration and enforcement of the New York state uniform fire prevention and building code and the New York state energy conservation construction code by counties.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a floating solar incentive and education program
rollCalls.summary: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to establish a floating solar incentive and education program to provide information and resources including technical assistance, access to industry standards, and financing available through the authority or other public or private sector sources, to municipalities, developers, builders, design professionals, and potential owners for the construction of floating solar.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the health, safety and human rights of incarcerated pregnant individuals, incarcerated birthing parents of children and their children
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the health, safety and human rights of incarcerated pregnant individuals, incarcerated birthing parents and their children; requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to establish rules and regulations relating to conditions in institutions and correctional facilities and the treatment and care of birthing parents in such institutions and facilities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to onsite overdose response services and requires certain locations and venues to maintain a supply of opioid antagonists
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the commissioner of health to establish standards for approval of onsite overdose response services; requires nightlife establishments, sporting or event centers, theaters, concert venues, and amusement parks to maintain a supply of opioid antagonists; provides that emergency use of opioid antagonist is covered by good Samaritan law.

rollCalls.title: Relates to service retirement benefits for uniformed sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Provides that for New York city uniformed sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

rollCalls.title: Relates to service retirement benefits for uniformed correction members of the New York city employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Provides that for New York city uniformed correction revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the farm ownership succession planning program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the farm ownership succession planning program to provide farm owners with a succession planning toolkit that can be used by such farm owners who plan on selling or closing their farm.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the functions of the Medicaid inspector general with respect to audit and review of medical assistance program funds
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Medicaid inspector general to comply with standards relating to the audit and review of medical assistance program funds.

rollCalls.title: Directs the office of children and family services to establish a center for fatherhood initiatives
rollCalls.summary: Directs the office of children and family services to establish a center for fatherhood initiatives to issue grants to initiatives regarding the promotion and advancement of fatherhood, including but not limited to all underserved fatherhood groups to help expand opportunities to improve parenting knowledge, attitudes, and self-efficacy.

rollCalls.title: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the POW-MIA Memorial Highway
rollCalls.summary: Changes the official name of the Staten Island Expressway to the "POW-MIA Memorial Highway".

rollCalls.title: Relates to protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners
rollCalls.summary: Enacts protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners; requires certain notifications from creditors and debt collectors; prohibits acceleration; enacts provisions for cosigner release.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of North Haven to reduce the maximum speed limit along certain designated streets
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of North Haven, county of Suffolk, to reduce the maximum speed limit along certain designated streets in such village to not less than twenty miles per hour.

rollCalls.title: Adds hazardous air quality to the state definition of a disaster and includes air quality emergency preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans
rollCalls.summary: Adds hazardous air quality to the state definition of a disaster; requires explicit inclusion of air quality emergency preparedness in local comprehensive emergency management plans with an action plan and annual inventory of air quality emergency resources.

rollCalls.title: Waives fishing, hunting and trapping license fees for certain first responders
rollCalls.summary: Waives fishing, hunting and trapping license fees for certain first responders.

rollCalls.title: Establishes distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates and provides that the funding for such be deposited in the Alzheimer's disease assistance fund
rollCalls.summary: Relates to establishing distinctive "Alzheimer's Awareness" license plates; provides that the funding for such be deposited in the "Alzheimer's disease assistance fund".

rollCalls.title: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the New York state youth in agriculture and entrepreneurship summer employment program to provide students with the opportunity to be educated on the agricultural industry and alternative career paths and to provide agricultural work experience and entrepreneurship work experience.

rollCalls.title: Relates to land used in agricultural production
rollCalls.summary: Includes certain land that is owned or rented as a farm operation for the production for sale of crops, livestock or livestock products as land used in agricultural production.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Huntington to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands to the Huntington African American Museum
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Huntington to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands to the Huntington African American Museum.

rollCalls.title: Relates to mandatory employer disclosures regarding employee compensation and benefits
rollCalls.summary: Relates to mandatory employer disclosures regarding employee compensation and benefits, including any non-salary or non-wage compensation and benefits.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "food retail establishment subsidization for healthy communities act"
