rollCalls.title: Authorizes counties to post local laws and notices via the internet
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes counties to post local laws and notices via the internet where such county doesn't have a newspaper published within the county.

rollCalls.title: Relates to food safety and quality date labeling requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain labeling to be used to indicate the safety dates and quality dates of food products; requires the department of agriculture and markets to educate consumers about such provisions.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the banking development district program and to make recommendations to improve such program
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of financial services to conduct a study on the banking development district program and to make recommendations to improve such program.

rollCalls.title: Provides for automatic voter registration and preregistration for persons applying for certain department of motor vehicles documentation, and for Medicaid enrollees
rollCalls.summary: Provides for automatic voter registration and pre-registration for persons applying for certain department of motor vehicles documentation, and for persons applying for or re-enrolling in Medicaid; allows individuals to decline such automatic registration and pre-registration.

rollCalls.title: Extends the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds
rollCalls.summary: Extends, until December 31, 2027, the authorization of residential property owners in high risk brush fire areas on Staten Island to cut and remove reeds.

rollCalls.title: Relates to access to prescription medication and coordination with workers' compensation board regulations governing network pharmacy use
rollCalls.summary: Codifies certain regulations of the workers' compensation board relating to access to prescription medication and coordination with workers' compensation board regulations governing network pharmacy use; requires the workers' compensation board to file a report on out-of-network pharmacy use within 3 years of the effective date.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions related to certified school psychologists and special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions related to certified school psychologists and special education services and programs for preschool children with handicapping conditions until June 30, 2028.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "city of Buffalo historic preservation receivership act"; provides the city of Buffalo specific procedures for the appointment of a receiver of rents in instances where the property at issue is neglected or abandoned.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the contents of claims
rollCalls.summary: Provides exceptions from the requirement of specificity in pleadings in certain cases involving sexual offenses.

rollCalls.title: Provides access to menstrual products in toilet facilities in certain public buildings
rollCalls.summary: Provides access to menstrual products in toilet facilities in public buildings owned or leased by the state that are determined to be opened to the public; requires reporting.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 11, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 11, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Designates May ninth as Opioid Awareness Day
rollCalls.summary: Designates May ninth as "Opioid Awareness Day".

rollCalls.title: Requires a lethality assessment in incidents of domestic violence
rollCalls.summary: Requires law enforcement officers to conduct a lethality assessment as part of the standardized domestic incident report form when responding to incidents of domestic violence.

rollCalls.title: Repeals provisions of the administrative code of the city of New York relating to the establishment of maximum base rents using the maximum gross building rental formula; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Repeals provisions relating to the establishment of maximum base rents using the maximum gross building rental formula.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a study on the economic impact of the establishment of kitchen incubators
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Empire State Development Corporation, in consultation with the department of agriculture and markets and the office of new Americans to conduct a study on the economic impact of the establishment of kitchen incubators; requires a report to the governor and the legislature.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prohibiting the inclusion of a confession of judgment in a contract or agreement for a financial product or service
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the inclusion of a confession of judgment in a contract or agreement for a financial product or service.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the application of fail-first or step therapy protocols to coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of serious mental health conditions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the application of fail-first or step therapy protocols to coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of serious mental health conditions; defines serious mental health condition.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent prescription substance use disorder
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent prescription substance use disorder.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the role of the commissioner of veterans' services in regards to the veterans' home assistance fund and the military family relief fund
rollCalls.summary: Directs that moneys in the veterans' home services fund shall be payable on vouchers certified by the commissioner of veterans' services; directs a report to be submitted by such commissioner; directs that moneys in the military family relief fund shall be payable on vouchers certified by the commissioner of veterans' services.

rollCalls.title: Relates to designating early polling places
rollCalls.summary: Relates to designating early polling places.

rollCalls.title: Relates to assessment and taxation of lessees and users of certain tax exempt property
rollCalls.summary: Subjects to taxation the possessory interest of a private individual or corporation which uses real property owned by the United States or the state, except for real property owned by public authorities, for business purposes; excludes private property where the use is for a concession available to the general public located on property, such as parks, available for the use of the general public.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain lease terms for BOCES properties
rollCalls.summary: Relates to certain lease terms for BOCES properties increasing the maximum rental period to 20 years.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to D'Youville Housing Association LLC for the construction of facilities on the campus of D'Youville University.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes and directs the department of public service to conduct a study on the deployment of energy interconnection processes into the electrical grid
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes and directs the department of public service to conduct a study on the deployment of energy interconnection processes into the electrical grid to meet the state's renewable energy goals; directs the department of public service to submit a report on its findings one year after the effective date.

rollCalls.title: Provides minimum basic training related to handling emergency situations involving individuals with any physical and/or developmental disability to all firefighters
rollCalls.summary: Empowers the office of fire prevention and control to, in coordination with the commissioner of the office for people with developmental disabilities and the chief disability officer, provide minimum basic training related to handling emergency situations involving individuals with any physical and/or developmental disability to all firefighters.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prohibiting the release of consumption data
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the release of a consumer's electrical or gas consumption data to any police officer, or private, local, state or federal law enforcement entity without a judicial court-ordered subpoena, warrant or the consumer's written consent.

rollCalls.title: Requires the department of environmental conservation, after consultation with the environmental facilities corporation and the department of state, to submit an annual agency stormwater expenditure report
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of environmental conservation, after consultation with the environmental facilities corporation and the department of state, to submit an annual agency stormwater expenditure report containing a comprehensive estimate and summary of funds needed and funds spent on stormwater projects under the department of environmental conservation, the environmental facilities corporation, the department of state and other applicable agencies or state authorities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the frequency and implementation of lock-down drills in schools
rollCalls.summary: Decreases the frequency of lock-down drills in schools; directs that such drills shall be implemented with a trauma-informed approach; permits parents to opt their children out of such drills.

rollCalls.title: Relates to educational leave for eligible incarcerated individuals
rollCalls.summary: Provides that for the purposes of educational leave, an eligible incarcerated individual shall include an incarcerated individual who is within two years of being an eligible incarcerated individual.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes special permits to remain open during certain hours of the morning
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes special permits to remain open during certain hours of the morning.

rollCalls.title: Relates to actions or practices that establish or maintain a monopoly, monopsony or restraint of trade, and authorizes a class action lawsuit in the state anti-trust law
rollCalls.summary: Relates to actions or practices that establish or maintain a monopoly, monopsony or restraint of trade; authorizes a class action lawsuit in the state anti-trust law.

rollCalls.title: Modifies the requirements for financial disclosures for certain state and legislative officials, officers and employees
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for financial disclosures for certain state and legislative officials, officers and employees.

rollCalls.title: Requires medical records to be made available to patients in an electronic format through a web portal
rollCalls.summary: Requires medical records to be made available to patients in an electronic format through a web portal and in a format that allows patients to save records to their own device; requires electronic medical records systems to give qualified persons access to records in a single, secure format and to establish policies and procedures to endure confidentiality.

rollCalls.title: Ensures that parents and guardians of youth are notified when their child is arrested
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the issuance of arrest warrants upon a youth who is still in high school; provides for the police officer to make a reasonable effort to notify the parent or other person legally responsible for the care of such youth or with whom the youth is domiciled that the youth has been arrested; provides that the police officer need not notify the parent or other person legally responsible when such youth is not also a juvenile offender and the notification would endanger the health and safety of such youth; amends provisions relating to sexually exploited children to include persons under the age of nineteen.

rollCalls.title: Provides a filing extension for the "enhanced" STAR exemption to eligible applicants
rollCalls.summary: Provides a filing extension for the "enhanced" STAR exemption to initial applicants provided that such applicants have not been granted such extension before and such applicants are otherwise entitled to the exemption.

rollCalls.title: Increases compensation of election inspectors to $300 and coordinators to $350 in New York city
rollCalls.summary: Increases compensation of election inspectors to $300 and coordinators to $350 in New York city.

rollCalls.title: Provides for victim statements at the sentencing of a defendant for a misdemeanor
rollCalls.summary: Provides for victim statements, or statements from anyone designated by a victim to speak, at the sentencing of a defendant for certain misdemeanors.

rollCalls.title: Establishes protections for minors who are featured in compensated video content
rollCalls.summary: Establishes protections for minors who are featured in compensated video content that generate earnings from being shared on social media or other video-sharing websites.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2024 assessment roll and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways
rollCalls.summary: Adds Salmon Creek in Monroe County to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "home utility weatherization jobs act"; requires each gas corporation, electric corporation, or combination gas or electric corporation to submit to the public service commission for review and approval at least one and up to ten neighborhood scale weatherization and electrification-ready projects.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the participation of certain animals in traveling animal acts
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the participation of certain animals in traveling animal acts; prohibits the department of environmental conservation from issuing permits or licenses allowing participation of certain animals in traveling animal acts; excludes certain permanent performing institutions; imposes a civil penalty not to exceed $1000 for a violation.

rollCalls.title: Requires public agencies to establish preliminary license application procedures to determine whether an applicant for a license would be ineligible for such license based on criminal history
rollCalls.summary: Requires public agencies to establish preliminary license application procedures to determine whether an applicant for a license would be ineligible for such license based on criminal history; establishes time frames for public agencies to respond to such applications; requires public agencies to report information regarding granting licenses annually.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city school district of the city of Salamanca to establish a reserve fund for federal impact aid in the event such aid is reduced.

rollCalls.title: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers
rollCalls.summary: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the penalty for the abandonment of animals
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the penalty for the abandonment of animals is a misdemeanor, punishable by imprisonment for not more than one year, or by a fine of not less than five hundred dollars nor more than one thousand dollars, or by both.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the inspection of certain vacated or abandoned properties for abandoned companion animals
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the inspection of property that has been vacated or abandoned for abandoned companion animals.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the sentencing for the crime of aggravated cruelty to animals
rollCalls.summary: Enacts "Tucker's law"; removes the provision that provides that any term of imprisonment for a violation of aggravated cruelty to animals may not exceed two years.

rollCalls.title: Relates to an individual's right to request a hearing regarding an unemployment insurance benefits claim
rollCalls.summary: Relates to an individual's right to request a hearing regarding an unemployment insurance benefits claim; provides such a hearing can be requested if benefits or a written notice of determination denying their claim are not received within thirty days of providing all required information.

rollCalls.title: Adds Falls Brook, Jones Brook, Kelso Brook, Minerva Stream, and Trout Brook to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization
rollCalls.summary: Adds Falls Brook, Jones Brook, Kelso Brook, Minerva Stream, and Trout Brook to the definition of inland waterways for the purposes of waterfront revitalization.

rollCalls.title: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats
rollCalls.summary: Restricts the performance of surgical devocalization procedures on dogs and cats; prohibited for reasons of convenience in keeping or handling a dog or cat.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a civil remedy for the protection of animals denied proper care
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a civil remedy for the protection of animals denied proper care by creating a special proceeding in the supreme court that will hold owners and caretakers liable if such animals under their care are mistreated.

rollCalls.title: Adds animal fighting to the definition of criminal activity for purposes of enterprise corruption crimes
rollCalls.summary: Includes animal fighting as a criminal act for purposes of enterprise corruption crimes.

rollCalls.title: Requires chain restaurants to label menu items that have a high content of sodium
rollCalls.summary: Requires chain restaurants to place an icon on menus next to food items that have a high content of sodium.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products.

rollCalls.title: Relates to microchipping of certain animals possessed by animal protective associations and rescue organizations
rollCalls.summary: Permits microchipping of certain animals possessed by animal protective associations and rescue organizations.

rollCalls.title: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc. from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the Caughdenoy Volunteer Fire Department, Inc., within the town of Central Square, Oswego county from the forty-five percent limit on non-resident members.

rollCalls.title: Relates to qualifications for holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery
rollCalls.summary: Allows persons holding the office of correction officer in the county of Montgomery to be a resident of certain other counties.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices; requires such informational pamphlet to be available on the department of health's website; requires practitioners to distribute such informational pamphlet to patients seeking contraceptives.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based solely on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the definition of coal tar and its use in pavement products
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the definition of coal tar and its use in pavement products.

rollCalls.title: Requires accurate interpretation of statements made by deponents with limited English proficiency in accusatory instruments and supporting depositions
rollCalls.summary: Provides that an accusatory instrument or supporting deposition consisting of factual allegations by a deponent with limited English proficiency is not sufficient unless accompanied by a sworn statement from an interpreter affirming the accuracy of the English interpretation.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 6, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 6, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the administration of certain funds and accounts related to the 2026-2027 budget, authorizing certain payments and transfers
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the administration of certain funds and accounts related to the 2026-2027 budget, authorizing certain loans, payments and transfers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers
rollCalls.summary: Relates to establishing minimum standards for payment plans for eligible customers; requires the public service commission to set standards for payment plans for certain customers including reasonableness of agreements and timelines for payment; establishes eligibility.

rollCalls.title: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness and increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients
rollCalls.summary: Expands the eligibility period for indigent legal service attorneys to receive certain loan forgiveness; increases loan reimbursement for certain attorneys who work in legal services with indigent clients.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the terms of office of commissioners of elections
rollCalls.summary: Increases the term of office of an election commissioner from two to four years beginning January first of each odd numbered year.

rollCalls.title: Expands the applicability of the assessment exemption for living quarters for parent or grandparent
rollCalls.summary: Expands the applicability of the assessment exemption for living quarters for parent or grandparent to include living quarters constructed or reconstructed before the effective date of the section providing such exemption.

rollCalls.title: Requires genetic testing results only be received by patients and health care providers providing direct care while health insurance companies only receive a record that the genetic testing was performed
rollCalls.summary: Requires genetic testing results only be received by patients and health care providers providing direct care while health insurance companies only receive a record that the genetic testing was performed; provides insurers cannot require access to genetic testing results and cannot take adverse action against someone for not providing genetic testing results.

rollCalls.title: Provides the New York city water board shall not establish a limit of less than six years to challenge any service charges for the use of or services furnished by the water board
rollCalls.summary: Provides the NYC water board shall not establish a limit of less than six years to challenge any fee, rate, rent or other service charges for the use of or services furnished by the water board and/or sewerage systems.

rollCalls.title: Permits schools to allow fire departments to make a recruitment presentation in a high school
rollCalls.summary: Permits the principal of any high school to allow any local fire department, upon request, to enter the school for the purpose of fire department junior recruitment, including, but not limited to: making presentations; disseminating literature; and answering questions by students.

rollCalls.title: Relates to designating the month of May "Maternal Mental Health Awareness Month"
rollCalls.summary: Relates to designating the month of May as "Maternal Mental Health Awareness Month".

rollCalls.title: Relates to designating the month of May "Korean American Family Month"
rollCalls.summary: Relates to designating the month of May as "Korean American Family Month".

rollCalls.title: Requires any website or mobile application associated with an electronic benefit transfer system to be offered in the twelve most common non-English languages
rollCalls.summary: Requires any website or mobile application associated with an electronic benefit transfer system to be offered in the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by limited-English proficient individuals in the state, based on data in the most recent American Community Survey published by the United States Census Bureau.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the chief administrator of the courts shall submit annually a report on the Drug Treatment Court Program during the preceding year
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the chief administrator of the courts shall submit annually a report on the administration, function and effectiveness of the Drug Treatment Court Program during the preceding year.

rollCalls.title: Relates to pre-trip safety checks for charter buses
rollCalls.summary: Requires motor carriers that operate charter buses to have pre-trip safety briefings on the mandatory use of safety belts by passengers and fines for such violations.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the implementation of certain parts of the state fiscal plan for the 2026-2027 state fiscal year
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the South Country central school district, in the county of Suffolk, to issue serial bonds for the purpose of liquidating deficits in its general fund; requires that the district prepare quarterly budget reports, quarterly trial balances; provides for advance aid to such school district (Part A); extends provisions of law relating to directing the state inspector general to appoint an independent monitor for the Orange county industrial development agency for one year (Part B).

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through May 4, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through May 4, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the completion of training requirements for sheriffs and undersheriffs
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the completion of training requirements for sheriffs and undersheriffs; directs the municipal police training council to promulgate rules and regulations relating to qualification for municipal police forces for persons who were previously sworn members of the state police and to provide certificates to such persons who meet such qualifications.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the revocation of a person's driver's license who has been convicted of operating a vessel while under the influence of alcohol or drugs
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the revocation of a person's driver's license who has been convicted of operating a vessel while under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the impact of hospital closures on healthcare access in the state
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of health to complete a report of the impact of hospital closures on healthcare access in the state.

rollCalls.title: Relates to article 78 judgments regarding disability pension determinations
rollCalls.summary: Permits court ruling in favor of a petitioner appealing the denial of a disability pension determination to grant disability pension.

rollCalls.title: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage for doula services as required coverage for maternity care
rollCalls.summary: Requires health insurance policies to include coverage for doula services as required coverage for maternity care.

rollCalls.title: Relates to reporting requirements of SUNY and CUNY
rollCalls.summary: Relates to reporting requirements of SUNY and CUNY; relates to financial information and identifying vendor information of each contract; relates to a list of all foundation and state university employees by campus, department and location including salaries, job titles and descriptions.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Port Authority Police Officer Arthur M. Ansert Jr.
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system including the bridge on the South Service Road, between Federal Circle and Perimeter Road Overpass, crossing over the Van Wyck Expressway in Jamaica to Port Authority Police Officer Arthur M. Ansert Jr.

rollCalls.title: Extends the urban deer management pilot program
rollCalls.summary: Extends the urban deer management pilot program for an additional three years.

rollCalls.title: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide thirty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase
rollCalls.summary: Requires gas and electric corporations to provide thirty days' notice to customers whenever there is a service rate or charge increase.

rollCalls.title: Includes contacts via text, email, private message, direct message or other electronic communication in the definition of the offense of aggravated harassment in the second degree
rollCalls.summary: Includes contacts via text, email, private message, direct message or other electronic communication in the definition of the offense of aggravated harassment in the second degree.

rollCalls.title: Relates to awards made to crime victims
rollCalls.summary: Increases the amount for awards made to crime victims; specifies certain items of personal property which are necessary and essential to the welfare of a claimant.

rollCalls.title: Allows industrial development agencies to make grants to municipalities for open space preservation, parkland improvements and conservation easements
rollCalls.summary: Allows industrial development agencies to make grants to municipalities for open space preservation, parkland improvements and conservation easements where the municipal governing body finds that the grant encourages tourism or otherwise improves quality of life.

rollCalls.title: Relates to releasing victims of domestic violence from certain contracts
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes one or more individuals who are under a shared contract to opt-out of such contract without a fee, penalty or charge due to status as a domestic violence victim; prohibits the company from transferring any contractual or billing responsibility of such shared contract to any other account holders on such shared contract; prevents companies from prohibiting a person who has opted-out due to domestic violence status to enter into a new contract.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the lab services accessibility act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the lab services accessibility act.

rollCalls.title: Includes certain persons of Middle Eastern and North African heritage and speakers of Haitian Creole as language minorities
rollCalls.summary: Includes certain persons of Middle Eastern and North African heritage and speakers of Haitian Creole as language minorities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to reports and awards by the office of victim services
rollCalls.summary: Requires the office of victim services to publicize programs offered by the office and to include certain information in annual reports to the governor and the legislature and to make such reports public on the office's website.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes where the victim is under the extreme influence of any substance which renders them incapable of appraising or controlling such victim's conduct and incapable of clearly expressing lack of consent.

rollCalls.title: Requires railroad corporations to conduct a comprehensive safety inspection when a freight train is parked in a train yard prior to traveling on tracks within the state
rollCalls.summary: Requires railroad corporations to conduct a comprehensive safety inspection when a freight train is parked in a train yard prior to traveling on tracks within the state including, but not be limited to, a review of tracks, safety equipment, including brakes, and train cars.

rollCalls.title: Relates to forfeiture of a beneficiary's right to benefits upon conviction of a family offense
rollCalls.summary: Permits a retired member to change their option election or designate a new beneficiary where the beneficiary has been convicted of a family offense.

rollCalls.title: Relates to notification of crime victims of the death of the accused
rollCalls.summary: Requires the notification of a crime victim or witness of the death of the accused if such person dies during pending judicial proceedings or during any period of incarceration, parole or post-release supervision, or when an order of protection exists.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a co-shelter toolkit
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a co-shelter toolkit of best practices, resources, case studies and other information deemed helpful to inform and encourage the implementation and sustenance of co-shelter models for victims of domestic violence and people experiencing homelessness with companion animals; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Requires the office for the prevention of domestic violence provide informational materials on removing an abuser's access to a smart home
rollCalls.summary: Requires the office for the prevention of domestic violence provide informational materials on removing an abuser's access to a smart home and the use of other technology for harassment.

rollCalls.title: Changes the due date by which the New York State teachers' retirement system is required to submit the annual MWBE report
rollCalls.summary: Changes the due date by which the New York State teachers' retirement system is required to submit the annual MWBE report to on or before December thirty-first following the end of the teachers retirement system's fiscal year.

rollCalls.title: Relates to notification of victims of crime, including sexual offenses, about the address confidentiality program
rollCalls.summary: Requires notification of victims of crime, including sexual offenses, about the address confidentiality program.

rollCalls.title: Establishes uniform waiting list priorities for domestic violence survivors applying for public housing
rollCalls.summary: Establishes uniform waiting list priorities for domestic violence survivors applying for public housing.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain mandatory disclosures for job advertisements
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain mandatory disclosures for printed or digital job advertisements by an employer or third-party job posting entity; provides for the imposition of a fine of $2,500 for violations.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay; imposes a five-year moratorium on placing sediment or fill in the borrow pits in Jamaica Bay.

rollCalls.title: Exempts the village of Williamsville fire department from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of its membership
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the village of Williamsville fire department, located in the village of Williamsville, county of Erie, from the requirement that the percentage of non-resident fire department members not exceed forty-five percent of its membership.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 30, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 30, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Exempts certain income for the purpose of determining aid provided pursuant to public assistance programs
rollCalls.summary: Exempts aid derived from funding from childcare stabilization grants, childcare desert funding, or other non-recurring funding, issued by the office of children and family services to childcare providers from income for the purpose of determining aid provided pursuant to public assistance programs.

rollCalls.title: Requires the department of veterans' services to establish and maintain a database of resources available in the state for veterans, members of the uniformed services, and their families
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of veterans' services to establish and maintain, in consultation and collaboration with other state agencies, a searchable database on the department's website providing resources available in the state for veterans, members of the uniformed services, and their families.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes municipalities and the department of financial services to seek civil penalties for violations of the duty to maintain a foreclosed property
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes municipalities and the department of financial services to seek civil penalties for violations of the duty to maintain a foreclosed property in an amount of up to $650 per day for each day such violation persists after the judgement of foreclosure has been issued.

rollCalls.title: Establishes "DJ's law" requiring training for police officers on discharging a firearm at a moving vehicle
rollCalls.summary: Enacts "DJ's law" which requires training for police officers on discharging a firearm at a moving vehicle; requires the municipal police training council to develop and disseminate written policies and procedures regarding such force.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position.

rollCalls.title: Requires notaries public and commissioners of deeds to complete and retain certain documents relating to the transfer of residential real property
rollCalls.summary: Requires notaries public and commissioners of deeds to complete and retain certain documents relating to the transfer of residential real property; relates to forgery and offering a false document concerning residential real property.

rollCalls.title: Requires owners of certain large vessels to establish whale strike prevention policies
rollCalls.summary: Requires owners of certain large vessels to establish whale strike prevention policies; establishes penalties for failure to establish such policies.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a study regarding doula friendly work spaces
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a study regarding doula friendly work spaces; requires a report.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against them in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against them in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance.

rollCalls.title: Requires that in the event a complaint made to local code enforcement results in the issuance of a compliance order, the complainant shall also be provided a copy of such order
rollCalls.summary: Requires that when a complaint is made to local code enforcement of a violation of the uniform fire prevention and building code or a local code which results in the issuance of a compliance order, the complainant shall also be provided a copy of such order.

rollCalls.title: Relates to expenses in matrimonial actions
rollCalls.summary: Relates to expenses in matrimonial actions; establishes there is a rebuttable presumption that certain itemized bills or invoices shall be admissible in evidence.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the expungement of syringe convictions
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the expungement of syringe convictions of criminally possessing a hypodermic instrument.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without consent
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits hospitals and health care providers from storing credit card information without signed written consent and requires disclosure if such information could be used to pay balances.

rollCalls.title: Facilitates appellate review of rulings that implicate issues of public concern
rollCalls.summary: Relates to facilitating appellate review of rulings that implicate issues of public concern.

rollCalls.title: Relates to granting employees access to personnel records
rollCalls.summary: Grants employees access to personnel records; requires notice of negative information in such records and an opportunity for a review; permits employee to include certain information in personnel records.

rollCalls.title: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control
rollCalls.summary: Relates to failure to complete a program for time allowances due to circumstances beyond an individual's control.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes vocational training, where practicable, to incarcerated individuals on the installation of solar hot water systems for the provision of hot water to correctional facilities
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes vocational training, where practicable, to incarcerated individuals on the installation of solar hot water systems for the provision of hot water to correctional facilities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the organization of industrial development agencies
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the organization of industrial development agencies and the definition of labor organization.

rollCalls.title: Categorizes the assault of certain employees of the New York city department of buildings or the New York city department of housing preservation and development as a class D felony
rollCalls.summary: Categorizes the assault of certain employees of the New York city department of buildings or the New York city department of housing preservation and development as a class D felony.

rollCalls.title: Relates to recovery of online accounts for mobile telephones
rollCalls.summary: Requires that businesses that provide consumers with online accounts to access services accounts for mobile telephones using proper identification if the business has a physical presence in this state.

rollCalls.title: Establishes mandatory minimum medicaid coverage for hospital confinement for childbirth
rollCalls.summary: Requires all insurance policies and health maintenance organization contracts to provide coverage for maternity patients and their newborns for hospital stays of at least 48 hours following childbirth by natural delivery and 96 hours following childbirth by caesarean section; provides such coverage for patients who are recipients of medicaid.

rollCalls.title: Exempts the purchase of certain oral hygiene products from the payment of sales tax
rollCalls.summary: Exempts toothpaste, toothbrushes and dental floss from the payment of sales tax.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 27, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 27, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Relates to immunization vaccines for children
rollCalls.summary: Requires the administration of certain vaccines for children in accordance with regulations issued by the commissioner, utilizing generally accepted medical standards and based on recommendations of the American Academy of Pediatrics, the American Academy of Family Physicians, the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, the American College of Physicians, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, and/or other similar nationally or internationally recognized scientific organizations; removes certain requirements for vaccines to be administered under federal guidance.

rollCalls.title: Prevents outsourcing during a hiring freeze
rollCalls.summary: Prevents an agency, department, division, commission, bureau or any other entity under the authority of the executive department from contracting, subcontracting or hiring any third party during a hiring freeze.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the electric landscaping equipment rebate program; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the electric landscaping equipment rebate program to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve air quality, and reduce noise pollution by promoting the adoption of quieter, zero-emission landscaping equipment; provides for rebates at the point of sale for applicants purchasing or leasing certain equipment; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Relates to arbitration organizations
rollCalls.summary: Relates to arbitration organizations; requires private arbitration organizations involved in fifty or more consumer arbitrations per year to collect, publish at least quarterly, and make available to the public in a computer-searchable database certain information relating to such arbitrations; prohibits financial conflicts of interest.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the division of criminal justice services from disclosing pending adjournment in contemplation of dismissals on civil records of arrests and prosecutions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the division of criminal justice services from disclosing pending orders of adjournment in contemplation of dismissal on civil records of arrests and prosecutions.

rollCalls.title: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses
rollCalls.summary: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses.

rollCalls.title: Relates to authorizing the New York state energy research and development authority to administer a program to provide grants related to enabling switching residences to electric heat pumps
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the New York state energy research and development authority to administer a program to provide grants or loans for the costs related to enabling switching residences with propane or fuel-oil heating systems to efficient electric heat pumps.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the use of the term "excited delirium" as a diagnosis, label, or cause of death
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of the term "excited delirium" as a diagnosis, label, or cause of death on death certificates, autopsy reports, police reports or any report, policy or procedure by a public agency or contractor; defines excited delirium.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "harmful algal bloom monitoring and prevention act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "harmful algal bloom monitoring and prevention act"; establishes the harmful algal bloom monitoring and prevention fund.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "beauty justice act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "beauty justice act"; provides for the regulation of ingredients in personal care products and cosmetics; prohibits the sale of personal care products and cosmetic products containing certain restricted products.

rollCalls.title: Provides lead service line identification for certain water systems
rollCalls.summary: Provides lead service line identification by a public water system that serves certain areas.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the manufactured home community preservation act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the manufactured home community preservation act to provide financial and technical assistance, within funds available to counties, municipalities, rural preservation companies, and other non-profit housing organizations for their housing preservation efforts; provides that funds in the mortgage insurance fund can be used to provide financial support to local governments and eligible non-profit housing organizations.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state after July 1, 2030.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "just energy transition act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "just energy transition act"; requires a study of competitive options to facilitate the phase-out, replacement and redevelopment of New York state's oldest and most-polluting fossil fueled generation facilities and their sites by the year 2030.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the accelerate solar for affordable power (ASAP) act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the accelerate solar for affordable power (ASAP) act to set a new target for distributed solar energy capacity and direct the public service commission to advance reforms to the utility interconnection process to ensure timely and cost-effective integration of new distributed energy resources.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the proper collection and disposal of mercury thermostats
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the proper collection and disposal of mercury thermostats; establishes a fund for the stewardship of mercury thermostats; extends the effectiveness of the mercury thermostat collection act.

rollCalls.title: Establishes state composting programs
rollCalls.summary: Requires all state agencies to establish a composting program in buildings owned, occupied or operated by such agencies; allows such agencies to arrange for collection of compostable waste by a private carter, transport such waste itself or process such waste on-site; requires reports on the costs and effectiveness of such programs.

rollCalls.title: Relates to portable solar generation devices
rollCalls.summary: Defines "portable solar generation device"; exempts portable solar generation devices from interconnection or net metering requirements; requires the state energy conservation construction code to allow for portable solar generation devices to be connected to a building's wiring through an electrical outlet.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances; provides penalties for violations.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 22, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 22, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Designates April twentieth as a day of commemoration to be known as New York state constitution day
rollCalls.summary: Designates April twentieth as a day of commemoration to be known as New York State Constitution Day.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits state chartered banking institutions from investing in and providing financing for private prisons
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits state chartered banking institutions from investing in and providing financing for private prisons.

rollCalls.title: Requires or allows licensing entities to suspend business licenses for certain businesses that are charged or convicted of wage theft
rollCalls.summary: Requires or allows licensing entities to suspend business licenses for certain businesses that are charged or convicted of wage theft; establishes reporting requirements for wage theft convictions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits
rollCalls.summary: Relates to reporting requirements on small nonprofits which lobby before the government.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the mortgagee or lienor of an abandoned multiple dwelling to apply for the appointment of a receiver to bring the building into compliance
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the mortgagee or lienor of an abandoned multiple dwelling to apply for the appointment of a receiver to bring the building into compliance.

rollCalls.title: Relates to advanced transmission technologies
rollCalls.summary: Directs electric corporations and combination electric and gas corporations to file a cost-effectiveness and timetable analysis as part of any base rate proceeding with the public service commission; directs NYSERDA to conduct a study on the effectiveness of advanced transmission technologies.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the sale of a non-indemnity legal service plan
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the sale of a non-indemnity legal service plan shall not constitute doing an insurance business in this state; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the crime of misappropriation of payroll funds
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the crime of misappropriation of payroll funds when a person knows that funds are designated for use as employee payroll funds or as payment of payroll taxes, and intentionally prevents the funds from being used for their designated purpose.

rollCalls.title: Relates to providing language access services to individuals relating to certain tax abatement programs
rollCalls.summary: Relates to providing language access services to individuals relating to the tax abatement program for rent-controlled and rent-regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities and senior citizen and disabled  homeowners.

rollCalls.title: Allows medical assistants to administer vaccines
rollCalls.summary: Allows medical assistants to administer vaccines while under appropriate supervision of a physician, nurse practitioner or physician assistant.

rollCalls.title: Relates to protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners
rollCalls.summary: Enacts protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners; requires certain notifications from creditors and debt collectors; prohibits acceleration; enacts provisions for cosigner release.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 20, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 20, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring new employees to be provided certain information relating to student loan repayment information
rollCalls.summary: Directs the development of materials to be provided to new employees relating to student loan repayment information.

rollCalls.title: Relates to medical assistance coverage for medically tailored meals
rollCalls.summary: Requires medical assistance coverage for medically tailored meals and medical nutrition therapy for the purpose of disease management.

rollCalls.title: Directs the commissioner to publicly publish an annual report on the environmental radiation surveillance program
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner to publicly publish an annual report on the environmental radiation surveillance program and analyze such report showing trends and cumulative impact, as well as notify other relevant agencies if contamination has exceeded EPA standards for maximum amounts of contamination allowed in drinking water or food.

rollCalls.title: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency
rollCalls.summary: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency to certain graduates of post secondary programs or comparable apprenticeship and workforce training programs for the purchase of certain property.

rollCalls.title: Relates to electronic delivery of insurance notices
rollCalls.summary: Allows for certain notices related to property/casualty insurance contracts under the vehicle and traffic law to be delivered by electronic means.

rollCalls.title: Expands the healthcare services provided by telehealth
rollCalls.summary: Expands the healthcare services provided by telehealth.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing a uterine fibroids awareness and education program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a uterine fibroids awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of uterine fibroids and the elevated risk for minority women.

rollCalls.title: Authorizing the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead an application for exemption from real property taxes
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead an application for exemption from real property taxes for property owned by such village.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the annual reporting obligations of the New York state energy research and development authority
rollCalls.summary: Increases the number of entities to whom the New York state energy research and development authority must submit an annual report; requires the report to include a brief summary of all proceeds collected and administered by the authority pursuant to an order of the public service commission or pursuant to regulation, including, but not limited to, assessments, fees, taxes, transfers, corporate income or surcharges imposed on energy consumers or power generators.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits termination of electricity or heat service during forecasts of extreme temperatures
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits termination of electricity or heat service during forecasts of 85 degrees or more than or thirty-two degrees or below.

rollCalls.title: Provides that credits for excess electricity generated by customer-generators subject to net energy metering may be carried over and used to offset electricity used
rollCalls.summary: Provides that credits for excess electricity generated by customer-generators subject to net energy metering by an electric corporation or the Long Island power authority may be carried over indefinitely and used against any charges imposed by an electric corporation or the Long Island power authority when the customer-generator uses more electricity than such customer generates; provides for the accounting of credits once every 5 years and the electric corporation or Long Island power authority shall reimburse the customer-generator for the accumulated credits.

rollCalls.title: Relates to strengthening of utility storm response and compliance
rollCalls.summary: Relates to strengthening of utility storm response and compliance by reviewing mitigating factors including but not limited to mitigating factors and the specifics surrounding the violation or violations.

rollCalls.title: Requires social services districts to automatically re-enroll eligible persons or households for the low-income home energy assistance program
rollCalls.summary: Requires social services districts to, every heating season, automatically re-enroll persons or households currently receiving assistance through the low-income home energy assistance program, so long as each person or household maintains eligibility.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of state and public service commission to study and report upon disclosure by utilities to credit reporting agencies of late payments
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of state and the public service commission to study and report upon the prevalence of the disclosure by public utilities, cable television companies and cellular telephone service providers to credit reporting agencies of late payments and defaults in payment of fees and charges by consumers.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the public service commission to establish rules to limit a utility's ability to recover certain operating expenses
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes and directs the public service commission to establish rules to limit a utility's ability to recover its direct or indirect costs associated with its attendance in, participation in, preparation for, or appeal of any rate proceeding conducted before the commission.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain utility corporations and the Long Island power authority to establish a meter usage monitor program
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain utility corporations and the Long Island power authority to establish a meter usage monitor program for the purposes of notifying residential customers when energy usage exceeds a cost or usage threshold in a given billing period determined by the residential customer.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits utility corporations and municipalities from increasing a bill previously rendered to a small non-residential customer after twelve months from the date service was provided
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits utility corporations and municipalities from increasing a bill previously rendered to a small non-residential customer after twelve months from the date service was provided; provides limited exceptions to such prohibition; requires the utility corporation or municipality to provide notice regarding the late billing.

rollCalls.title: Relates to civil penalties imposed by the public service commission upon certain utility corporations
rollCalls.summary: Requires that any sanction or civil penalty imposed by the public service commission be returned to the rate payers by means of a direct bill credit, as soon as practically feasible or no later than ninety days.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the termination of certain utility services and to reports on investigatory proceedings relating to gas, electric, and steam service
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits utility corporations from imposing late fees, interest, or penalties during an investigation by the commission; allows retroactive late fees, interest, or penalties if a determination is made in favor of such utility corporation; prohibits utility services from being terminated during an investigation by the commission; requires utility corporations to notify customers of investigations; requires notice to the general public; requires the public service commission to prepare reports on investigatory proceedings relating to gas, electric, and steam service.

rollCalls.title: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation
rollCalls.summary: Requires daycare facilities to maintain evacuation and lockdown plans for children with disabilities during an emergency situation.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits recording of the entrance of a school ground
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits recording of the entrance or exit of a school ground or the entrance  or exit to a property that contains school grounds within its boundaries.

rollCalls.title: Requires the department of labor create and maintain a list of available careers and job openings for veterans in the state of New York
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of labor create and maintain a list of available careers and job openings for veterans in the state of New York and provide such list to the department of veterans' services; requires such list to be placed on the department of veterans' services website.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prosecution by the department of financial services and municipalities of certain violations regarding residential real property
rollCalls.summary: Relates to prosecution by the department of financial services (DFS) and municipalities of certain violations regarding residential real property by mortgage lenders and similar entities; directs DFS to promulgate standards of review of whether to prosecute such violations; requires deference to municipalities where both the municipality and DFS are authorized to prosecute such a violation; directs payments of civil penalties issued pursuant to such violations to be paid to DFS if DFS is the prosecuting entity.

rollCalls.title: Relates to actions involving public petition and participation
rollCalls.summary: Provides that certain allegations made by employees involving employment discrimination shall be protected and matters of public interest in actions involving public petition and participation.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the provision of breast pumps to certain incarcerated birth parents and allowing children to remain with their incarcerated birth parent for a period of time
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the provision of breast pumps and related collection and storage materials to certain incarcerated nursing birth parents who are confined in or committed to an institution or local correctional facility with or without their child subject to specific time limitations; requires institutions and local correctional facilities to provide pumps and related materials to such incarcerated birth parents; requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to issue an annual report on data relating to incarcerated birth parents.

rollCalls.title: Requires DHCR to develop a common application and web portal for certain funding, tax credits, loans, and grants for housing development
rollCalls.summary: Requires DHCR to develop a common application and web portal for certain funding, tax credits, loans, and grants for housing; requires such application to be available upon request from relevant state agencies; requires such web portal to be manageable by relevant state agencies; makes relevant provisions.

rollCalls.title: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; and makes conforming technical changes
rollCalls.summary: Ensures proper administration and enforcement of the uniform fire prevention and building code and the state energy conservation construction code; provides additional definitions; provides remedies for violations of the code; makes conforming technical changes.

rollCalls.title: Relates to automatic eligibility for early intervention services for children found to have elevated venous blood lead levels
rollCalls.summary: Relates to automatic eligibility for early intervention services for children found to have elevated venous blood lead levels (at or above 5 mcg/dl).

rollCalls.title: Requires the dissemination of materials regarding child access prevention and the safe storage of firearms
rollCalls.summary: Requires the preparation and dissemination of written materials regarding child access prevention and the safe storage of firearms; establishes such information shall be provided to students and/or persons in a parental relationship to such students at the beginning of each semester or quarter of the regular school year beginning on and after July 1, 2026.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 16, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 16, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Relates to child care provider registration
rollCalls.summary: Provides that child care provider licenses be valid for a period of up to six years.

rollCalls.title: Relates to state use of disaster emergency response personnel and non-state resource providers
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the governor to deploy non-state resource providers to the northern emergency management assistance compact and the international emergency management assistance compact.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certificate of residence policies for community colleges
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the state university trustees to promulgate rules or regulations relating to late fees and exceptions for students submitting certificate of residence forms, and a reconciliation process for such forms received after the list of non-resident students was sent to a county.

rollCalls.title: Relates to sexual offense evidence collection kit procedures
rollCalls.summary: Requires that all sexual offense evidence shall be kept in a locked, separate and secure area for twenty years from the date of collection or until the victim's fortieth birthday, whichever is later; makes other sexual offense evidence collection kit procedures.

rollCalls.title: Relates to authorizing body scanner utilization in certain facilities under the office of children and family services
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the use of body imaging scanning equipment in certain facilities for youth and adolescent offenders placed with or committed to the office of children and family services.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the introduction and use of business records in grand jury proceedings
rollCalls.summary: Provides that any writing or record made as a memorandum or record of any act, transaction, occurrence or event, may be received in grand jury proceedings as evidence of proof that such act, transaction, occurrence or event, if it was made in the regular course of any business.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 14, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 14, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Expands geographical boundaries for residency requirements of correction officers employed by the counties of Rockland and Orange
rollCalls.summary: Expands geographical boundaries for residency requirements of correction officers employed by local correction facilities of Rockland and Orange counties.

rollCalls.title: Empowers the council on the arts to designate Little Yemen as a cultural district
rollCalls.summary: Empowers the council on the arts to designate Little Yemen as a cultural district.

rollCalls.title: Requires the development and implementation of a tattoo policy by law enforcement agencies
rollCalls.summary: Requires the commissioner of the division of criminal justice services, the superintendent of the division of state police, and the commissioner of the department of corrections and community supervision and the person in charge of every state law enforcement agency to adopt and implement a tattoo policy for all members of such law enforcement agency who are designated as police officers, peace officers and applicants for employment in such positions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area
rollCalls.summary: Relates to establishing ground rent rebates for eligible homeowners and renters in the Battery Park project area; provides for a rebate program; provides for a process for application and certification.

rollCalls.title: Relates to insurance coverage for dental night guards
rollCalls.summary: Provides that dental insurance coverage shall include coverage for night guards; defines dental night guards; provides that dental night guards shall be covered under Medicaid.

rollCalls.title: Redefines the term "following" for a crime of stalking in the fourth degree
rollCalls.summary: Redefines the term "following" for a crime of stalking in the fourth degree to include the use of certain devices or computers to gain access to, record, track or report the movement or location of a person or their property without the person's permission or authority to do so.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the crimes of falsely reporting an incident in the first and second degrees
rollCalls.summary: Adds falsely reporting the use of a deadly weapon or dangerous instrument as part of the crimes of falsely reporting an incident in the first and second degrees.

rollCalls.title: Provides for offering reward or incentive programs
rollCalls.summary: Allows for insurance providers and corporations to create and offer reward or incentive programs to eligible members.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "language access expansion act"
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain documents and forms to be provided in the twelve most common non-English languages spoken by limited English proficient immigrants of five years or less according to the American community survey, as published by the United States census bureau.

rollCalls.title: Relates to audit of individual apartment improvements (IAIs) for rent stabilized apartments outside of the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Requires an annual inspection and audit process which shall review five percent of individual apartment improvement notifications for rent stabilized apartments outside of the city of New York; requires additional audits where violations are found.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Sgt Henry Johnson
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates the bridge located on Interstate 90, designated as Bridge Number 1092839, which crosses over the Hudson River in the cities of Albany and Rensselaer to Sgt Henry Johnson.

rollCalls.title: Provides for emergency appropriation for the period April 1, 2026 through April 7, 2026
rollCalls.summary: Provides for emergency appropriation through April 7, 2026 for the support of government.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions of law relating to certain costs of the department of motor vehicles
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions of law relating to increasing certain motor vehicle transaction fees and relating to certain costs of the department of motor vehicles.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits an individual convicted of a crime involving elder abuse from inheriting from the elder's estate as a distributee
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an individual convicted of a crime involving elder abuse from inheriting from the elder's estate as a distributee.

rollCalls.title: Relates to issuing stop-work orders for misclassification of employees
rollCalls.summary: Empowers the commissioner of labor to issue stop-work orders against employers for misclassification of employees as independent contractors or for providing false, incomplete, or misleading information to an insurance company on the number of employees of such employer.

rollCalls.title: Relates to designating the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day"
rollCalls.summary: Designates the fourth Thursday in March as "Tuskegee Airmen Commemoration Day".

rollCalls.title: Establishes standards for the reuse of deconstructed building materials
rollCalls.summary: Establishes standards for the reuse of deconstructed building materials; requires the uniform building code to set standards for salvage lumber; requires the secretary of state to develop a program for grading salvage lumber for structural purposes.

rollCalls.title: Relates to adding certain notice requirements for enforcing liens on goods in self-storage facilities
rollCalls.summary: Relates to adding certain notice requirements for enforcing liens on goods in self-storage facilities.

rollCalls.title: Relates to establishing the crime of voyeurism
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the crime of voyeurism in the first and second degree which is defined as when someone for their own amusement, entertainment, profit, sexual arousal or sexual gratification trespasses or uses an instrument to observe for the purpose of viewing a person dressing or undressing or the sexual or other intimate parts of such person at a place and time when such person has a reasonable expectation of privacy, without such person's knowledge or consent.

rollCalls.title: Allows for the examination of industrial development agencies and not-for-profit corporations by county comptrollers
rollCalls.summary: Allows for the examination of projects and/or actions by industrial development agencies and not-for-profit corporations by county comptrollers.

rollCalls.title: Relates to license requirements for professional geologists; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the education requirements to be licensed as a professional geologist may be partially substituted by practical experience; relates to the issuance of an identification card as a geologist in training.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain data required in an annual report on the administration of managed long term care plans
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain data to be included in reports on the administration of managed long term care plans; changes reporting period to annually.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the senior center council; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the senior center council for the purposes of providing a forum for discussion of challenges facing senior centers across the state and developing solutions; supports sharing of information regarding efficient and effective operation of senior centers in different areas around the state; encourages the spread of methods and programs with proven effectiveness; creates an environment for peer-to-peer support for senior centers across the state; offers recommendations for how the state can support senior centers and lower barriers to effective service delivery; offers recommendations on existing services and cost effective measures to ensure the long-term sustainability and viability of senior centers in all areas of the state; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

rollCalls.title: DEBT SERVICE FUND--GENERAL DEBT SERVICE FUND
rollCalls.summary: Makes appropriations for the support of government - State Debt Budget.

rollCalls.title: Requires insurance coverage for lactation consultant services
rollCalls.summary: Requires insurance coverage for lactation support services by a certified lactation consultant who evaluate and manage lactation and infant feeding problems and provide preventative clinical consulting to prevent or minimize the occurrence of potential problems.

rollCalls.title: Designates March 25, "Medal of Honor Day", as a day of commemoration
rollCalls.summary: Designates March 25, "Medal of Honor Day", as a day of commemoration.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the fentanyl abuse and overdose prevention task force
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the fentanyl abuse and overdose prevention task force to conduct a comprehensive study on fentanyl abuse and overdose prevention and to report on the findings and recommendations of the task force.

rollCalls.title: Expands definition of eligible senior citizen and disabled person with respect to condominium and cooperative conversion
rollCalls.summary: Expands definition of eligible senior citizen and disabled person to include any member of the tenant's household lawfully occupying the premises as such person's residence who is 62 years of age with respect to condominium and cooperative conversion to provide protection to disabled and senior citizen non-purchasing residents of buildings that undergo cooperative or condominium conversions under an eviction plan even where such residents are not tenants of record in the buildings.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the resolution of certain claims by certain employees
rollCalls.summary: Makes the release of any claim by an employee, or independent contractor who is a natural person, against an employer, unenforceable if, as a condition of such resolution, the employee or independent contractor is prohibited from applying for, accepting, or engaging in future employment with such employer, or any entity or entities related to such employer.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a senior housing task force
