rollCalls.summary: Relates to authorizing and regulating the use of electronic bell jar vending machines; requires responsible placement and operation of electronic bell jar vending machines; allows for geographic considerations for such machine placement.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the city of Batavia to alienate certain parklands for use as a municipal parking lot and to preserve the historic Brisbane mansion
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of Batavia to alienate certain parklands for use as a municipal parking lot and to preserve the historic Brisbane mansion.

rollCalls.title: Relates to issuing the village of Nelliston incorporation documents
rollCalls.summary: Directs the secretary of State to issue to the village of Nelliston in the Town of Palatine, Montgomery county, a certificate of incorporation verifying the status of the village of Nelliston as incorporated as a village since 1878.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Montgomery to impose a hotel and motel tax; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Montgomery to impose a hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the New York state veterans cemetery act
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the "New York state veterans cemetery act"; directs the division to conduct an investigation and study on the issue of the establishment of a New York state veterans cemetery funding program.

rollCalls.title: Relates to dental laboratories
rollCalls.summary: Relates to dental laboratories; defines terms; requires any dental laboratory operating, doing business, or intending to operate or do business in this state to register with the department of health; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to increasing the earnings limitation for positions of public service
rollCalls.summary: Relates to increasing the earnings limitation for positions of public service; increases the earnings limitation from $35,000 to $65,000 in 2027 and thereafter.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "city of Little Falls deficit financing act" authorizing the city of Little Falls, in the county of Herkimer, to finance certain deficits by the issuance of bonds
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of Little Falls, in the county of Herkimer, to issue serial bonds in an aggregate principal amount not to exceed three million four hundred thousand dollars for the purpose of liquidating deficits in its general, golf, and water funds; requires that the city of Little Falls prepare quarterly budget reports, quarterly trial balances and a three-year financial plan.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate certain land within Ferry Point Park in the borough of the Bronx
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue the use as parkland and alienate certain land within Ferry Point Park in the borough of the Bronx through the entering of leases or other agreements with Bally's New York Operating Company, LLC.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes counties to post local laws and notices via the internet
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes counties to post local laws and notices via the internet where such county doesn't have a newspaper published within the county.

rollCalls.title: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from seven to nine members
rollCalls.summary: Expands the Tompkins county industrial development agency from a maximum of seven members to nine members.

rollCalls.title: Relates to authorizing the city of New York to transfer and convey certain city owned property to the Bedford-Stuyvesant volunteer ambulance corps
rollCalls.summary: Relates to authorizing the city of New York to transfer and convey certain city owned property to the Bedford-Stuyvesant volunteer ambulance corps.

rollCalls.title: Permits surviving spouses of certain retirement plan members to retain certain benefits upon remarriage
rollCalls.summary: Permits surviving spouses of NYC police pension fund members to retain accidental death benefits upon remarriage.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Port Authority Detective Thomas Inman
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Babylon, county of Suffolk, to Detective Thomas Inman.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the purposes of the Brockport Exempt Volunteer Firefighters' Benevolent Association, Inc.
rollCalls.summary: Changes the name of the Brockport Exempt Volunteer Firemen's Benevolent Association, Inc.; expands the use of foreign fire insurance premium taxes by such organization.

rollCalls.title: Provides for a disability retirement for certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities
rollCalls.summary: Provides for a line of duty disability presumption for any condition of impairment of health caused by diseases of the lung, resulting in total or partial disability or death of certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities.

rollCalls.title: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in certain cities
rollCalls.summary: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in a city with a population of one million or more.

rollCalls.title: Revives provisions of law relating to authorizing the use of existing village sewer rents for infrastructure projects other than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville
rollCalls.summary: Revives provisions of law relating to authorizing the use of existing village sewer rents for infrastructure projects other than sewer projects in the village of Baldwinsville.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of Kings Point, town of North Hempstead, county of Nassau, to alienate and discontinue certain parklands
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of Kings Point, town of North Hempstead, county of Nassau, to alienate and discontinue certain parklands for the purpose of providing additional parking for the community center being built by the United Mashadi Jewish Community of America, and to replace such alienated parkland with a new, dedicated parkland.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the establishment of a fraud assessment commission, an assessment for workers' compensation fraud investigations and the workers' compensation fraud investigation fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a fraud assessment commission; directs the chair of the workers' compensation board, in consultation with the workers' compensation fraud inspector general and the fraud assessment commission, to establish an assessment for workers' compensation fraud investigations to fund the investigation and prosecution of workers' compensation fraud, willful failure to secure payment of workers' compensation, and failure to keep true and accurate records; establishes the workers' compensation fraud investigation fund in the joint custody of the chair of the workers' compensation board, the commissioner of labor, and the comptroller, which shall consist of monies received from the imposition of the assessment for workers' compensation fraud investigations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to disability retirement benefits to Stacie Stueber on behalf of her deceased husband, deputy sheriff Richard Stueber, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, or cleanup operations
rollCalls.summary: Provides accidental disability retirement benefits for deputy sheriff Richard Stueber, a participant in World Trade Center rescue, recovery, and cleanup operations.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the avoiding vexatious overuse of impleading to delay (AVOID) act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "avoiding vexatious overuse of impleading to delay (AVOID) act" which relates to time frames for certain court filings.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling for members who first become members of a public retirement system of the state on or after April first, two thousand twelve.

rollCalls.title: Permits certain twenty-five year retirement program dispatcher members to file elections not to participate
rollCalls.summary: Permits certain twenty-five year retirement program dispatcher members to file elections not to participate.

rollCalls.title: Relates to qualifications for holding the office of clerk-treasurer or deputy clerk in the village of Baxter Estates
rollCalls.summary: Exempts persons holding the office of clerk-treasurer or deputy clerk in the village of Baxter Estates from the requirement that such person be a resident of the political subdivision or municipal corporation of the state for which such person shall be chosen or within which such person's official functions are required to be exercised.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes agencies to procure goods, services and construction from special veteran emerging business enterprises
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes agencies to procure goods, services and construction from special veteran emerging business enterprises; defines special veteran emerging business enterprises.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Congregation Khal Mevakshei Hashem, Inc. to receive retroactive real property tax exempt status for the 2024 assessment roll and all of the 2023-2024 school taxes.

rollCalls.title: Relates to ensuring continued access to backup devices for patients with cochlear implants
rollCalls.summary: Requires insurance coverage to backup devices for patients with cochlear implants during the initial implantation and for replacements and upgrades.

rollCalls.title: Updates the South Lockport Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association's charter
rollCalls.summary: Updates the South Lockport Volunteer Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association's charter; amends the purposes of such organization and the permitted uses of certain insurance premium taxes collected.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to transfer and convey certain unappropriated state land to The Arc Westchester New York
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to transfer and convey certain unappropriated state land to The Arc Westchester New York.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a temporary practice authorization program for certain medical professionals to practice in underserved areas
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a temporary practice authorization program for physicians, registered nurses and licensed practical nurses to practice in underserved areas.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions and makes technical corrections to school speed zones in NYC; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions and makes technical corrections to school speed zones in NYC; repeals certain provisions relating thereto.

rollCalls.title: Directs the Department of Transportation to grant a permanent access and construction easement to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Department of Transportation to grant a permanent access and construction easement to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority for the use of a portion of DOT-owned land to support potential future rail yard development.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the right of publicity
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the right of publicity; amends the definitions of "deceased performer", "deceased personality" and "digital replica" in relation to the right of publicity; relates to the use of a deceased performer's digital replica without authorization by the applicable right holder.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a feasibility study and report on the potential reestablishment of the empire state summer games
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of parks, recreation and historic preservation, in conjunction with the department of economic development, to conduct a feasibility study and report on the potential reestablishment of the empire state summer games.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "fostering affordability and integrity through reasonable (FAIR) business practices act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "fostering affordability and integrity through reasonable (FAIR) business practices act", to expand the attorney general's ability to protect New Yorkers from unfair, deceptive and abusive business practices.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer
rollCalls.summary: Requires advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer; imposes a $1,000 civil penalty for a first violation and a $5,000 penalty for any subsequent violation.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Trooper James M. MacLarnon
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in Nassau county to Trooper James M. MacLarnon.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the scope of certain provisions relating to beneficial owners of limited liability companies
rollCalls.summary: Amends the definitions of the terms "beneficial owner", "reporting company" and "exempt company" to set the scope of certain provisions relating to beneficial owners of limited liability companies; authorizes the department of state to further clarify any such definitions.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of Chester to impose a hotel and motel tax; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of Chester to impose a five percent hotel and motel tax; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Requires medical evaluations for assisted living eligibility to be conducted within thirty days prior to the date of admission
rollCalls.summary: Requires medical evaluations for assisted living eligibility to be conducted within thirty days prior to the date of admission.

rollCalls.title: Removes emergency medical services from the limit on real property tax levies by local governments
rollCalls.summary: Removes expenditures for emergency medical services from the limit on real property tax levies by local governments.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Dickinson to establish hotel and motel taxes within such town.

rollCalls.title: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers
rollCalls.summary: Provides parity to durable medical equipment providers by requiring Medicaid managed care organizations to reimburse such providers at no less than one hundred percent of the medical assistance durable medical equipment and complex rehabilitation technology fee schedule for the same service or item.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits Medicaid from requiring prior authorization for certain HIV medications
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits Medicaid service providers from requiring prior authorization for antiretroviral prescription drugs for the treatment or prevention of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

rollCalls.title: Permits certain licensed athletic trainers to practice in New York State if they are licensed to practice in another state, territory or country
rollCalls.summary: Permits certain licensed athletic trainers who are licensed to practice in another state, territory or country to provide athletic training services to athletes and team personnel at a discrete sanctioned team sporting event or performance in this state.

rollCalls.title: Requires contractors and subcontractors performing construction work for covered renewable energy systems to use apprenticeship agreements
rollCalls.summary: Requires contractors and subcontractors performing construction work for covered renewable energy systems to use apprenticeship agreements; requires thermal energy networks to require contractors and subcontractors to use pre-apprenticeship direct entry providers registered with the department of labor.

rollCalls.title: Includes the space force as being members of the armed forces or veterans eligible for certain credits and benefits
rollCalls.summary: Includes the Space Force as being members of the armed forces or veterans eligible for certain credits and benefits that are available to other active and veteran members of the armed forces.

rollCalls.title: Relates to professional employer organization services
rollCalls.summary: Provides that receipts from other services and other business receipts, taxpayers, and combined groups including members, engaged in providing professional employer organization services shall include with such receipts amounts received with respect to wages, benefits, and other employee expenses disbursed to or for the benefit of a client's worksite employees and the related employment taxes if the amounts received are included in the calculation of the business income base or the combined business income base, respectively.

rollCalls.title: Repeals certain provisions regarding adoption of new or revised city charter proposed by charter commission which limit submission of questions to city's electors
rollCalls.summary: Repeals certain provisions regarding the adoption of a new or revised city charter proposed by a charter commission which limits the submission of questions to a city's qualified electors; eliminates the rule that provides that whenever a city charter commission puts a proposal on the local ballot, all other local referendum proposals are barred from the ballot.

rollCalls.title: Relates to access to educational activities by public assistance recipients who are subject to work participation requirements
rollCalls.summary: Relates to access to educational activities by public assistance recipients who are subject to work participation requirements; allows homework expected or required by an educational institution to count towards satisfaction of the work activity requirements for public assistance benefits for participants engaged in certain educational or training activities.

rollCalls.title: Requires documents utilized by state agencies, public authorities and municipalities to replace the term "emotionally disturbed person"
rollCalls.summary: Requires documents utilized by state agencies, public authorities and municipalities to replace the term "emotionally disturbed person" with the term "person experiencing an emotional crisis".

rollCalls.title: Limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland
rollCalls.summary: Relates to limiting the shift between classes of taxable property in the town of Haverstraw, county of Rockland for 2025-2026.

rollCalls.title: Relates to high deductible health plans and health savings accounts
rollCalls.summary: Relates to cost sharing requirements for high deductible health plans and health savings accounts.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Charlie Bunger Sr.
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Charlie Bunger Sr. in the village of Babylon, county of Suffolk.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants a fee for a dishonored rent check in excess of the actual costs or fees incurred by such landlord as a result thereof
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants a fee for a dishonored rent check in excess of the actual costs or fees incurred by such landlord as a result thereof, provided such dishonored check fee was included in the initial lease.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain voidable transfers affecting a federal home loan bank
rollCalls.summary: Relates to certain voidable transfers affecting a federal home loan bank including injunctions and the conduct of delinquency proceedings against insurers domiciled in this state.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "trapped at work act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "trapped at work act"; prohibits the use of employment promissory notes.

rollCalls.title: Requires manufacturers or distributers of kratom within the state to include a warning label; prohibits labeling of kratom products as all natural
rollCalls.summary: Requires manufacturers of kratom products within the state to have a warning label that the product has not been approved by the federal food and drug administration and the products' side effects; prohibits labeling of kratom products as all natural.

rollCalls.title: Creates the jockey health insurance reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Creates the jockey health insurance reserve fund for the payment of premiums not yet paid; provides for the return of funds if such reserve fund becomes no longer necessary.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a brand owner's license
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person with a federal basic permit to apply to the liquor authority for a brand owner's license; establishes a fee therefor.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring the display of a notice of responsibilities to protect underground facilities
rollCalls.summary: Provides any entity which leases excavation equipment to the public with the telephone number of the system and a sample or model notice informing lessees of excavation equipment of the system and their responsibilities relating to the protection of underground facilities.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Copake to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues to be deposited into the fund
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Copake to establish community preservation funds and to impose a real estate transfer tax with revenues to be deposited into the community preservation fund; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Establishes standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems
rollCalls.summary: Establishes standards for glass repair and calibration of advanced driver assistance systems for motor vehicle glass repair facilities.

rollCalls.title: Allows individuals to register in the donate life registry through mandatory personal income tax electronic tax filings
rollCalls.summary: Allows individuals to register in the "donate life registry" on any mandatory electronic personal income tax filing.

rollCalls.title: Requires rates paid for rehabilitation and opioid treatment be pursuant to certain fee schedules published by the office of addiction services and supports
rollCalls.summary: Requires rates paid for rehabilitation and opioid treatment be pursuant to certain fee schedules published by the office of addiction services and supports.

rollCalls.title: Relates to scholarships for academic excellence
rollCalls.summary: Provides that a scholarship for academic excellence that is declined by a student prior to the end of their high school program shall be granted to the next most qualified student, if practicable.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the city of Mount Vernon to impose a hotel and motel tax
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the city of Mount Vernon to impose a hotel and motel tax of 5.875%.

rollCalls.title: Increases the tax on deeds in the city of Mount Vernon
rollCalls.summary: Increases the tax on deeds in the city of Mount Vernon to 1 1/2 percent.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the Rochester school facilities modernization program act
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes an additional $125 million for Phase 3 of the Rochester school facilities modernization program; extends phase 3 of the Rochester school facilities modernization program to 2033.

rollCalls.title: Reduces tuition rates for certain Olympic athletes
rollCalls.summary: Reduces tuition rates of out of state Olympic athletes who represented Team USA.

rollCalls.title: Reforms the education requirements for persons who want to become certified public accountants
rollCalls.summary: Reforms the education requirements for persons who want to become certified public accountants; provides alternative pathways to being certified as certified public accountants.

rollCalls.title: Relates to hotel and motel taxes in Saratoga county and the city of Saratoga Springs
rollCalls.summary: Relates to hotel and motel taxes in Saratoga county and the city of Saratoga Springs; increases the allowable amount of tax imposed by the county; removes exemptions for properties having less than 4 units; relates to the disposition of tax revenues collected; eliminates an advisory committee.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the purpose of such corporation and the use of certain tax monies received by the Rescue Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association Inc. in the town of Cheektowaga, Erie county
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the purpose of such corporation and the use of certain tax monies received by the Rescue Volunteer and Exempt Firemen's Benevolent Association Inc. in the town of Cheektowaga, Erie county.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices; requires such informational pamphlet to be available on the department of health's website; requires practitioners to distribute such informational pamphlet to patients seeking contraceptives.

rollCalls.title: Provides alternative retirement benefits for the police force at Erie County Medical Center
rollCalls.summary: Provides alternative retirement benefits for the police force at Erie County Medical Center; provides a qualifying member shall receive a retirement allowance consisting of a pension equal to one-fiftieth of their final average salary for each year of qualifying creditable service.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes David Edwards to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes David Edwards to receive certain service credit under a twenty-five year retirement plan offering one-sixtieths after twenty-five years of total creditable service for service with the Binghamton Fire Department.

rollCalls.title: Relates to an exemption from the licensing requirements for servicers of student loans
rollCalls.summary: Relates to an exemption from the licensing requirements for servicers of student loans.

rollCalls.title: Requires the commissioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program
rollCalls.summary: Requires the commissioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the elderly pharmaceutical insurance coverage program, including future enrollment and program cost projections, and to publish such report and deliver the report to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, and the speaker of the assembly.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the village of Croton-on-Hudson to impose a hotel and motel tax
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the village of Croton-on-Hudson, in the county of Westchester, to impose a hotel and motel tax.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to SB Clinical Practice Management Plan, Inc. for the construction of facilities
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to SB Clinical Practice Management Plan, Inc. for the construction of facilities.

rollCalls.title: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises to 2026
rollCalls.summary: Extends the reporting deadline of the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2026; extends for one year the advisory panel on employee-owned enterprises which is tasked with reporting and making recommendations on how best to support such businesses and promote the formation and growth of new employee-owned enterprises in New York state.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
rollCalls.summary: Allows the state liquor authority to issue a retail license for on-premises consumption for a premises which shall be located within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a church, synagogue or other place of worship.

rollCalls.title: Relates to retail food store, food service establishment and food warehouse licensing
rollCalls.summary: Relates to retail food store, food service establishment and food warehouse licensing; defines terms; provides for licensure; authorizes the commissioner of agriculture and markets to grant, suspend or revoke licenses; authorizes civil practice law and rules article 78 proceedings to challenge the actions of such commissioner; authorizes such commissioner or such commissioner's duly authorized representatives to investigate and inspect such retail food stores or warehouses; requires the department of agriculture and markets to assign at least on retail food specialist to each inspection zone; provides for penalties and remedies; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Establishes voluntary opportunities for veterans
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of veterans' services to provide information on the department's website on volunteer opportunities available to veterans and to post relevant application forms that a qualified veteran can use to apply for volunteer opportunities.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes occupancy taxes in the city of Utica and the city of Rome
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes occupancy taxes in the city of Utica and the city of Rome not to exceed 3%.

rollCalls.title: Relates to qualifications to hold the position of assistant village engineer in the village of Croton-on-Hudson
rollCalls.summary: Permits the village of Croton-on-Hudson to allow the office of assistant village engineer of such village to be held by a person who is not a resident of such village, provided that such person resides within Westchester county or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

rollCalls.title: Relates to a license to sell liquor at retail for consumption on certain premises
rollCalls.summary: Allows the state liquor authority to issue a retail license for on-premises consumption for a premises which shall be located within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a school, church, synagogue or other place of worship.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain sections of law relating to real property tax exemptions for real property owned by volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain sections of law relating to real property tax exemptions for real property owned by volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

rollCalls.title: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects
rollCalls.summary: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions of the coordinated construction act for lower Manhattan relating to joint bidding on contracts for public work projects.

rollCalls.title: Extends provisions authorizing the city of Hudson to impose hotel and motel taxes
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions authorizing the city of Hudson to impose hotel and motel taxes.

rollCalls.title: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance of a church
rollCalls.summary: Exempts certain property located in the city of Glens Falls, county of Warren, from the prohibition of alcohol sales within two hundred feet of a building occupied as a church, synagogue or other place of worship.

rollCalls.title: Relates to judicial districts
rollCalls.summary: Provides that in the fourth judicial department, two new districts, fourteen and fifteen are added; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Makes technical changes to the aid to localities budget regarding certain state agencies
rollCalls.summary: Makes technical changes to the aid to localities budget regarding the office of children and family services, the office of temporary and disability assistance, the department of health, the department of labor and the department of state.

rollCalls.title: Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for certain appropriations for services and expenses of additional grants-in-aid to certain school districts, public libraries and institutions
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2022-2023 state fiscal year for grants in aid to certain agricultural organizations
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for certain appropriations for the 2022-2023 state fiscal year for grants-in-aid to environmental conservation initiatives

Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2023-2024 fiscal year for services and expenses of human services and veterans community services organizations
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for additional grants in aid to certain schools, libraries and not-for-profit institutions
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for additional grants in aid certain educational and not-for-profit institutions

Establishes an itemized list of grantees for the 2024-25 state fiscal year for services and expenses, grants or reimbursement of expenses incurred by providers of community safety and restorative justice programs
Sets forth an itemized list of grantees for the 2024-25 state fiscal year for services and expenses of senate priorities for housing initiatives
Sets forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2024-25 state fiscal year for the provision of community adult and youth mental health programs and services
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for certain appropriations for services and expenses of economic development and community services organizations
Establishes an itemized list of grantees for the 2024-25 state fiscal year for services and expenses of human services and veterans community services organizations
Amends a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for the New York state economic development assistance program
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-2026 state fiscal year for community public health programs and services
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-2026 state fiscal year for community adult and youth mental health programs and services
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-2026 state fiscal year for community safety and restorative justice programs
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-2026 state fiscal year for services and expenses of senate priorities for housing initiatives
Sets forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-2026 state fiscal year for services and expenses of economic development and community services organizations
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for the 2025-2026 state fiscal year for additional grants in aid for education
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for a certain appropriation for additional grants in aid to certain libraries
Establishes a list of grantees for certain appropriations for the 2025-26 state fiscal year
Establishes a plan setting forth an itemized list of grantees for certain appropriations for the 2025-26 state fiscal year for grants or reimbursement of certain expenses by local governments
Prohibits public utilities from using funds or being reimbursed by funds raised from ratepayers for certain activities
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits public utilities from using funds or being reimbursed by funds raised from ratepayers for contributions or gifts to political candidates, trade associations, public charities, and lobbyists, and for certain travel, entertainment and educational expenditures.

rollCalls.title: Relates to allowing telephone calls prior to an incarcerated individual's transfer
rollCalls.summary: Relates to allowing telephone calls prior to an incarcerated individual's transfer except under exceptional circumstances.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "open shelves act"
rollCalls.summary: Ensures that library staff of free association, public, and hospital libraries, and with certain advice, Indian libraries, are able to develop collections, services, and programming that reflect the values and protections established under the human rights law and the equal rights amendment to the state constitution.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the rider representation act relating to membership on the board of the metropolitan transportation authority
rollCalls.summary: Provides voting membership to existing non-voting rider representatives on the MTA Board, provides for enhanced representation of MTA riders with disabilities.

rollCalls.title: Requires third-party food delivery services maintain insurance through a group policy that covers bodily injury or death arising out of or resulting from qualifying accidents involving a delivery person
rollCalls.summary: Requires third-party food delivery services maintain insurance through a group policy that covers bodily injury or death arising out of or resulting from qualifying accidents involving a delivery person.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems
rollCalls.summary: Regulates the development and use of certain artificial intelligence systems to prevent algorithmic discrimination; requires independent audits of high risk AI systems; provides for enforcement by the attorney general.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "food safety and chemical disclosure act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "food safety and chemical disclosure act"; prohibits certain food additives and food color additives; provides that in an action to enforce compliance, the recognition by the federal food and drug administration of any of these substances as safe may not be alleged as a defense; establishes requirements for the reporting of GRAS (generally recognized as safe) substances.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the submission of requests to the committee on special education for the educational services mandated by an individualized education services program
rollCalls.summary: Requires the school district of location shall annually provide written notice to all parents or persons in parental relation to students with disabilities attending nonpublic schools within their district regarding the process for requesting special education services; relates to the denial of services in a city having a population of one million or more for the 2024--2025 school year.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the municipal sustainable energy loan program regarding qualifying water improvements, qualifying resiliency improvements and, in a city with a population of one million or more, the use of low carbon intensity building components.

rollCalls.title: Requires school districts to provide information regarding water safety to parents or students upon enrollment
rollCalls.summary: Requires school districts to provide information regarding water safety to parents or students upon enrollment.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates portion of the state highway system to Detective Brian C. Mulkeen
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Woodbury, county of Orange, to Detective Brian C. Mulkeen.

rollCalls.title: Requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "safer weapons, safer homes act"; requires the division of criminal justice services to study the technological viability of personalized firearms; defines personalized firearms; requires the division to report to the governor and the legislature on the results of the study.

rollCalls.title: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for SCRIE, DRIE, SCHE and DHE by any increase in the consumer price index
rollCalls.summary: Provides for adjustment of the maximum income threshold for eligibility for the senior citizen rent increase exemption (SCRIE), disability rent increase exemption (DRIE), senior citizen homeowners' exemption (SCHE), and disabled homeowners' exemption (DHE) by any increase in the consumer price index (CPI).

rollCalls.title: Relates to electronic appearances for parking violations
rollCalls.summary: Provides that persons charged with a parking violation shall be able to make an electronic court appearance unless a locality elects not to permit electronic appearances.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes municipalities in the county of Orange to add unpaid housing code violation penalties, costs and fines to such municipalities' annual tax levy in accordance with applicable law.

rollCalls.title: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential
rollCalls.summary: Provides that the results of urine tests conducted pursuant to a judicial diversion program shall be private and confidential.

rollCalls.title: Designates certain portions of the state highway system as the "Between Cayuga and Seneca Lakes Wine Trail"
rollCalls.summary: Designates certain portions of the state highway system between Cayuga lake and Seneca lake as the "Between Cayuga and Seneca Lakes Wine Trail".

rollCalls.title: Establishes the previously owned zero-emission vehicles rebate program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the previously owned zero-emission vehicles rebate program to provide an incentive of an amount up to $2,000 for individuals who purchase used or previously owned zero-emission vehicles.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "beauty justice act"
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "beauty justice act"; provides for the regulation of ingredients in personal care products and cosmetics; prohibits the sale of personal care products and cosmetic products containing certain restricted products.

rollCalls.title: Provides for certain presumptions for reckless driving and the implementation of a reckless driving and vehicular violence awareness component of the pre-licensing course for driver's licenses
rollCalls.summary: Provides for certain presumptions for reckless driving and the implementation of a reckless driving and vehicular violence awareness component of the pre-licensing course for driver's licenses.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the wage payment integrity act
rollCalls.summary: Amends provisions relating to payment of wages to include compensation that is not payable solely at the employer's discretion; requires certain notices.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the New York state and local employees' retirement system to accept an application for disability retirement benefits from Andrew Reilly, Jr.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the New York state and local employees' retirement system to accept an application for disability retirement benefits from Andrew Reilly, Jr.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the maximum allowable timeframes to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the maximum allowable time frames to respond to requests for records under the freedom of information act.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the office of Native American affairs
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the office of Native American affairs to act as a centralized office for Native American nations to access information on state programs that are provided to Native Americans.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prohibiting the procurement of certain technology and products which pose a state or national security risk
rollCalls.summary: Aligns state and local procurement laws with federal law prohibiting the procurement of certain information and communications technology and electronic parts or products which are determined to pose a risk to state and national security.

rollCalls.title: Allows for individuals to consent to receive information regarding donor programs at the time of application for or renewal of a driver's license or non-driver identification card
rollCalls.summary: Allows for individuals consent to receive information from the C.W. Bill Young Cell Transplantation Program and the national marrow donor program at the time of application for or renewal of a driver's license or non-driver identification card; directs the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish a process by which the department of motor vehicles shall refer driver's license and non-driver identification card applicants who consent to having their information shared with the C.W. Bill Young Cell Transplantation Program and the national marrow donor program for the purposes of receiving information from such programs about enrolling as a potential donor.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the authority of a hospice medical director to sign a death certificate
rollCalls.summary: Grants authority to a hospice medical director or a physician designated by such director, to sign a death certificate.

rollCalls.title: Establishes an office of the state medical fund ombudsperson and a medical indemnity fund advisory panel
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an office of the state medical indemnity fund ombudsperson and a medical indemnity fund advisory panel to advocate for, assist and represent the interests of qualified plaintiffs.

rollCalls.title: Requires that pharmacies that are permanently discontinuing to notify customers of such discontinuance
rollCalls.summary: Requires pharmacies that are permanently discontinuing to notify customers of such discontinuance and provide information including locations of other nearby pharmacies.

rollCalls.title: Relates to article 78 judgments regarding disability pension determinations
rollCalls.summary: Permits court ruling in favor of a petitioner appealing the denial of a disability pension determination to grant disability pension.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "sustainable affordable housing and sprawl prevention act"; exempts or limits environmental review under SEQR for the construction of certain new residential units to avoid creating unnecessary housing sprawl; limits certain rights to action under SEQR; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Provides lead service line identification for certain water systems
rollCalls.summary: Provides lead service line identification by a public water system that serves certain areas.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the "New York junk fee prevention act"
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the "New York junk fee prevention act"; requires clear and conspicuous pricing practices regarding junk fees.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the "no severance ultimatums act"
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the "no severance ultimatums act", which prevents employers from giving coercive ultimatums to employees or former employees relating to severance agreements.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the public service commission to establish rules to limit a utility's ability to recover certain operating expenses
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes and directs the public service commission to establish rules to limit a utility's ability to recover its direct or indirect costs associated with its attendance in, participation in, preparation for, or appeal of any rate proceeding conducted before the commission.

rollCalls.title: Relates to access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs
rollCalls.summary: Provides an owner or lessee access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs for certain circumstances.

rollCalls.title: Relates to banning the use of biometric identifying technology in schools
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of biometric identifying technology in schools for any reason other than certain specified purposes; adds fingerprint identification of teachers, administrators and students for the purpose of securely logging into a digital device for academic and administrative purpose to allowable purposes.

rollCalls.title: Protects tenants displaced due to fire
rollCalls.summary: Provides that any tenant who is evicted or otherwise removed from a dwelling unit as a result of a vacate order issued by any governmental agency or department due to fire shall be entitled to a suitable accommodation; defines suitable accommodation; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the disposition of certain fines and penalties
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the disposition of certain fines and penalties; directs such fines to a conservation enforcement account in the state conservation fund.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the Bedford Hills Fire District to file an application for exemption from school and real property taxes
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Bedford Hills Fire District to file an application for exemption from school and real property taxes for the 2022-2023 assessment years.

rollCalls.title: Relates to requiring the installation of intelligent speed assistance devices for repeated violation of maximum speed limits
rollCalls.summary: Requires the installation of intelligent speed assistance devices if a driver accumulates eleven or more points on their driving record during a 24 month period, or receives 6 speed camera or red light camera tickets during a twelve month period.

rollCalls.title: Permits certain retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from certain other retail licensees
rollCalls.summary: Permits on-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from off-premises retail licensees and off-premises retail licensees to purchase wine and liquor from on-premises retail licensees.

rollCalls.title: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded
rollCalls.summary: Requires contracting agencies to contact minority and women-owned business enterprises when such enterprise is listed on a utilization plan and when a contract is awarded; mandates that the prime contractor use such enterprise identified on the utilization plan, unless such enterprise cannot perform or is no longer state certified.

rollCalls.title: Requires the board of elections in a city with a population of one million or more to provide certain notices prior to a change of polling place
rollCalls.summary: Requires the board of elections in a city with a population of one million or more to notify by mail state and county party committees and certain elected officials prior to a change of polling place.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the veterans tuition awards program
rollCalls.summary: Expands the veterans tuition awards program to allow the transfer of unused benefits to a spouse, survivor or child; defines terms.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the anti-waiver of employment rights act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "anti-waiver of employment rights act" to invalidate any express or implied contractual provision waiving or otherwise limiting any employee's substantive or procedural rights, remedies, or claim.

rollCalls.title: Provides family leave to persons recovering from a pregnancy loss
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definition of "family leave" to include persons recovering from a pregnancy loss.

rollCalls.title: Clarifies that the statutory damages available for certain wage violations are not punitive in nature and are designed to compensate workers
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies that the statutory damages available for certain wage violations are not punitive in nature and are designed to be liquidated damages rather than penalties or to compensate workers for the employer's failure to prevent wage theft and for the harm to employees that results from such failure.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act
rollCalls.summary: Enacts the "consumer wheelchair repair bill of rights act" requiring manufacturers to make available certain documentation, parts, embedded software, firmware, or tools necessary for repairing equipment; establishes a timely repair for wheelchair program; deems all wheelchair repairs needed within 5 years of initial prescription medically necessary.

rollCalls.title: Relates to warning labels on certain social media platforms
rollCalls.summary: Requires warning labels on social media platforms which provide an addictive feed, autoplay, infinite scroll, like counts, and/or push notifications; directs the commissioner of mental health to design the warning label.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the "Jack Reid Law: Protect All Students Act"
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits discrimination against and harassment or bullying of students by other students on school property or at a school function; requires schools to investigate reports of bullying; requires schools to adopt a written, plain-language anti-bullying and harassment policy; requires school employees to report incidents of bullying or harassment.

rollCalls.title: Repeals section 2307 of the public health law relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease
rollCalls.summary: Repeals provisions relating to persons knowing themselves to be infected with venereal disease.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a procedure for appointing a president or chairperson upon a vacancy of such position.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the sale of digital electronic equipment and providing diagnostic and repair information
rollCalls.summary: Modifies what qualifies as an original equipment manufacturer and the manufacture date when hardware must comply with the right to repair law; repeals certain limitations on the right to repair law.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the sale and distribution of certain mercury-added lamps
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale and distribution of compact fluorescent mercury-added lamps and linear fluorescent mercury-added lamps on and after January 1, 2029; provides exceptions; allows for sale of otherwise prohibited lamps from existing stock acquired prior to such date.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Michael Winston Hoard, the widower of Kathy Marie Dwyer-Hoard, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of his deceased wife with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the offense of vehicular homicide
rollCalls.summary: Creates the crime of vehicular homicide; makes such crime a class B felony.

rollCalls.title: Relates to commuter passes on the New York state thruway in the Syracuse area
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the New York state thruway authority to issue annual short distance commuter permits which shall provide for travel at no charge between interchanges in permit areas.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Union Vale, county of Dutchess, to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Union Vale, county of Dutchess, to alienate and discontinue the use of certain parklands and to lease the lands to Homeland Towers, LLC for the placement and operation of a wireless communications tower.

rollCalls.title: Establishes an online insurance verification system for motor vehicle insurance
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an online insurance verification system for motor vehicle insurance; requires insurers to provide necessary information.

rollCalls.title: Relates to prevailing wage requirements applicable to brownfield remediation work performed under private contract
rollCalls.summary: Relates to prevailing wage requirements applicable to brownfield remediation work performed under private contract as it relates to certain remediation activities, for sites that are seeking or have received a determination that the site is eligible for the tangible property credit component of the brownfield redevelopment tax credit, and the work is paid for in whole or in part by public funds.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of intoxication of the victim as a defense in sex crimes where the victim is under the extreme influence of any substance which renders them incapable of appraising or controlling such victim's conduct and incapable of clearly expressing lack of consent.

rollCalls.title: Relates to peer-to-peer mobile payment service security
rollCalls.summary: Directs every peer-to-peer mobile service to require users to create a personal identification code associated with the user's account that is required to be used when certain actions are taken and to require users to set a monetary amount for intended transfers above which the use of a personal identification number will be required to authenticate the user's identity.

rollCalls.title: Requires the development of mental illness training for providers of temporary housing
rollCalls.summary: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance, in conjunction with the office of mental health and the office of children and family services, to develop a mental illness training course to be utilized by providers of temporary housing assistance to focus on recognizing signs and symptoms of mental illness.

rollCalls.title: Relates to protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners
rollCalls.summary: Enacts protections for private education loan borrowers and cosigners; requires certain notifications from creditors and debt collectors; prohibits acceleration; enacts provisions for cosigner release.

rollCalls.title: Defines enforcement officers in a city with a population of one million or more for the purposes of regulating tobacco products, herbal cigarettes and smoking paraphernalia
rollCalls.summary: Defines enforcement officers in a city with a population of one million or more for the purposes of regulating tobacco products, herbal cigarettes and smoking paraphernalia; provides that an enforcement officer for purposes of section 1399-ee of the public health law shall be the office of administrative trials and hearings.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.

rollCalls.title: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation, and department of transportation about certain freight rail trains
rollCalls.summary: Requires railroad corporations to inform the division of homeland security and emergency services, department of environmental conservation and department of transportation about freight rail trains transporting hazardous materials prior to traveling on tracks within the state.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a moratorium on the sale and use of biosolids
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a moratorium on the sale and use of biosolids; defines terms.

rollCalls.title: Directs the commissioner of the office of general services to erect a monument to be known as the New York state Holocaust memorial
rollCalls.summary: Directs the commissioner of the office of general services to erect a monument to be known as the "New York state Holocaust memorial" in the Governor Nelson A. Rockefeller Empire State Plaza to memorialize the victims of the Holocaust and to educate the public about the history of the Holocaust and the dangers of antisemitism, racism, and all manifestations of intolerance.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to transfer and convey certain state land to the Syosset central school district
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the commissioner of general services to transfer and convey certain state land to the Syosset Central School District for the purpose of building new and expanding current facilities at Berry Hill Elementary School; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals
rollCalls.summary: Permits unvented attics and unvented enclosed rafter assemblies to be sealed with air-impermeable insulation in order to help attain building decarbonization goals.

rollCalls.title: Requires peer-to-peer car sharing programs provide certain insurance coverage
rollCalls.summary: Requires peer-to-peer car sharing programs provide insurance coverage in amounts equal to the financial responsibility requirements set forth in section three hundred eleven of the vehicle and traffic law; removes requirements relating to requiring additional insurance coverage.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Susan Gillinder, the widow of Robert C. Ritchie, to file a new service retirement application and an option election form on behalf of her deceased husband with the New York state and local employees' retirement system.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the practice of professional geology
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the practice of professional geology.

rollCalls.title: Relates to licensing laser hair removal technicians
rollCalls.summary: Relates to licensing laser hair removal technicians; establishes laser hair removal rules, regulations and standards.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a quality incentive program for managed care providers
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a quality incentive program for managed care providers that is distributed based on managed care providers' performance in meeting quality objectives.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study on the number of children who are caregivers and how being a caregiver impacts their education.

rollCalls.title: Provides for the transfer of service credit between certain retirement systems
rollCalls.summary: Provides for the transfer of service credit by a member of the New York city police pension fund into the New York city police pension fund.

rollCalls.title: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain health insurance policies include coverage for services provided by pharmacists related to contraceptives.

rollCalls.title: Modernizes the practice of podiatry
rollCalls.summary: Modernizes the practice of podiatry specifically relating to ankle surgery.

rollCalls.title: Relates to staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people
rollCalls.summary: Sets minimum staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people.

rollCalls.title: Relates to eligibility for participants in the automotive 25 year/age 50 pension plan with more than 30 years of credited service who remain in active service after age 62 to receive a service retirement benefit
rollCalls.summary: Relates to eligibility for participants in the automotive 25 year/age 50 pension plan with more than 30 years of credited service who remain in active service after age 62 to receive a service retirement benefit equivalent to the standard service retirement benefit received by Tier IV members with the same age and service.

rollCalls.title: Relates to bus lane restrictions in New York city
rollCalls.summary: Provides that it shall be a defense to any prosecution for a violation of a bus lane restriction pursuant to a bus rapid transit program when an employee of the metropolitan transportation authority is performing authorized duties on behalf of such authority and is operating an authorized employer motor vehicle in the bus lane at the time of the violation and conducting lawful business or providing service to an official metropolitan transportation authority vehicle or personnel while in a bus lane.

rollCalls.title: Authorizing the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead an application for exemption from real property taxes
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the assessor of the county of Nassau to accept from the Incorporated Village of Hempstead an application for exemption from real property taxes for property owned by such village.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from The Cathedral of the Incarnation in the Diocese of Long Island
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from The Cathedral of the Incarnation in the Diocese of Long Island.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Chabad of West Hempstead
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the county of Nassau assessor to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Chabad of West Hempstead for a portion of the 2022-2023 school taxes, a portion of the 2023 general taxes; all of the 2023-2024 school taxes and all of the 2024 general taxes; and all of the restored 2024-2025 school taxes and all of the restored 2025 general taxes.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the training and use of artificial intelligence frontier models
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the training and use of artificial intelligence frontier models; defines terms; establishes remedies for violations.

rollCalls.title: Requires synthetic content creations system providers to include provenance data on certain content made available by the provider
rollCalls.summary: Requires synthetic content creations system providers to include provenance data on synthetic content produced or modified by a synthetic content creations system that such provider makes available.

rollCalls.title: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties
rollCalls.summary: Provides a tax exemption on real property owned by active auxiliary police officers in local law enforcement agencies in certain counties having a population of more than three hundred thirty-eight thousand and less than three hundred forty thousand, determined in accordance with the latest federal decennial census.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Patterson to impose a hotel and motel tax
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Patterson, in the county of Putnam, to impose a hotel and motel tax.

rollCalls.title: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed as probation officers
rollCalls.summary: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed as a probation officer, supervising probation officer or probation officer trainee of a department of probation in a city with a population of one million or more.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the senior center council; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the senior center council for the purposes of providing a forum for discussion of challenges facing senior centers across the state and developing solutions; supports sharing of information regarding efficient and effective operation of senior centers in different areas around the state; encourages the spread of methods and programs with proven effectiveness; creates an environment for peer-to-peer support for senior centers across the state; offers recommendations for how the state can support senior centers and lower barriers to effective service delivery; offers recommendations on existing services and cost effective measures to ensure the long-term sustainability and viability of senior centers in all areas of the state; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Police Officer Frederick G. Maley
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Police Officer Frederick G. Maley in the hamlet of North Bellmore, town of Hempstead, county of Nassau.

rollCalls.title: Establishes the crimes of unlawful dissemination or publication of intimate images in the first, second, and third degree; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the crimes of unlawful dissemination or publication of intimate images in the first, second, and third degree; defines terms and clarifies application of provisions relating to such crimes; extends the statute of limitations for such crimes; repeals provisions relating thereto.

rollCalls.title: Relates to indexing fixed amounts and clarifying compliance
rollCalls.summary: Relates to indexing fixed amounts and clarifying compliance with respect to life insurance agents.

rollCalls.title: Relates to rechargeable battery recycling
rollCalls.summary: Relates to rechargeable battery recycling; adds a battery used as the principal electric power source for an electric scooter or bicycle with electric assist to the definition of "rechargeable battery"; provides that a battery manufacturer may not sell, offer for sale, or distribute rechargeable batteries in the state unless the battery manufacturer is implementing or participating under an approved plan; allows a city with a population of one million or more to enforce through its own agencies.

rollCalls.title: Relates to the provision of regulatory information to small businesses
rollCalls.summary: Relates to the provision of regulatory information to small businesses through the establishment of a small business regulatory nexus by certain agencies.

rollCalls.title: authorizing Liliana Fernandez-Clemente, the widow of Daniel Clemente, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Liliana Fernandez-Clemente, the widow of Daniel Clemente, to file a new service retirement application and option election form with the New York state and local employees' retirement system on behalf of such deceased member.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the government response to insider fraud and trading act relating to securities fraud whistleblower incentives and protections
rollCalls.summary: Provides for securities fraud whistleblower incentives and protections; defines terms; grants whistleblower awards for one or more whistleblowers who voluntarily provide original information to the attorney general that was the basis for a successful covered enforcement action; protects whistleblowers from retaliation; authorizes the attorney general to adopt any necessary rules and regulations; makes related provisions.

rollCalls.title: Directs counties to develop and maintain comprehensive county emergency medical system plans
rollCalls.summary: Directs counties, in coordination with their regional emergency medical services councils, to develop and maintain comprehensive county emergency medical system plans that provide for coordinated emergency medical systems within such counties.

rollCalls.title: Relates to automated decision-making by government agencies
rollCalls.summary: Regulates automated decision-making by government agencies; requires agencies to conduct impact assessments; requires disclosure of automated decision-making tools utilized by governmental agencies.

rollCalls.title: Directs the department of motor vehicles to create a plan to increase the availability of wheelchair accessible vehicles in New York state outside of the city of New York
rollCalls.summary: Directs the department of motor vehicles to develop a plan to increase the availability of wheelchair accessible vehicles, by county, in New York state outside of the city of New York; defines accessibility; requires a report to identify any existing local guidelines for accessible vehicles; directs development of benchmarks for increasing wheelchair accessible vehicles.

rollCalls.title: Relates to actions and proceedings seeking an abatement of rent based on violations of the housing maintenance code
rollCalls.summary: Relates to actions and proceedings seeking an abatement of rent based on violations of the housing maintenance code, applicable housing standards, the building code, or the health code; relates to the number of housing judges assigned to certain actions.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the assessor of Nassau county to accept an application for retroactive real property tax exempt status from Al-Muneer Foundation, Inc.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the assessor of Nassau county to accept an application for retroactive real property tax exempt status from Al-Muneer Foundation, Inc.

rollCalls.title: Permits the town of Warwick to use preservation funds for water quality improvement
rollCalls.summary: Permits the town of Warwick to utilize preservation funds for the implementation of water quality improvement projects.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes an occupancy tax in the village of Baldwinsville
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes an occupancy tax of up to 5% in the village of Baldwinsville, county of Onondaga.

rollCalls.title: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Jack Barletta
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Jack Barletta on state route 208 in the county of Orange.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the issuance of "Blue Star Mother" and "Blue Star Family" distinctive license plates and establishes the "blue star mothers and families fund"
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the issuance of "Blue Star Mother" and "Blue Star Family" distinctive license plates for parents and family members of active duty service members; establishes the "blue star mothers and families support fund".

rollCalls.title: Authorizes a residential parking system in the village of Sleepy Hollow in the county of Westchester
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a residential parking system in the village of Sleepy Hollow in the county of Westchester.

rollCalls.title: Requires the department of health to enter into a contract for the digitalization and indexing of certain vital records
rollCalls.summary: Requires the department of health to enter into a contract with an entity experienced in maintaining genealogical research databases for the digitalization and indexing of certain vital records.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the widow of William James Middlebrooks to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Janice Middlebrooks, the widow of William James Middlebrooks, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.

rollCalls.title: Prohibits the sale of children's products, mattresses and upholstered furniture containing fiberglass unless they contain a prominent label
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale of children's products, mattresses and upholstered furniture containing fiberglass unless they contain a prominent label; defines children's product; prohibits custom upholsterers from repairing or restoring any children's product, mattress or furniture with parts that contain fiberglass; provides remedies for violations.

rollCalls.title: Relates to payments in lieu of taxes for property acquired for park or recreational purposes by the town of Hempstead
rollCalls.summary: Extends from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2027, the expiration of provisions of the town law relating to payments in lieu of taxes for property acquired for park or recreational purposes by the town of Hempstead.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the town of Highlands to impose a hotel and motel tax
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the town of Highlands, Orange county, to impose a hotel and motel tax of up to five percent.

rollCalls.title: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police; provides for employer pick-up of certain additional member contributions required to be made by certain participants in the 25-year retirement programs.

rollCalls.title: Authorizes the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes Bonnie E. Sullivan, the widow of Gerald J. Sullivan, to file an application with the New York state and local police and fire retirement system on behalf of such deceased member and deem such application as timely filed.

rollCalls.title: Relates to pro bono service by attorneys and candidates for admission to the bar
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a requirement of pro bono service as a condition of admission to the bar or attorney registration; exempts pro bono work performed pursuant to an agreement with the federal government if the federal government designates the recipients of the pro bono work or type or types or nature of such legal services; provides for the expiration of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Enacts the NY-PROTECT ACT; repealer
rollCalls.summary: Allows an organization included on the federal list of tax-exempt organizations under section 501(c)(3) of title 26 of the United States code on March first, two thousand twenty-five to automatically maintain their tax-exempt status for New York state purposes; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

rollCalls.title: Relates to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington
rollCalls.summary: Extends provisions relating to certain real property to be conveyed to the town of Huntington for one year.
